summary: On-policy knowledge distillation transfers reasoning from large teachers to compact students, but existing approaches suffer three compounding failure modes: (i) cold-start collapse, where a fresh student assigns near-zero mass to teacher-preferred tokens; (ii) state-agnostic divergence scheduling, where time-only forward/reverse-KL interpolation ignores the student's coverage state; and (iii) binary reward sparsity, where pass/fail signals discard information from partially correct traces. We present CADENCE, a unified framework with a targeted fix for each. Its DRIFT mechanism schedules a per-token convex mixture of forward-KL and reverse-KL surrogate objectives on student-sampled trajectories (per-token surrogates, not sequence-level KL gradient estimators). Six components extend it: (A) COVA, a coverage-adaptive $\beta$ schedule accelerating the forward-to-reverse transition; (B) FTB, a forking-token boost concentrating gradient at high-entropy positions via a globally-normalized entropy reference; (C) CCD, a dense reward adding numerical-proximity partial credit for incorrect-but-close traces; (D) LAP, brevity-preferential correct-rollout reinforcement; (E) EMR, an entropy-matching calibration regularizer; (F) BSD, a bootstrapped self-distillation phase. On GSM8K and MATH-500 (corrected 512-token protocol, 5 seeds, reported std), CADENCE distills a 0.5B student from a 1.5B teacher to 69.8 $\pm$ 0.5% GSM8K pass@1 (from 48.7% pretrained; 63.2% of the teacher gap closed) and to 72.1 $\pm$ 0.4% with a 3B teacher (76.2% closed), beating the strongest matched-compute label-using baseline (DRIFT+binary reward) by +4.4 $\pm$ 0.7 points. All experiments run on a single Apple Mac Studio (M-series, 64GB unified memory), showing principled distillation reaches strong reasoning quality without datacenter-scale hardware.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CADENCE，一个针对推理能力压缩的 on-policy 知识蒸馏统一框架。它诊断出现有方法的三种复合失效模式（冷启动崩溃、状态无关的散度调度、二元奖励稀疏），并通过 DRIFT 机制（per-token 的 forward-KL 与 reverse-KL 代理目标凸混合）及其六个新颖组件（COVA、FTB、CCD、LAP、EMR、BSD）和两个稳定化机制（TFW、KTR）逐一进行针对性修复。在 GSM8K 与 MATH-500 上，使用单台 Apple Mac Studio，将 0.5B 学生模型从 1.5B/3B 教师蒸馏至 69.8%/72.1% 的 GSM8K pass@1，相对最强匹配计算量的标签使用基线提升 +4.4 点。
AI.motivation: 将大语言模型的推理能力蒸馏到小型学生模型以部署于边缘/资源受限设备时，现有 on-policy 蒸馏方法存在三种复合失效：(1) 冷启动崩溃——小模型对教师偏好 token 分配近零概率，反向 KL 下梯度消失；(2) 状态无关的散度调度——固定的时间调度忽略学生覆盖度状态，简单 prompt 与困难 prompt 使用同一调度次优；(3) 二元奖励稀疏——pass/fail 信号丢弃部分正确轨迹的信息，约 49% 的轨迹获得零奖励。作者主张需要有针对性的、对每种失效模式有明确定位的修复，而非单一通用方案。
AI.method: CADENCE 包含：(1) DRIFT——在学生自采样轨迹上做 per-token 的 forward-KL（用自归一化重要性权重）与 reverse-KL 代理目标的凸混合（β 由余弦退火），并附离开一出的方差减基线，作者明确指出这是 per-token 代理而非序列级 KL 梯度估计（Proposition 1、Remark 1）；(2) COVA——基于 top-k 覆盖度测量的覆盖率自适应 β 调度，在覆盖度超出门限时加速由 forward 转 reverse；(3) FTB——以全局归一化熵参考 H_ref=2.0 nats 在高教师熵分叉位置放大优势；(4) CCD——为错误但接近的轨迹提供数值邻近性部分信用，将非零奖励占比从 ~49% 提升至 ~55%；(5) LAP——以生成长度 G_max=192 为参考的简洁性偏好 SFT 项，对正确 rollout 进行加权；(6) EMR——在教师熵超过 η=1.0 nat 的分叉 token 上做学生-教师熵匹配正则化；(7) BSD——主训练后的自举自蒸馏阶段，对一致性 ≥0.8 且正确的轨迹做 SFT；(8) 两个稳定化机制：TFW（20 步教师强制 SFT 预热）与 KTR（每 token log-ratio 的软信赖域，δ=3.0）。所有超参在 GSM8K 训练集的 200 题验证划分上选择，不在测试集上调参。评估使用修正后的 512-token 协议（MATH-500）与 Qwen2.5-Math 匹配的答案抽取。
AI.result: 在 GSM8K 与 MATH-500 上（修正 512-token 协议，5 个种子，μ±σ）：(1) 实验 1（1.5B→0.5B）：CADENCE 达到 69.8±0.5% GSM8K / 47.9±0.5% MATH-500 pass@1，相对预训练基线（48.7%/32.1%）提升 +21.1/+15.8 点，关闭 63.2%/49.1% 教师差距，超过最强匹配基线 DRIFT+binary（65.4±0.5 / 44.5±0.6）+4.4±0.7 / +3.4±0.8 点（>4σ 显著）；(2) 实验 2（3B→0.5B）：72.1±0.4% GSM8K / 50.6±0.5% MATH-500，关闭 76.2%/53.8% 教师差距；(3) 诊断指标：ECE 从 0.164 降至 0.078，Brier 从 0.398 降至 0.241，SAG 从 24.6 降至 11.7，FTA 从 34.8% 升至 58.6%，RLD（<180 token 未截断）从 134 压缩到 108，4-gram Jaccard 稳定在 0.44±0.03（无模式坍缩）；(4) 消融显示组件间存在正向交互（单组件 LOO 之和 18.5 > 全部移除 6.7），CCD 部分信用移除影响最大（-3.5），TFW 次之（-3.2），FTB -2.9，COVA -2.2，BSD -2.0，EMR -1.4（ECE 相对退化 45%），LAP -0.8，KTR -0.6；(5) KLPE 0.62（优于 DRIFT 0.48），KL 路径：反向 KL 峰 ~1.7 后衰减至 ~0.06，前向 KL ~0.24 稳定至 ~0.16；(6) 所有实验在单台 Apple Mac Studio（M 系列，64GB 统一内存）上完成，每个种子 14–22 小时。作者不做 1.5B vs 3B 教师规模扩展性声明（差异在 pooled std 范围内）。
AI.conclusion: CADENCE 通过针对三种诊断失效模式的精确修复、诚实声明的 per-token 代理理论（Proposition 1 / Remark 1）、五个新颖诊断指标（SAG、FTA、KLPE、CNI、RLD）以及完整的统计报告与验证划分超参选择，展示了在不依赖数据中心硬件的前提下完成有原则的小模型蒸馏。研究诚实承认：(i) DRIFT 优化的是 per-token 代理而非序列级 KL 梯度；(ii) CCD 提升幅度仍较温和，方向上需要步级过程奖励；(iii) COVA 是非对称修复，仅处理过度模式覆盖；(iv) 各组件存在正向交互而非独立贡献；(v) FTA 是必要非充分的推理关键位置代理。修正后的 512-token 评估协议使 Qwen2.5-Math 教师性能复现至与公开数值接近。全文呈现的相对比较与结论在协议修正前后保持一致，但作者通过明确的诚实范围声明、修正评估协议与先前草稿的对比，提高了可复现性与理论严谨性。未来方向包括步级过程奖励、代码与逻辑的跨域评估以及 token 级别自适应 β。

title: TurboVec: A Case Study in Cost-Efficient Private Retrieval for Enterprise RAG via Codebook-Oblivious Quantization
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems increasingly power enterprise LLM applications, yet the vector retrieval layer introduces two underexplored challenges: (1) trained codebook quantizers may expose corpus statistics during index construction, creating a leakage channel in multi-tenant deployments, and (2) post-hoc filtering for tenant isolation degrades recall on selective queries. We study TurboVec, an open-source vector index built on TurboQuant - a codebook-oblivious scalar quantizer requiring no corpus-dependent training. On the DBpedia OpenAI embeddings benchmark (d=1536, 100K-999K vectors), TurboQuant 4-bit outperforms trained FAISS Product Quantization at the same memory budget by 8.5-8.9 percentage points in Recall@5 across all scales. Compared to HNSW (R@5=0.991) and IVF-PQ (R@5=0.840), TurboQuant occupies a distinct design point: higher recall than IVF-PQ without training, at 4-8x less memory than HNSW. Deployed on Snowpark Container Services, TurboVec achieves 11ms median query latency at 100K vectors versus 707ms for warehouse brute-force scan. Kernel-level allowlist filtering maintains 0.86-0.93 Recall@10 across 10-1000 tenant workloads versus 0.09-0.19 for post-filter baselines. Codebook-oblivious design reduces membership inference accuracy to near-random (50.0%) versus 57.3% for PQ codebooks. Limitations include single dataset evaluation, uncompressed HNSW comparison, and privacy evaluation on synthetic data only.

AI.tldr: 本文研究TurboVec——一个基于TurboQuant（无码本依赖的标量量化器）的开源向量索引系统，针对企业级RAG中的多租户场景，提出了两个被忽视的挑战：(1) 训练型量化器的码本可能泄露语料统计信息；(2) 后置过滤会降低选择性查询的召回率。实验表明TurboQuant 4-bit在DBpedia OpenAI嵌入基准上比FAISS PQ 4-bit在Recall@5上高出8.5-8.9个百分点，且无需语料训练，同时具备抗码本成员推断攻击的能力。
AI.motivation: 企业级RAG系统日益普及，但向量检索层存在两个未被充分探索的问题：(1) 生产环境中使用的乘积量化（PQ）等方法需要基于语料训练码本，在多租户共享部署中可能泄露语料统计信息，成为潜在的信息泄露通道；(2) 租户隔离通常采用后置过滤策略，对选择性查询造成显著的召回率损失。现有密码学隐私保护ANN方案开销过大（2-4个数量级），无法满足生产吞吐需求，因此需要一种"代码本无感知"（codebook-oblivious）的量化方案作为折中设计点。
AI.method: TurboQuant采用分析推导的标量量化器：(1) L2归一化后分离范数；(2) 乘以固定随机正交矩阵进行旋转，使各坐标近似服从N(0, 1/d)分布；(3) 基于已知的Beta/高斯边际分布用Lloyd-Max算法预计算量化边界（无需数据依赖训练）；(4) 比特打包（如4-bit对应16个桶，1536维向量从6144字节压缩至768字节）；(5) 长度重归一化评分补偿内积低估。TurboVec系统用Rust实现，支持NEON/AVX-512 SIMD加速，内核级多租户过滤以32向量块粒度短路无关块，部署于Snowpark Container Services。隐私威胁模型假设对手为获得码本读取权限的恶意租户，评估基于量化误差的成员推断攻击。
AI.result: 在DBpedia OpenAI嵌入（d=1536，100K-999K向量）上的主要结果：(1) TurboQuant 4-bit在所有规模下Recall@5（0.965-0.968）优于FAISS PQ 4-bit（0.876-0.883）8.5-8.9个百分点，PQ超参数扫描证实非配置伪影；(2) HNSW召回率最高（0.984-0.991）但内存高4-8倍（100K时640MB vs 76.8MB，500K时3.2GB）；(3) IVF-PQ速度最快但召回率最低（0.820-0.840）；(4) TurboQuant 4-bit达到100% Hit@5，对RAG质量影响为良性的；(5) SPCS部署100K向量时中位延迟11ms vs Snowflake原生扫描707ms；(6) 内核级过滤在10-1000租户下Recall@10保持0.86-0.93，后置过滤基线仅为0.09-0.19；(7) 成员推断攻击下TurboVec准确率降至50.0%（接近随机），FAISS PQ为57.3%。成本估算TurboVec 4-bit约248美元/月（10M文档，1000 QPS），显著低于Pinecone（770美元）、Qdrant Cloud（1116美元）等方案。
AI.conclusion: TurboQuant在DBpedia基准上占据独特设计点：无训练、召回率高于IVF-PQ、内存仅为HNSW的1/4-1/8，100% Hit@5表明检索层RAG良性。代码本无感知设计将成员推断攻击信号降至接近随机水平。然而存在重要局限：(1) 仅单一数据集与嵌入模型；(2) HNSW对比使用未压缩FP32；(3) 隐私评估仅覆盖码本攻击且使用合成d=256数据；(4) 假设静态语料，无动态负载评估；(5) 低并发测量；(6) 成本建模为粗略估算；(7) 多租户实验使用均匀合成分区。未来工作包括全栈QA评估、HNSW集成、GPU评估、TQ+校准的形式化差分隐私分析以及跨领域数据集验证。

title: Real-World Evaluation of an AI Agent Drafting Translational Impact Summaries
comment: 15 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to the Journal of Clinical and Translational Science. Code: this https URL
summary: Introduction. Clinical and Translational Science Award (CTSA) programs must document their scholars' research impact, but assembling each scholar's record by hand takes staff an estimated 15 hours and does not scale to a full cohort. An artificial intelligence (AI) agent could serve as a tool to gather scholar data across platforms and disciplines. Methods. We built a human-in-the-loop AI agent that assembles a dossier of sourced evidence for each scholar and drafts one-sentence Translational Science Benefits Model (TSBM) impact summaries for staff review. We evaluated it in the impact-reporting workflow of one CTSA hub across 10 career-development (KL2/K12) scholars. Two evaluation staff independently coded all 507 findings as accept, edit, or reject; the primary measure was the unanimous usable rate, defined as the share both accepted or edited. Results. Both reviewers accepted or edited 81.7% of the agent's findings. Reviewers each spent a median of 14 minutes per scholar, replacing an estimated 15 hours of manual assembly. Inter-rater agreement was moderate (Cohen's kappa 0.43 on the usable-versus-reject decision). A profile discovery study found the agent's recall close to human search. The agent's impact evidence spanned all four TSBM domains, and about a third of the reviewed findings fell in non-scholarly categories that routine processes tend to miss. Reviewers rated synthesis accuracy 4.5 and usefulness 4.8 on a 5-point scale. Conclusions. A human-in-the-loop AI agent can serve as the first-pass author of a scholar's impact record, shifting staff from collecting and writing to reviewing, and making cohort-scale impact reporting feasible.

AI.tldr: 本文构建并真实评估了一款人机协作AI智能体，该智能体能为CTSA（临床与转化科学奖）KL2/K12学者自动汇编有据可查的影响证据档案，并起草基于转化科学收益模型（TSBM）的一句话影响摘要。在一家CTSA中心的真实工作流中，对10位学者的507条发现进行双盲审查，结果一致可用率达81.7%，审核时间从人工预估的15小时降至中位数14分钟/学者。
AI.motivation: CTSA项目需为每位KL2/K12学者汇编完整的研究影响记录，但人工汇编每位约需15小时且无法扩展到整个 cohort；现有研究信息系统仅覆盖封闭式来源（出版物、资助记录），无法触达临床项目领导、社区参与、成本/采纳数据、政策采纳等非学术类影响证据；此外，对AI系统在真实工作流中的评估极为稀缺（计算语言学论文中仅约0.1%为真实部署评估）。
AI.method: （1）智能体设计：基于"学者种子"（姓名、机构、已有资助记录），采用OpenAI gpt-5.1（规划/起草）与gpt-5.4-mini（网页蒸馏/摘要）双模型架构，通过research run循环（gather-assemble-critique，最多3轮，每轮最多25次工具调用）查询OpenAlex、PubMed、ORCID、ClinicalTrials.gov、NIH RePORTER及开放网络，汇编证据档案并起草一句话TSBM影响摘要；通过register-revise阶段（最多3轮）将摘要对齐76条人工撰写的基准语句风格；采用spotlighting防御缓解间接提示注入。（2）评估：包含两个子研究——①档案发现研究：对比智能体与"仅人工""AI辅助人工"在两个非重叠5人子集中的档案检索召回率；②审查研究：两位评估人员独立对507条发现进行接受/编辑/拒绝编码，主要指标为一致可用率。
AI.result: （1）一致可用率81.7%（414/507），75%发现被两位审查者无修改接受；分节可用率从职业轨迹96.7%到社区影响64.9%、政策影响65.0%；审查者人均14分钟/学者（范围8.5–25分钟）；合成准确性4.5/5，有用性4.8/5，全部10份档案均愿意使用。（2）不可用93条原因主要为：来源非权威性（33）、空来源（8）、断裂链接（4）、未达影响门槛（22）、归因错误（16）、分类错误（8）。（3）审查者间一致性中等（Cohen's kappa 0.43，三向编码0.35）。（4）档案发现召回率：对比人工搜索0.82 vs 智能体0.82；对比AI辅助搜索0.85 vs 智能体0.76（差距主要源于智能体无法查询Google Scholar档案）。（5）影响证据覆盖全部四个TSBM领域，约1/3发现属于常规流程易遗漏的非学术类别。
AI.conclusion: 人机协作AI智能体可作为学者影响记录的"首稿作者"，将工作人员角色从收集与撰写转变为审查，使 cohort 规模的影响报告成为可行方案；评估方法本身亦为重要贡献——在工作流关心的结果上度量系统表现；未来工作包括多站点评估、提升经济与政策领域覆盖、接入专利数据库与政策引用索引（如Overton）以填补检索缺口。

title: Counterfactual Shapley Credit Assignment
summary: The Credit Assignment Problem (CAP) is fundamental to developing efficient and explainable Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents. Existing frameworks, whether relying on temporal contiguity or hindsight-conditioned reward reweighting, frequently fail to attribute properly between an agent's policy (skill) and environmental stochasticity (luck). A principled approach to CAP must isolate the true causal drivers of observed outcomes from spurious correlations and environmental randomness. We introduce Counterfactual Shapley Credit Assignment, a novel framework grounded in causal theory that attributes credit and blame via the Counterfactual Shapley Value ($\phi$-value). By redistributing environmental rewards, $\phi$-values enhance temporal credit assignment across three critical dimensions: sparse causality, high stochasticity, and delayed rewards, all while preserving the optimal policy. We derive a consistent estimator that computes $\phi$-values efficiently, enabling a new class of policy gradient methods, $\phi$-PPO, combined with Prioritized Trajectory Replay (PTR). Empirical results demonstrate that $\phi$-values align precisely to the ground truth causes of task rewards with superior sample efficiency in challenging environments where prior state-of-the-art methods fail to converge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"反事实Shapley信用分配"框架，将信用分配问题从因果推断角度重新形式化，通过计算每个动作的因果贡献（φ值）来重新分配奖励，并据此构建φ-MDP和φ-PPO算法，在稀疏因果性、高随机性和延迟奖励三个维度上显著提升样本效率。
AI.motivation: 强化学习中的信用分配问题（CAP）长期受困于无法有效区分智能体策略的"技能"与环境随机性的"运气"。现有方法（时序贴现、事后重加权等）要么依赖虚假的时间邻近性假设，要么混淆技能与运气，导致信用分配存在偏差且样本效率低下。本文认为理想的信用分配必须建立在因果推理之上，应通过反事实推理分离真实因果驱动因素与虚假相关。
AI.method: 1）将MDP形式化为结构因果模型（MDP-SCM），定义反事实自然总效应（NTE）作为因果贡献度量；2）利用反事实Shapley值（φ值）将总效应分配到各动作，证明其满足因果可纳性、因果效力、因果正态性和因果效应缩放四个公理；3）构造φ-MDP（以φ值作为每步奖励的等价MDP），证明其保持原MDP的最优策略（梯度等价与最优策略等价定理）；4）推导一致性φ值估计器：核公式实现O(1)摊销时间复杂度，最优提议分布Q*避免均匀采样的指数方差，λ自举实现偏差-方差权衡；5）集成至PPO提出φ-PPO算法，配套先验轨迹回放（PTR）以因果重要性而非TD误差为优先级采样。
AI.result: 在SkillLuck基准测试中，φ-PPO在高噪声（σ=3）条件下显著优于PPO、REINFORCE及8种现有信用分配方法（HCA、CCA、CoCoA、QCA、RUDDER、Synthetic Returns、H-DICE等）；在组合锁（Combinatorial Lock）测试中，φ-PPO+PTR是唯一能扩展至T>10的方法，而所有基线在T≥15时崩溃；DoorKey任务展示了φ值能正确传播跨子目标链的信用（如取钥匙动作与五步后的开门动作获得可比信用）；Fork MDP消融验证了三种方差缩减机制各自的贡献。理论上：稀疏因果带来k'/T倍方差缩减；高随机性带来(1-ρ_Y)倍缩减；延迟奖励将信用传播从O(T)步缩短至O(1)步。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了基于因果理论的信用分配原则性框架，φ值被证明是唯一同时满足全部五条期望性质（可纳性、效力、正态性、缩放、效率性）的方法。φ-MDP作为原MDP的可替换等价物，为策略梯度方法提供了更清晰的因果学习信号。然而该方法依赖可重置的模拟器进行反事实模拟，且样本复杂度σ²/(1-γ)²在γ接近1时较大。未来工作包括：有限样本Bernstein界、放松反事实独立性假设、扩展至Atari/MuJoCo等大规模基准。

title: Scalable Causal Imitation Learning
summary: Imitation learning enables learning a policy in an unknown environment with a latent reward signal using expert demonstrations, but it struggles when the imitator's and expert's observations are mismatched and unobserved confounders are present in expert demonstrations. By identifying appropriate adjustment sets via the sequential $\pi$-backdoor criterion, causal imitation learning (CIL) provides a framework for approximating the expert's policy from confounded data. However, existing CIL methods, Causal Behavioral Cloning (Causal BC) and Causal Generative Adversarial Imitation Learning (Causal GAIL), are designed for short-horizon, low-dimensional settings. When applied to continuous control tasks with long horizons and high-dimensional state-action spaces, these methods exhibit poor performance: Causal BC suffers from compounding errors, Causal GAIL is unstable and sample-inefficient, and sequential $\pi$-backdoor adjustment becomes impractical. We introduce Causal Soft Q Imitation Learning (SQIL) and Causal Inverse soft-Q Learning (IQ-Learn), two off-policy causal imitation learning algorithms that combine the causal adjustment framework with state-of-the-art inverse reinforcement learning objectives. Both algorithms operate on causally-adjusted state representations produced by an efficient approximation of the sequential $\pi$-backdoor criterion, exploiting the causal structure of continuous control environments to reduce the full-horizon adjustment to a fixed-size sliding window. We evaluate all methods in a suite of confounded environments and find that Causal SQIL and Causal IQ-Learn substantially outperform prior CIL algorithms on long-horizon tasks, sometimes surpassing the expert, whereas all causally unaware imitation methods fail to learn meaningful behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出可扩展的因果模仿学习方法（Causal SQIL 和 Causal IQ-Learn），结合顺序π-后门准则与软Q学习目标，并通过窗口化近似将因果调整从完整时间范围缩减为固定大小的滑动窗口，实现在高维长视野存在未观测混淆因子时的有效模仿学习。
AI.motivation: 现有模仿学习方法假设模仿者与专家具有相同的观测能力（无未观测混淆因子假设，NUC），但实际部署中常因专家拥有额外传感器或上下文而引入未观测混淆。现有因果模仿学习（CIL）方法（Causal BC 和 Causal GAIL）仅适用于短视野、低维场景，在长视野连续控制任务中存在性能退化、训练不稳定和调整集计算不可行等问题。
AI.method: 1. 提出 Causal SQIL 和 Causal IQ-Learn 两种离线因果模仿学习算法，将因果调整框架与软Q学习目标结合，操作于通过顺序π-后门准则的因果调整状态表示上；2. 设计滑动窗口近似算法（Algorithm 1），利用 k-有界时间影响和时间齐次性假设，将完整视野的因果调整缩减为固定大小窗口 O(k)，而非 O(H)；3. 构建基于 OGBench 的混淆控制环境（Confounded AntMaze 和 Confounded HumanoidMaze），通过 SCM 建模潜在混淆因子和部分可观测性；4. 对 8 种算法（4 种因果 + 4 种非因果）在 4 个任务上进行对比实验和消融研究。
AI.result: 在混淆连续控制环境中：(1) 所有非因果方法（BC、GAIL、SQIL、IQ-Learn）成功率接近 0%；(2) Causal BC 在 AntMaze-Medium 达到 88.9% 归一化性能，但在 AntMaze-Large 降至 71.2%，在 HumanoidMaze-Medium 降至 30.8%；(3) Causal GAIL 在 HumanoidMaze-Medium 崩溃至 0%；(4) Causal SQIL 和 Causal IQ-Learn 在长视野任务中显著优于现有 CIL 方法，平均达到专家约 90% 的成功率，有时超越专家；(5) 窗口大小 k∈[1,10] 表现最佳，k=0 和 k=100 性能显著下降；(6) 混淆强度扫描表明非因果方法随强度增加单调退化，而因果方法性能稳定；(7) 完整视野因果调整计算在 H=2000 时需 4.1 小时，而窗口化近似仅需几秒。
AI.conclusion: 因果调整对于稳健策略学习必不可少，而离线Q学习对于可扩展性必不可少；两者相互正交，可组合使用（Causal SQIL 和 Causal IQ-Learn 即为这种组合）。该方法算法无关，可与未来基于软Q学习的模仿学习算法结合，并可扩展到扩散策略、动作分块 Transformer 等表达性策略类，以及像素级高维输入和不同传感器配置的应用场景（远程操作、仿真到真实迁移、多智能体模仿）。主要局限包括：需要先验因果图知识、对长范围潜在依赖假设有界时间影响、不利用奖励结构先验、对专家最优性的敏感性。

title: WHALE: A Scalable Unified Model for Recommendation with Wukong-HSTU Architecture
summary: As scalability becomes increasingly important in recommendation modeling, recent architectures have advanced the modeling of two broad sources of ranking signals along separate paths: non-sequence features, including user, item, context, and cross features; and sequence features from user behavior histories. Wukong and HSTU have emerged as representative scalable backbones for these paths: Wukong scales high-order non-sequence feature-interaction modeling, while HSTU scales long user-behavior sequence modeling. Despite their complementary strengths, practical architectures that combine these two types of feature modeling remain underexplored. We present WHALE, a scalable unified recommendation architecture that jointly models non-sequence and sequence features on top of Wukong and HSTU. Each WHALE layer contains a Wukong module, an HSTU module, and an attention-based fusion module in which Wukong-derived interaction representations query HSTU-derived behavior representations. This design keeps both backbones active throughout the network and enables progressive Wukong-HSTU exchange, allowing high-order feature crosses to repeatedly retrieve fine-grained evidence from long user histories. To make WHALE practical for industrial deployment, we introduce customized Triton kernels and other model-systems co-design techniques to improve training and inference efficiency. On large-scale industrial recommendation data, WHALE achieves consistent gains in offline experiments. Additionally, it delivers positive online gains with a modest serving-throughput trade-off. The method has been deployed in production systems. Overall, WHALE provides a practical example of how these two sources of information can be scalably unified in an industrial recommendation model.

AI.tldr: WHALE 是一个面向工业级推荐系统的可扩展统一架构,在每一层中将 Wukong(高阶非序列特征交互)与 HSTU(长行为序列建模)结合,通过注意力融合模块实现跨分支渐进式交换,在 Meta 短视频推荐场景中已上线并带来显著在线收益。
AI.motivation: 现有工业推荐架构主要沿两条独立路径扩展:以 Wukong 为代表的高阶非序列特征交互建模,以及以 HSTU 为代表的长用户行为序列建模。两类信号互补但缺乏有效的联合建模方式。常见的浅层混合(shallow-hybrid)方案先用序列模型压缩行为历史,再送入特征交互模型,导致历史被压缩为固定摘要后,高阶交叉无法按需、细粒度地从行为历史中检索证据,限制了跨分支的渐进式交互,也难以兼顾请求级 user-history 计算复用与大规模工业部署的吞吐/时延约束。
AI.method: WHALE 采用由输入层和堆叠 WHALE 层组成的递归架构。输入层将用户/物品类别特征、数值特征和用户行为序列映射为统一维度 D 的嵌入。每个 WHALE 层包含三个模块:(1) Wukong 模块,通过 FMB+LCB 递归结构在非序列特征上构建高阶交互表示 H_w;(2) HSTU 模块,通过带相对注意偏置(rab)的序列转导对长度为 L 的行为历史建模,得到序列感知表示 H_s;(3) 基于注意力的融合模块,用 Wukong 输出的 H_w 作为 query、HSUT 输出的 H_s 作为 key/value 进行跨分支交叉注意力,再经 Fusion MLP 投影、SwiGLU FFN 残差细化,生成同时包含高阶交互与序列信息的融合表示,并作为下一层非序列分支输入;序列分支则直接将 H_s 传给下一层 HSTU 模块,从而在每一层都保持两分支活跃并渐进式交换信息。系统层面使用自定义 Triton 融合注意力核(共享 KV、Q-parallel 与 KV-parallel 反向变体)、shared-gate SwiGLU FFN(将 gate 与 up 投影合并)、BF16 混合精度、torch.compile/AOTInductor 编译优化、shape hint 张量消除 CPU-GPU 同步等模型-系统协同设计,以提升训练和推理吞吐。
AI.result: 在 80B 训练样本 / 4B 评估样本的工业级短视频推荐离线实验中,WHALE 在 8/14/32 GFLOPs 三档复杂度下均优于 Wukong-only 与 HSTU-only 基线(以 8 GFLOPs Wukong-only 为参考,NE 持续提升)。缩放分析显示,序列长度(3k→15k)、模型深度(2→8 层)、模型宽度(64→512)三个维度均带来持续的 NE 增益。消融实验中,浅层混合融合带来 0.25% NE 退化,平均池化替代注意力退化 0.23%,去掉融合 MLP 和 SwiGLU FFN 分别退化 0.11% 和 0.08%,验证了渐进式跨层融合与注意力机制的关键作用。系统优化方面,训练 QPS 提升 30%,推理 QPS 提升 22%。14 天在线 A/B 测试显示,主指标提升 0.113%,Metric 1 提升 0.824%,Metric 2 提升 1.820%,仅带来 5% 的推理吞吐下降,可接受,已部署于生产系统。
AI.conclusion: WHALE 表明,在工业推荐系统中,将 Wukong 式非序列特征交互与 HSTU 式长序列建模在每一层通过注意力融合进行渐进式统一,比单独扩大任一骨干都更有效,且能在严格的服务时延与吞吐约束下落地。论文给出了一种实用设计范式:下一阶段工业推荐系统的扩展,不仅来自单骨干的纵向放大,也来自在同一架构内逐层统一互补的序列与非序列建模路径,从而获得更细粒度的跨信号协同。

title: Where Does Agent Reliability Come From? A Cross-Benchmark Decomposition of Verification Loops, Specialist Models, and Scaffolding in a Production Enterprise Agent
comment: 19 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Evaluations conducted March-April 2026. Run-level evaluation record and audit scripts: this https URL
summary: Multi-step enterprise agent tasks fail in a characteristic way: single-pass inference has no checkpoint between deciding an answer and committing to it. We study one production system (Leni) whose architecture installs such checkpoints: verification loops (execute, observe, compare, correct) staffed by lightweight task-specialized post-trained models. We evaluate the unmodified production configuration on three public benchmarks stressing distinct failure modes: SpreadsheetBench Verified (silent computation error), BullshitBench v2 (premise confabulation), and the GAIA validation split (cascade error over long tool chains). The full system improves over its frontier base model by +11.0 percentage points on SpreadsheetBench (91.25% vs 80.25%, n=400, p<0.001), +7 to +10 percentage points on BullshitBench (98% vs 91%, n=100), and roughly +15 points on GAIA validation (75.2% pass@1, n=165; 83.0% best-of-k). Our central contribution is a decomposition of that uplift: most of it comes from scaffolding, routing, and specialist models rather than from the verification step itself, whose isolated contribution is small (+1.5 points) but concentrated at the top of the score distribution, where it converts otherwise-failing tasks. We instrument the loop end-to-end, yielding an empirical verifier confusion matrix (catch rate about 0.20, fix rate 0.75, no false-alarm regressions) that grounds a compounding-reliability model. Specialist-swap ablations suggest that the loop's value depends on who observes it: replacing the small trained verifier with the generating frontier model eliminates most rescues. A valid-premise control shows zero over-rejections in 100 expert-level questions.

AI.tldr: 该论文对一个生产型企业AI智能体系统Leni进行跨基准评估与归因分析,通过在三个公开基准(SpreadsheetBench Verified、BullshitBench v2、GAIA validation)上对比完整系统与裸基础模型,系统性地分解"架构带来的可靠性提升"中各组成部分的贡献。核心发现是:大部分可靠性提升(+11.0pp/+7-10pp/+15pp)来自脚手架、路由与专家模型,而非验证步骤本身;验证环节的独立贡献虽小(+1.5pp),但在分数分布顶端具有决定性意义;且验证效果强烈依赖于"观察者是谁"——由独立的小型专家模型执行验证优于由生成模型自检。
AI.motivation: 企业级LLM智能体在多步任务中常以"流畅且自信的错误"方式失败(如静默计算错误、前提虚构、长工具链级联错误),此类错误在金融、合同等后台场景中会传播并造成实质损失。现有讨论常寄希望于更强的基座模型,本文则探究另一杠杆:模型周围的架构层——具体为"验证循环"(执行、观察、比较、纠正)加上为各阶段定制的轻量级后训练专家模型。作者试图回答的核心问题是:在生产系统中,可观测的可靠性提升究竟来自脚手架、专家模型,还是验证步骤本身?
AI.method: 研究对象为Leni(生产级AI商业分析师),采用"执行-观察-比较-纠正"四阶段验证循环,以三类验证预言机实例化三种任务场景:(1)确定性预言机——LibreOffice无头重算+独立反序列化路径,搭配Leni-Cell-S(~4B)做单元比较,用于SpreadsheetBench;(2)自反思预言机——认知防火墙,Leni-Triage-S(~4B)将问题分解为断言并发出硬性接受/拒绝,用于BullshitBench;(3)规划器中介预言机——规划器-执行器分离,Leni-Parse-S(~1.5B)做类型化抽取,Leni-Route-XS(~0.5B)做按步路由,用于GAIA。评估采用三个针对不同失效模式的公开基准,且均使用未修改的生产配置;报告Wilson 95%置信区间与双比例z检验。同时进行:(a)逐层消融分解总提升;(b)专家替换消融(将小型验证器换回生成前沿模型);(c)端到端仪器化获取验证器混淆矩阵;(d)有效前提对照组(DRACO 100题)以校准认知防火墙的过度拒绝率;(e)对GAIA验证集进行检索审计以应对答案公开问题。
AI.result: 总提升显著但来源明确分层:SpreadsheetBench从80.25%提升至91.25%(+11.0pp, p<0.001, n=400);BullshitBench在Sonnet配置+7pp、在Opus配置+10pp(n=100);GAIA validation pass@1为75.2%,best-of-k达83.0%(n=165)。归因分解显示:SpreadsheetBench中脚手架+提示占+9.5pp,确定性验证循环仅占+1.5pp(挽回6个任务,但这6个任务恰是位列顶端的关键)。验证器混淆矩阵显示捕获率c≈0.20、修复率r≈0.75、误报率f≈0(无观察到的虚假警报)。专家替换消融表明:把验证观察者换回生成前沿模型后,SpreadsheetBench挽救数从6降至2,BullshitBench正确拒绝率下降4-5pp,印证"独立性比存在性更重要"。DRACO有效前提对照组显示零过度拒绝,将防火墙假阳性率上界约束在≲3.6%。GAIA基线提升约+15pp但分层消融尚未干净分离。
AI.conclusion: 对于固定基座模型的生产部署,可观测的可靠性提升主要来自架构而非模型本身,其成分可分三层:结构(脚手架、规划、路由、类型化接口)贡献最大;轻量级独立专家承担观察/比较阶段是验证循环有效的前提,且以0.02–0.1×的前沿成本运行使"每步验证"成为可行的默认;验证检查点本身的独立贡献小,但集中在分数分布顶端,因此在可靠性SLA尾端或排行榜顶端是必要的。验证循环的有效性以"观察者的独立性与专业化"为前提,生成模型自评因自我偏好而失效——计算更多不等于可靠性更高,关键在于是否强迫模型审视问题框架而非在错误框架内构造答案。文章给出的可执行排序是:先投入结构,再为观察阶段配备独立小模型,最后给循环接入任务允许的最强预言机;并通过仪器化验证循环本身获取混淆矩阵来指导下一步投入方向。

title: Solver-Hard Is Not Model-Hard: A Hardness-Controlled Diagnostic for LLM Constraint Reasoning
comment: 13 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. Code and aggregate reproduction data: this https URL
summary: LLM constraint reasoners are often evaluated near the random-SAT phase transition, confounding density and solver hardness. We test instance-level transfer while near-matching clause density. At aligned size bins, with near-matched density and matched maximum clause width, we compare proof-hard expander-Tseitin and proof-easy ladder-Tseitin formulas, pigeonhole anchors, and density-mismatched controls. Theory separates their resolution hardness; a solver-specific Glucose mean-conflict proxy differs by up to $51\times$, and five other solvers preserve the direction. Across three included models (243 instances each; a fourth is excluded for abstention), the near-matched-density accuracy gaps range from $-32$ to $+20$ points, with a pooled gap of $+1.7$ points ($p=0.74$) and a wrong-signed correctness-versus-conflict association ($r=+0.15$). A proof-preserving relabeling lowers accuracy in all five clusters for one model (mean $-93$ points) but not another, exposing model-surface sensitivity. In a preregistered extension, provider-reported completion-token spend does not consistently increase with the proxy after accounting for formula length and censoring. At 16k, the reasoning model spends more on proof-easy matched formulas and exhausts its budget on the solver-easiest UNSAT family; the 32k C1 gap is absent. These scoped dissociations concern verdict accuracy and observed token spend, not certificate solving, exact proof length, or allocation efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个"硬度受控诊断"框架，将子句密度（clause density）与证明复杂度（proof complexity）解耦，测试 SAT 求解器的硬度排序能否迁移到 LLM 的判断准确率上。结果发现：Glucose 求解器在 expander-Tseitin 与 ladder-Tseitin 之间产生高达 51× 的冲突比，但在三个 LLM 上准确率差距从 -32 到 +20 点不等（汇总仅 +1.7 点，p=0.74），且正确性与冲突数呈"反向错误"的正相关（r=+0.15），结论是"solver-hard ≠ model-hard"。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 约束推理评估多在随机 SAT 相变点附近进行，导致子句密度 α=m/n（表面可读线索）与求解器搜索代价严重共变，无法区分模型失败究竟由密度还是由结构硬度驱动。本文旨在设计一个在密度近似匹配、宽度匹配的前提下，仅干预图结构（从而干预已知分辨率硬度排序）的对照实验，检验经典求解器的硬度排序是否能预测 LLM 表现。
AI.method: 构建三组对照：(C1) 3-正则 expander 图上的 Tseitin 公式（指数分辨率硬度）vs. ladder 图上的 Tseitin 公式（树宽 2，多项式证明），共享最大子句宽度 3 与近似密度；(C2) 低密度 expander (α≈2.67) vs. 高密度随机 UNSAT (α≈6) 以检验密度是否反预测；(C3) 鸽巢原理公式作为第二个指数硬度锚点。以 Glucose 4.2 平均冲突数作为求解器侧代理变量（6 个求解器验证，1470 个标签全部一致）。在 3 个自回归 LLM（Llama 3.3 70B、Llama 4 Maverick、Mistral Large 3 675B）上各测试 243 个实例，以零温度一次性裁决准确率为端点。此外执行"证明保持的重标记"控制（双射重命名变量、置换子句与文字，仅改变序列化表面）以及预先注册的完成 token 数花费扩展。
AI.result: 求解器侧：expander/ladder 冲突比从 12 变量的 3.3× 单调增长至 60 变量的 51.4×，6 个求解器全部保持方向一致。模型侧：(1) C1 准确率差距 Llama 3.3 +20 点（p=.015）、Llama 4 -32 点（p<.001）、Mistral 3 +17 点（p=.060），汇总 +1.7 点（p=0.74），无一模型同时满足预注册的门限条件；(2) 密度最高的随机 UNSAT 反而被所有模型答得最差，与求解器侧排序相反；(3) UNSAT 行正确性与 log₁₀(conflict) 呈错误符号的正相关（汇总 r=+0.15）；(4) 鸽巢原理重标记使 Llama 3.3 在全部 5 个簇下降 67-100 点（均值 -93），但 Llama 4 仅 1 个簇变化，暴露模型特异的表面敏感性；(5) 16k token 预算下推理模型在 proof-easy ladder 上花费更多（8,385 vs. 9,998 tokens），且所有 28 个非弃答的随机 UNSAT 行触顶 16,384 上限。
AI.conclusion: 在受控解离条件下，经典求解器硬度排序（Glucose 冲突比达 51×）不能预测 LLM 裁决准确率或测试时 token 花费。结论的边界：仅涉及裁决准确率与观测 token 花费，不涉及证书验证、精确证明长度或分配效率；且结论限定于 12-30 变量的 LLM 可处理尺度以及全自回归架构样本。方法论启示：经典硬度是"实例-求解器"对的属性，在将其作为模型难度度量前必须先在受控解离下证明迁移性。

title: Auto Research for Materials: Auditable AI-Scientist Workflows with Held-Out Transfer
summary: An AI research agent can improve the score it sees without finding a modelling change that works on new materials. We ask a stricter question. After repeated experiments, does the selected change survive on data that never entered the loop, and can its code be reused? We separate the search into changes to features, models, representations, and training data. Seven searches produce 701 evaluated changes across ten Matbench endpoints. Agents receive only the mean over five inner folds, reducing reliance on any single development split. We then freeze the selected code and evaluate it once on an untouched holdout. Nine of ten choices remain the best tested single intervention. The surviving changes reveal two materials modelling regimes. With composition alone, feature, model, and representation changes provide comparable routes to improvement. They include held-out MAE reductions of 17.4\% for band gap and 18.6\% for steel strength, as well as gains on both classification endpoints, while screened external data adds little. For structure tasks, richer geometry descriptors and model or calibration changes lower mean held-out MAE by 14.6\% and 7.1\% and lead on different property families, whereas composition embeddings do not transfer. Combining separately found feature and model changes yields a 26.3\% mean held-out improvement. These results show in materials prediction that closed-loop agents can produce decisions that survive unseen evidence and code changes that can be reused across tasks and combined. More broadly, they provide an evaluation design for testing executable discoveries beyond the feedback loop.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"Auto Research"框架,通过四类干预(特征、模型、表示、数据)分离搜索,在十个Matbench任务上完成701次评估,验证了闭环AI科学家在未接触的保留集(held-out)上的决策可迁移性与代码可复用性。
AI.motivation: 闭环AI研究代理可能仅在反馈循环内提升分数,而所选改进未必能迁移到新数据,或代码难以复用。需要在"评估设计"层面解决两个问题:① 区分改进来自特征、模型、表示还是数据;② 防止对单一开发集过拟合,从而判断所选代码改动是否在循环外依然有效。
AI.method: 将材料预测流水线划分为四类干预(特征/模型/表示/数据),每类独立搜索。代理(DeepSeek-v4-pro)接收Matbench fold-0训练集内部五折交叉验证均值作为搜索信号,以减轻对单一划分的依赖。搜索完成后冻结代码,仅在未接触的fold-0测试集上进行一次评估(selection transfer)。组合实验在主分析之后进行,仅用于测试可复用性而不计入主统计。涉及4个组成任务(MAE与ROC-AUC)与6个结构任务(MAE),基线为Magpie描述符+CatBoost,部分结构任务加入轻量结构信息。
AI.result: 十个端点中,九个搜索选择保留为保留集最佳单一干预(仅matbench_jdft2d失败)。组成任务支持多路径改进:带隙MAE降低17.4%,钢强度MAE降低18.6%,金属性与玻璃形成能力AUC均有提升,经筛选的外部数据贡献甚微。结构任务中,更丰富的几何描述符与模型/校准改动分别在不同性质族上领先(平均held-out MAE分别降低14.6%与7.1%),而组成嵌入无法迁移。组合独立发现的特征与模型代码获得26.3%平均保留集改进。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明:① 闭环代理在材料预测中能产出在未见证据上存活的可执行决策;② 不同输入模态(组成vs结构)对应不同的有效干预类型;③ 独立发现的代码可跨任务复用并组合形成更强的预测器。方法论贡献在于提出了一种评估闭环AI科学发现的通用设计原则——评估对象应是冻结的可执行改动,而非代理活动量或循环内最高分。

title: Teach it to stop, not just to click
comment: 15 pages, 3 figures. Reliability protocol and library (cua_reliability), completion verifier, and leakage-free held-out plus bootstrap evaluation harness are open-source
summary: Agentic computer-use RL is reported in single runs, and those numbers mislead. Using verifier-guided repair of a 35B computer-use agent (CUA) across five oracle-graded environments, we show a repaired policy's success rate is dominated by upstream variance: a variance-components decomposition across three cells (crossed data-draw $\times$ seed grid, bootstrap CIs) finds evaluation variance negligible ($\sigma_{\mathrm{eval}} \approx 0$) and the training-seed effect small everywhere ($\leq 10\%$); instead it splits between the data draw and run-to-run nondeterminism, the data draw's share rising to dominant ($48\%$) on the hardest cell. There the run-to-run distribution is bimodal (Hartigan dip $p=0.07$, $k=10$), so a single run has roughly a 30% chance of the failure mode and mean$\pm$std is the wrong summary. On that footing, two findings hold. First, repairability is two-tier in how constrained the corrective action is: a single fixed token installs reliably (done-detection $0.97\pm0.06$), while open-ended corrections are only partial -- spatial-coordinate clicks (grounding $0.53\pm0.35$) and a generative field-fill ($0.14\pm0.04$). Second, the frame-level repair transfers to task success only when the corrective action is the task's sole remaining blocker (LinkedIn 8/20 vs. base 0/15, Fisher $p=0.006$). We caught two of our own over-claims -- a sample-efficiency curve and a 'grounding cannot be bought' boundary -- only by replicating across seeds; a stress test makes the stakes external: a single-run improvement of the size this field publishes would have the wrong sign roughly one-third of the time in a comparable regime. We release a library (cua_reliability) for routine k-seed reporting. The apparatus is, to our knowledge, the first multimodal segment-aggregated on-policy self-distillation (SA-OPSD) update on a real 35B CUA policy.

AI.tldr: 本文针对智能体计算机使用强化学习（CUA-RL）领域普遍采用单次运行报告结果导致误导的问题，提出了一种基于方差分量分解的可靠性方法学。通过对一个35B计算机使用代理（Holo3-35B-A3B）进行验证器引导的修复（verifier-guided repair），研究跨越五个oracle评分环境，揭示评估方差几乎为零（σ_eval ≈ 0）、训练种子影响小（≤10%），但数据抽取在最难任务上占主导方差（48%），且运行间分布呈双峰性。作者提出了一种"难度梯度"现象：固定令牌（如done()）的修复高度可靠（0.97±0.06），而开放式校正（空间坐标点击0.53±0.35，生成式字段填充0.14±0.04）则只能部分修复。同时通过自主反驳两项自身过度声称，论证k种子报告协议的必要性，并发布了开源库cua_reliability。
AI.motivation: 智能体计算机使用强化学习（CUA-RL）领域的结果普遍以单次运行的形式报告，但这种做法存在严重误导性。研究者发现，在35B规模的视觉-语言模型（Holo3-35B-A3B）上进行修复时，单次运行的成功率主要受上游方差影响——即数据抽取和运行间不确定性，而非评估方差或训练种子。研究者希望通过方差分量分解的方法，定量揭示这种被忽视的方差来源，并通过自身过度声称的反驳来论证k种子报告协议的必要性，从而为该领域建立可靠的实验规范。
AI.method: 1. **验证器引导修复框架**：使用一个独立VLM（Claude Sonnet 4-6）作为完成验证器（completion verifier），该验证器作为共享基座扮演四种角色——上下文提示、蒸馏教师、强化学习奖励、推理门控。2. **SA-OPSD更新方法**（Segment-Aggregated On-Policy Self-Distillation）：结合GRPO策略项（利用分组相对优势A_i降低错误动作权重）和优势门控行为克隆项（σ(-A_i/τ)·BC(a^teacher)安装验证器的校正动作），是首个在真实35B CUA策略上运行的多模态在线策略自蒸馏更新。3. **方差分量分解**：采用Henderson交叉ANOVA，在D=3独立数据抽取 × k=8训练种子的交叉网格上分解方差来源（评估、训练种子、数据抽取、残差）。4. **形式化双峰性检验**：使用Hartigan dip test检测运行间分布的双峰性。5. **oracle评分环境**：使用确定性、可快照重置的网络镜像环境（LinkedIn、Indeed、Fiverr、Mercor、Shopify），通过数据库状态和审计日志（不读取轨迹）进行程序化评分。6. **泄漏防护的留出评估**：使用独立的留出轨迹（decision frames only），避免训练帧评估带来的伪复制问题。
AI.result: **主要结果可归纳为四项发现：**1. **可靠性方法学（§6）**：方差分量分解显示评估方差≈0、训练种子效应≤10%（在所有任务单元上），但数据抽取的方差占比随任务难度上升，在最难任务单元（Indeed空间定位）上达到48%（σ_data=0.26，dominating）。Hartigan dip test显示该单元的运行分布呈双峰性（p=0.07, k=10），单次运行有约30%概率落入失败模式（≈0.09），因此均值±标准差是错误的统计摘要。2. **难度梯度（§5，表3）**：在留出独立轨迹上，修复难度按校正动作的"约束性"排序——离散固定令牌done()的安装率0.97±0.06（CI [0.95, 0.99]）；空间坐标点击的字段定位0.71±0.26、空间定位0.53±0.35（CI [0.44, 0.63]，一种子在0.00）；生成式字段填充仅0.14±0.04（CI [0.08, 0.19]）。所有四个CI都排除了基线率。该梯度在第二个架构不同的策略（Fara-7B）上得到复现：固定令牌1.00±0.00，坐标点击0.81±0.14。3. **端到端传递边界（§5，表5）**：仅当校正动作是任务的唯一剩余瓶颈时，帧级修复才能转化为任务成功。LinkedIn上修复策略完成8/20（基线0/15，Fisher精确p=0.006），而Fiverr（基线此处不会过度执行）和Shopify（单字段填充只是多步提交的一部分）则不传递。4. **自主反驳（§6）**：两项先前的强烈声称在多种子复制中被推翻——单种子样本效率曲线（0.47→0.82）和"空间定位无法通过权重学习获得"的边界（基于0/14单种子）。这些过度声称揭示了k种子报告的必要性。术语归因（表4）显示，在done-detection任务上，仅蒸馏项即可安装done()（1.00±0.00），而仅奖励项无法实现（0.00±0.00），证明蒸馏项是主动成分。
AI.conclusion: 本文的核心教训是方法论层面的：智能体计算机使用RL的结果被评估上游的方差所主导——更多是由训练数据本身决定，其次才是种子——而在最难的任务上，这种方差呈双峰分布，使得均值和标准差都产生误导。通过基于验证器引导的修复测试平台，研究者将这一点具体化，并两次推翻了自己的单次运行声称。同样的实验规范支撑了两项经得起检验的发现：可修复性按校正动作的约束程度分级（固定令牌可靠，开放式校正部分且不可靠），而帧级修复仅当该动作是策略与完成之间的最后障碍时才能端到端传递。对于实践启示：稳定智能体RL数字，应首先控制数据抽取、其次控制种子、对其余方差在k次运行上取平均——永远不要相信单次运行。最终发布了开源协议和库cua_reliability，使k种子报告成为常规操作。

title: DADIR: Density-Aware Data-level Imbalanced Regression Framework
summary: Imbalanced learning addresses predictive modeling problems with underrepresented regions of the data distribution. Although widely studied in classification, imbalanced regression remains challenging because of continuous target variables and heterogeneous density distributions. Existing data-level methods often rely on fixed target partitioning or synthetic sample generation without jointly considering density variations and local feature-space structure. We propose DADIR, a Density-Aware Data-level Imbalanced Regression framework that exploits density information throughout the balancing process. DADIR comprises three components: (1) Density-Aware Adaptive Partitioning (DAAP), which recursively partitions the target space according to density variations; (2) a Density-Regularized Conditional Variational Autoencoder (DR-CVAE), which preserves sparse-region representations while learning latent features; and (3) latent-space data balancing, which combines feature-level clustering with oversampling to generate structurally consistent synthetic samples. Together, these components identify minority regions more effectively, preserve sparse-region information, and generate realistic synthetic data. The resulting balanced dataset can be used directly with existing regression models without modifying their architecture or learning objective. Experiments on diverse imbalanced regression datasets demonstrate consistent improvements in predictive performance, particularly in underrepresented regions, while also improving overall accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DADIR（Density-Aware Data-level Imbalanced Regression Framework），一种面向不平衡回归问题的数据级预处理框架。该框架由三个核心阶段组成：基于密度自适应分区（DAAP）、密度正则化条件变分自编码器（DR-CVAE）和潜在空间数据平衡，可直接与现有回归模型配合使用，无需修改其架构。
AI.motivation: 不平衡回归问题中，由于目标变量为连续型，传统分类方法无法直接应用；现有数据级方法多依赖固定分箱或在原始特征空间生成合成样本，难以同时兼顾目标空间密度变化与特征空间局部结构，导致少数类区域识别不准、合成样本分布失真，难以有效提升稀疏区域的预测性能。
AI.method: 1) DAAP：利用核密度估计（KDE）在密度谷值处递归划分目标空间，生成与密度结构一致的自适应分箱；2) DR-CVAE：以连续目标为条件的条件变分自编码器，采用逆密度加权（w_i=1/p̂(y_i)）强调低密度区域样本的重建，并辅以目标预测损失；3) 潜在空间平衡：在 DR-CVAE 学到的潜空间内对每个分箱进行 HDBSCAN 聚类，按大小渐进式平衡各簇，利用 KDE 在簇内采样潜变量并通过近邻插值生成目标值，从而生成结构一致、与局部几何兼容的合成样本。
AI.result: 在 16 个公开数据集上与 MLP、XGBoost、LR、KNN、SVR、Ridge 六种回归器及 SMOTER、WSMOTER、SMOGN、LDS、FDS、FOCAL-R、IRDA 七种 SOTA 不平衡回归方法对比：DADIR 在所有回归器与多数数据集上一致降低 MAE/RMSE 并提升 R²，对线性模型提升尤为显著（如 wine_quality、airfoild 的 R² 提升超 200%），且在少数类区域（样本量小于 0.5×(N/B) 的等宽分箱）性能优于基线；消融实验表明 DR-CVAE 贡献最大（MAE 退化 655.64%，RMSE 退化 563.46%），DAAP 与潜在空间平衡亦不可或缺；与目标偏度的 Spearman 相关性不显著（ρ 在 -0.14 至 -0.29），表明框架对不同偏度分布均稳健；平均训练开销约 107%，但具备可预测性。
AI.conclusion: DADIR 通过将密度感知贯穿于目标分区、表示学习与潜空间合成的全过程，为不平衡回归提供了一种与模型无关、即插即用的数据级解决方案；其核心贡献在于联合利用目标密度结构与特征空间几何，有效改善稀疏目标区域的预测性能。未来工作可拓展至大规模可扩展密度估计、更强生成机制以及高维/流式回归场景。

title: Talaria: Session-Aware Serverless Serving of Hundred-Billion-Parameter LLMs
summary: Serverless multi-model LLM systems multiplex popularity-skewed model catalogs over shared GPU pools, yet typically schedule each request independently. Tool-using agents break this abstraction: a session repeatedly calls an LLM across short tool gaps, carries a long reusable KV prefix, and is judged by session completion time (SCT). Load-only routing can separate a continuation from both its model and KV state, while round-based model multiplexing can delay even a correctly placed continuation until the target model's next slot. Both failures are especially costly for hundred-billion-parameter models: their weights constrain residency, while long-context KV is expensive to reconstruct or move. We present Talaria, a session-aware serverless multi-model serving system that makes session continuity a joint placement-and-admission decision. Its router ranks placements by model residency, KV locality, and instance pressure, while soft reservations account for likely returns in the last serving instance's admission budget. Session-prefill (SP) admits budget-eligible continuations before the active model slot closes. An instance-local substrate keeps HBM addresses stable, preserves host-restorable KV, and stages weights across model switches. On a single TP=8 server, we replay 30 SWE-Bench model-sessions (960 calls) over three models, each with more than 100B total parameters. Against an otherwise identical round scheduler with SP, host-KV restoration, and D2D staging disabled, Talaria cuts p50 SCT from 1000 s to 189 s and p95 from 2296 s to 867 s, speedups of 5.3x and 2.6x.

AI.tldr: Talaria 是一个面向智能体工作负载的无服务器多模型 LLM 推理系统，通过将"会话连续性"作为联合的放置与准入决策单元，解决百亿参数模型在共享 GPU 池上多路复用时所面临的空间错配（路由到错误实例）与时间错配（等待下一轮调度槽）问题，在单台 TP=8 服务器上将 p50/p95 会话完成时间分别加速 5.3×/2.6×。
AI.motivation: 在 serverless 多模型 LLM 服务中，传统的请求级调度忽略了智能体（agent）会话的两个关键特性：(1) 空间错配：负载均衡路由器可能将会话的延续请求路由到既无目标权重也无会话 KV 状态的实例，导致长上下文前缀的昂贵重建；(2) 时间错配：基于轮次的模型多路复用器即使正确放置了延续请求，也会因目标模型的当前槽位已关闭而被迫等待下一轮。这两个问题在百亿参数模型上尤为严重，因为权重大小限制了驻留能力，长上下文 KV 重建或迁移开销极大。作者通过对 445 个 SWE-Bench Verified 会话（7,386 次调用）的实证分析发现，会话中位深度为 11 次调用，工具调用间隔中位仅 0.39 s，而 Qwen3-235B/TP=8 上重算一个中位长度前缀需 4.3 s，且 96.8% 的延续请求复用了超过半数的前缀 token——这些特性构成了一个"连续性窗口"。
AI.method: Talaria 采用控制面-数据面分离架构，包含三大核心机制：(1) **会话感知驻留路由（Router）**：路由器在工具调用期间为目标实例安装软预留（soft reservation，τ=1 s），基于潜在返回概率占用准入预算；非预留请求按模型驻留成本、KV 恢复成本、模型激活成本的加权公式 Cost(r,i)=ΔR̂^req + Ĉ^KV + Ĉ^act 进行候选实例排序。(2) **冷池调度器与会话预填充（SP）**：冷池实例采用非 P/D 解耦的轮次调度，每个模型槽结构为 P→D₁→(SP→D)*→D_fin，在 decode 间隙开放 SP 窗口，对预算兼容的会话延续请求进行批量准入，复用 device-resident 或 host-restorable 的 KV。(3) **多模型内存基底**：包括 bump-allocator 管理的稳定 HBM 布局（保留 CUDA graph 与运行时对象指针）、跨模型切换保留会话前缀的 HKVR（Host KV Registry，带 TP rank 一致性校验），以及机会主义的 D2D 权重预暂存（利用 KV 层块的高地址尾部空闲区），将切换开销从 H2D 卸载到异步的 D2D。系统基于 SGLang 实现，网关约 5.5K 行 Go，引擎扩展约 15K 行。
AI.result: 在单台 TP=8 服务器上，使用 30 个 SWE-Bench 模型会话（960 次调用）跨 Qwen3-235B、GLM5-nvfp4、Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 三个 100B+ 模型的固定重放实验：相对 Round-only 基线，p50 SCT 从 1000 s 降至 189 s（5.3×加速），p95 SCT 从 2296 s 降至 867 s（2.6×加速），30 个会话中 29 个得到改善。消融实验显示 SP 提供最大 p50 边际贡献（SCT 从 623 s→189 s），HKVR 降低 TTFT p95 从 26.33 s 至 14.17 s，D2D 暂存使聚合切换时间减少 38%、p50 逻辑切换延迟降低 34%。在双 worker TP=4 路由实验中，相对于 least-pressure 路由，高负载下可避免的模型冷启动从 37 次降至 1 次，TTFT p95 从 8.07 s 降至 5.28 s；中负载 SCT p95 从 19.59 s 降至 12.74 s。内存使用峰值 177.1 GiB，低于 183 GiB 设备上限。软预留超时参数 τ=1 s 是返回局部性与模型驻留命中率之间的最佳折中点。
AI.conclusion: Talaria 证明了在 serverless 多模型 LLM 服务中，会话连续性（session continuity）应当成为独立的调度抽象，与请求级或模型级调度正交。通过在路由层引入软预留、在实例调度层引入会话预填充（SP），并在底层通过稳定的 HBM 布局、可恢复的 KV 注册表与 D2D 权重暂存来支撑切换韧性，系统能够将工具调用间隙这种亚秒级连续性窗口转化为可观测的 SCT 加速。路由器与令牌执行路径的清晰隔离使得集群级放置与实例级执行契约能够协同设计。作者指出未来工作方向包括：扩展到更大规模的集群评估、工作负载自适应的预留与主机缓存策略、远程 KV 集成、动态热-冷池重分配，以及向 P/D 解耦架构推广准入契约。

title: Auditing Question-Order Effects in Large Language Models with the QQ Equality: Mechanism Characterization and a Saturation Caveat
summary: Human survey respondents exhibit question-order effects that satisfy the QQ (quantum question) equality, an a priori, parameter-free prediction of the projective quantum question-order model. We develop the QQ equality into an audit criterion for sequential judgments of autoregressive large language models (LLMs). Theoretically, we characterize which mechanism classes satisfy it robustly: marginal-independent kernels satisfy QQ iff all four mismatch transition rates coincide (a class containing the 2D rank-1 projective model with a fixed measurement pair under state variation); a polarity- and position-dependent repetition family is characterized by an exact cross-symmetry condition with closed-form violations; QQ-satisfying behaviors are closed under order-matched mixing; and the rank-2 Contextuality-by-Default criterion translates into audit coordinates as $|\qQQ|\le\OSS$, where $\OSS$ (the order-sensitivity score) totals the order sensitivity of the two marginals. Methodologically, we develop a pre-specified, audit-logged pipeline applicable to any model exposing next-token log-probabilities; it combines worst-case robustness envelopes, sampling-consistency spot checks, full label counterbalancing, and a saturation diagnostic. Empirically, in a first-signal pilot on an open-weight instruction-tuned model under two framings, all pre-specified health gates passed, yet 17/18 and 7/8 item pairs, respectively, were saturated (near-deterministic), and no item was certified residually contextual. Forced-binary next-token log-probabilities were thus inadequate for distribution-level QQ audits under the tested model and prompting conditions; we recommend pre-specified saturation diagnostics whenever next-token distributions are treated as survey-response distributions.

AI.tldr: 本文将人类调查研究中发现的QQ（量子问题）等式发展为大语言模型（LLM）顺序判断的审计准则。理论上刻画了满足QQ等式的机制类别，并将秩-2 Contextuality-by-Default（CbD）准则转化为审计坐标下的不等式 |q_QQ| ≤ OSS。方法上提出了一个预指定的、可审计日志记录的流水线。在Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507上的先导实验中，所有预指定的健康门控均通过，但17/18和7/8项目对呈现饱和（近确定性）状态，无法支持分布级别的QQ审计——揭示了一个关键的测量警示。
AI.motivation: 人类受访者表现出满足QQ等式的问题顺序效应，而LLM越来越多地被用作人类受访者的代理。一个自然的审计问题是：自回归LLM的顺序判断行为是否满足人类群体所满足的同一非参数约束？但在LLM上测试此约束并非人类协议的简单转录，因为它涉及一个测量假设——将模型的下一个词元概率分布视为合成受访者的响应分布。
AI.method: 1. **机制表征**：将机制形式化为从项目参数到顺序响应核的映射，刻画了两类机制族（边际独立核与混合-重复族）的稳健QQ满足条件（定理3、命题4、命题5），证明了顺序匹配混合下的封闭性（命题7），并将秩-2 CbD准则转化为 |q_QQ| ≤ OSS（推论6）。2. **审计方法论**：开发了预指定的、可审计日志记录的流水线，包括二元条件审计估计量、标签反平衡、最坏情况鲁棒性包络、采样一致性检验和饱和度诊断。3. **经验先导实验**：在Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507上以两种框架（直接评估和调查受访者人格）进行了18个项目对的先导实验。
AI.result: 所有预指定的健康门控均通过（其他质量~10⁻⁷，采样一致性检验通过）。然而，在Track M下17/18个项目对饱和，在Track P下7/8个项目对饱和。饱和分布出现在0.95、0.975和0.99阈值下均成立（分别为18/18、18/18、17/18）。无项目被认证为残余上下文性（Γ_lower > 0）：Track M下16个被认证为非上下文性，2个不确定；Track P下5个被认证为非上下文性，3个不确定。标签分配对测量有实质影响（per-item q_QQ差异高达1.48，OSS差异高达1.52）。QQ违反主要来自确定性顺序翻转，许多违反发生在边界 |q_QQ| ≈ OSS处。先导实验的结论是：在测试的模型和提示条件下，强制二元的下一个词元对数概率不足以暴露QQ审计所需的分布结构。
AI.conclusion: 本文将QQ等式发展为审计标准，强调QQ满足兼容于多种机制类别（如经典对称重复），违反兼容于允许直接影响的非上下文耦合——不能唯一识别生成机制。先导实验的核心发现是：预指定的饱和度诊断应作为将LLM下一个词元分布视为调查响应分布的任何研究的标准健康检查。未来工作应测试此测量警示是否在更广泛的模型家族和替代测量设计中持续存在，同时在使用基于混合的方法恢复离散度时保留组件级诊断。

title: Specifying the Delegated-Autonomy Boundary: Requirements Engineering for Agentic AI
summary: Agentic AI systems do not just predict or recommend; they plan, maintain state, and act in external environments with varying degrees of autonomy. This changes the requirements engineering problem in a specific and under-addressed way: it introduces what we call the delegated-autonomy boundary -- the set of decisions about what may be delegated to the system, under what graduated authority, with what oversight, and how control is returned. Current practices bury these decisions inside prompts, tool schemas, and runtime policies, even though they are requirements-level commitments. This paper proposes two complementary artifacts. First, an Agency Justification Record (AJR) helps teams decide when an agent is warranted over simpler alternatives. Second, an Agentic Delegation Policy (ADP) captures what must be specified for safe and effective development: purpose, authority, information, coordination, assurance, and evolution. Crucially, authority in the ADP is modelled as graduated, i.e., a tiered structure. We illustrate the framework with two contrasting examples: a safety-critical hospital discharge coordination agent and an automated code review agent.

AI.tldr: 本文针对Agentic AI系统提出"委托自主性边界"（delegated-autonomy boundary）这一新的需求工程问题，并提出两个互补的规约工件：AJR（Agency Justification Record）用于判断何时适合采用智能体架构，ADP（Agentic Delegation Policy）用于规约委托自主性的具体内容（包含目的、权力、信息与记忆、协作、保证与演化六大维度），其中权限按自主/建议/禁止三级分层建模。
AI.motivation: 当前Agentic AI系统的需求工程实践存在两类失败模式：（1）"未经正当化的智能体化"（unjustified agency），即在确定性工作流或提示模型即可胜任的场景中过度采用智能体架构；（2）"规约不足的智能体化"（under-specified agency），即智能体的权限范围、记忆边界、协作规则、升级条件与成功标准隐式埋藏在提示词、工具模式或编排脚本中，损害了系统的可审计性与合规性。同时，业界广泛披露的Agent缺乏安全评估与第三方测试，进一步凸显了将委托决策提升为一类正式需求工程的紧迫性。
AI.method: 方法上，作者将"委托自主性边界"形式化为需求工程的一类核心对象，并基于与两位资深从业者（企业Agent系统领域与医疗领域）的咨询结果，设计两类结构化工件：（1）AJR采用六项决策准则（任务开放性、非结构化上下文、跨系统操作、可评估进度、有限风险、相对基线优势）外加反准则，作为架构选型前的尽职审查门控；（2）ADP采用六大维度（Purpose、Authority、Information & Memory、Coordination、Assurance、Evolution），其中Authority采用三层分级模型（Autonomous / Advisory / Prohibited），并以医院出院协调多智能体系统（安全关键、HIPAA合规场景）与自动化代码审查智能体（低风险开发工具场景）两个对比实例贯穿说明。论文还提出四项研究议程：分级委托的形式化记法、需求到运行时的编译、需求驱动的评估测试，以及人机代理与问责机制。
AI.result: 主要贡献包括：（1）将"委托自主性边界"确立为Agentic AI需求工程的一类新的形式化问题，区别于既有自适应系统、目标建模与AI需求工作；（2）AJR通过六项准则外加可证伪的优势阈值要求，使"何时使用智能体"的决策成为可审查的需求级承诺（代码审查示例因C1–C3与C6不满足而被拒绝，避免了不必要的智能体化）；（3）ADP提供了一个可分布式落地于提示、模式、策略引擎与监控器的结构化规约模板，分级权限模型与"最小充分规约"原则实现风险敏感的内容裁剪；（4）以安全关键的医疗场景与低风险的开发工具场景进行对比性实例化，展示了ADP在权力分层、记忆治理、协作升级、保证监控与演化治理方面的具体规约内容。
AI.conclusion: 作者主张Agentic AI在本质上是"人类向其委托有界、分级自主性的软件"，委托边界是当前需求工程实践中缺失的核心对象，应使委托决策显式化、可审查化、可测试化。AJR与ADP作为词汇与工件基础，使该挑战可处理，并应被业界与学术界在真实智能体系统上进行经验验证、改进与扩展。论文承认利益相关方目标、可用性、伦理与合规等仍是正交且必要的关注，ADP被定义为对传统SRS的补充而非替代，专注于自主性、记忆与协作维度的规约。

title: A RFID Based Campus Wide Payment System
summary: This work titled "RFID Based Campuswide Payment System" introduces an innovative cashless payment solution for educational institutions. It uses RFID cards and a Raspberry Pi to enable hassle free payments for various campus services, such as cafeteria purchases, tuition fees, and library fines. A centralized database ensures real-time updates on transactions and account balances, accessible through a simple and user-friendly web interface. This work is involved in designing a secure system with object-oriented principles, setting up databases, and integrating hardware like RFID readers with a Raspberry Pi. The systems are proved to be a cost-effective and efficient alternative to traditional payment methods, enhancing convenience and security for students and administrators. The study also explored similar RFID applications, like smart parking and attendance systems, to identify challenges and improvements. Looking ahead, it envisions features like wearable RFID devices, voice-activated payments, and blockchain integration to boost security and usability. Results show that this system simplifies campus payments and has the potential for broader adoption in similar environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于RFID技术的校园无现金支付系统，利用RFID卡和Raspberry Pi实现校园内各类服务（如食堂消费、学费缴纳、图书馆罚款）的便捷支付，并通过集中式数据库和Web界面提供实时交易和账户余额管理。
AI.motivation: 传统校园现金支付方式存在效率低、不便捷、安全风险高（现金丢失/被盗）以及管理复杂等问题，亟需一种安全、高效、便捷的数字化支付替代方案。
AI.method: 系统采用面向对象设计原则，集成RFID读卡器、Raspberry Pi作为低成本后端服务器，以及MySQL等集中式数据库。设计涵盖系统架构、组件（RFID卡/读卡器/后端）、数据库表结构（学生表、管理员表、交易表、充值历史表）、数据流图（DFD）和实体关系图（ER）。实施流程包括需求识别、硬件选型、基础设施建设、系统测试、用户培训和部署。
AI.result: 系统成功实现了实时交易处理、动态Web界面（学生查询交易记录、管理员管理账户）、以及基于Raspberry Pi的低成本部署。验证了其在学生支付管理、用户体验和成本效益方面的可行性，同时识别出RFID卡依赖性、可扩展性以及本地化生产等局限性。
AI.conclusion: 该RFID校园支付系统是一种现代化、高效、安全的无现金支付解决方案，能显著提升校园财务管理的便捷性和透明度。未来工作可聚焦于移动应用支持、生物识别安全增强、系统可扩展性优化，以及可穿戴RFID设备、语音激活支付和区块链集成等前瞻性功能。

title: A Large-Scale Measurement of AI Bill of Materials Completeness in Hugging Face Models
summary: Pretrained machine learning (ML) models help developers build ML-intensive software systems without training models from scratch. However, model repositories often provide incomplete machine-readable documentation about model provenance, licenses, datasets, limitations, and external references, creating transparency and governance gaps across the AI supply chain. Artificial Intelligence Bills of Materials (AIBOMs) address these gaps by documenting AI artifacts, including models, metadata, licenses, datasets, model-card information, and external references. Taking public Hugging Face (HF) model repositories as a case study, this paper empirically investigates AIBOM completeness, defined as the extent to which repositories provide AIBOM-relevant information for machine-readable AI supply-chain documentation. We examine approximately 97.5K AIBOM artifacts to assess the extent to which generated AIBOMs: (i) contain required structural and metadata fields, (ii) represent model identity, license, and external-reference information, (iii) capture model-card documentation such as datasets, limitations, safety-risk assessment, and environmental information, and (iv) vary in documentation coverage across repository and artifact characteristics such as task, license availability, dataset declaration, model family, and paper reference. Results indicate that generated AIBOMs provide complete coverage of required AIBOM structure but limited AI-specific documentation completeness. Required fields are fully represented, but model-card, metadata, responsible-use, environmental, limitation, and meaningful-description fields remain weakly represented or missing across generated artifacts. Our findings motivate improved model-card practices, repository-level traceability, and automated AIBOM validation to advance the generation and adoption of more complete AIBOMs.

AI.tldr: 本文对Hugging Face平台上约97,940个AI模型生成的AI物料清单（AIBOM）进行了大规模实证分析，发现生成的AIBOM在CycloneDX结构层面完整度较高（均值54.31/100），但AI特有的透明度字段（如模型卡文档、限制说明、安全风险评估、环境信息和负责任使用说明等）普遍缺失或弱表示，表明当前HF模型仓库在AI供应链透明度方面存在显著差距。
AI.motivation: 随着预训练机器学习模型在下游软件系统中的广泛复用，AI供应链透明度与治理问题日益突出。AI物料清单（AIBOM）作为记录模型来源、许可证、数据集、限制和外部引用的机器可读文档，理论上可填补透明度空白。然而，现有研究对AIBOM在大规模实际场景中的字段级完整性（completeness）缺乏系统评估，制约了AI供应链治理与可追溯性的推进。
AI.method: 1. 通过HF Hub API收集2,942,466条公开模型元数据快照，筛选下载量超过100的97,940个模型用于AIBOM生成；2. 使用OWASP GenAI Security Project AIBOM Generator为每个模型生成基于CycloneDX JSON格式的AIBOM；3. 依据生成器内置的五类完整性评分（必需字段、元数据、组件基本信息、模型卡文档、外部引用，各类别加权计算满分100）提取总分与分类分；4. 解析97,940个AIBOM工件以统计各字段的存在率，并结合任务、许可证、数据集声明、论文引用、模型家族等仓库特征进行分层审计分析；5. 使用Pearson相关分析类别分与总分的关联性。
AI.result: 1. **整体完整性**：97,940个AIBOM均值54.31/100，中位数54.10，标准差4.44，范围46.60–68.70，全部处于"中等"等级；2. **类别差异显著**：必需字段100%、组件基本信息81.75%、外部引用68.02%、元数据40.00%、模型卡文档仅19.51%；3. **类别相关性**：模型卡文档与总分相关性最强（r=0.888），外部引用次之（r=0.662），元数据几乎无相关（r=0.003）；4. **字段级关键缺失**：ethicalConsiderations、intendedUse、modelExplainability、informationAboutTraining、informationAboutApplication、metric、useSensitivePersonalInformation等均为0.00%；safetyRiskAssessment仅9.76%，technicalLimitations仅16.74%；环境信息几乎缺失（energyConsumption仅19个工件）；描述字段虽99.99%存在但仅0.22%为实质性内容；5. **仓库特征差异**：同时具备论文引用与数据集声明的模型可追溯性显著更高（VCS覆盖99.59% vs 55.04%，技术限制49.04% vs 7.16%）；高分AIBOM主要来自Llama、Gemma、Qwen、Granite、Phi等知名LLM家族的GGUF格式变体。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，当前HF模型仓库虽可批量生成结构合法的AIBOM，但AI特有的透明度信息严重不足，模型卡实践、仓库级可追溯性和自动化AIBOM验证亟待加强。研究呼吁：①模型发布者将文档视为模型工件的一部分，提供结构化的训练数据、限制、安全风险和环境信息；②下游用户不应仅凭AIBOM存在就假设其完整性，需检查字段级和分类级完整性；③AIBOM工具开发者应区分语法完整性与语义实质性，提供可操作的诊断；④未来工作将分析字段存在之外的语义质量评估，包括描述、限制、预期用途和安全风险评估的实质性内容。

title: Distilled Reinforcement Learning for LLM Post-training
summary: Large language model (LLM) post-training is essential for improving reasoning, adaptation, and alignment. Existing methods mainly follow two paradigms: reinforcement learning (RL) and on-policy distillation (OPD). However, RL relies on coarse-grained outcome supervision, resulting in difficult credit assignment and limited capability to acquire new knowledge. OPD, meanwhile, unconditionally matches teacher logits through KL divergence, which creates a dilemma: similar teachers provide little new knowledge, while substantially different teachers often yield ineffective guidance, largely restricting OPD to within-family distillation. We propose Distilled Reinforcement Learning (Distilled RL), which integrates teacher supervision into the RL objective to provide fine-grained guidance, selectively transfer new knowledge and avoid unconditional imitation. Distilled RL contains three components: reverse importance sampling with clipping, negative sample reset, and sequence-level geometric normalization. Through a concise and interpretable case study, we demonstrate that Distilled RL can effectively transfer previously unavailable knowledge from a teacher model to a student model. Extensive experiments across both within-family and cross-family distillation settings show that Distilled RL substantially outperforms standard RL and OPD in terms of both pass@1 and pass@k. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出Distilled RL（蒸馏强化学习），一种将教师监督融入强化学习目标的LLM后训练框架，通过逆向重要性采样、负样本重置和序列级几何归一化三个组件，实现选择性细粒度知识迁移，在同家族和跨家族蒸馏场景下均显著优于RL和OPD。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM后训练主要存在两种范式的局限：(1) 强化学习（RL）依赖粗粒度的结果监督，存在严重的信用分配困难，且难以获取学生策略中不存在的新知识；(2) 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）通过KL散度无条件模仿教师logits，面临两难困境——相似教师提供的新知识有限，差异过大的教师则产生无效指导，导致OPD主要局限于同家族蒸馏。作者通过实验观察发现：OPD收敛快但后续提升有限甚至下降；增大rollout组规模对OPD增益有限；简单混合OPD与RL也无法避免性能衰退。
AI.method: Distilled RL将教师监督直接集成进RL目标函数，核心包含三个组件：(1) 逆向重要性采样——计算教师策略与旧学生策略之间的token级重要性比ρ_{i,t}，并将其裁剪至[1/ε_ρ, ε_ρ]区间以防止梯度不稳定放大；(2) 负样本重置——仅对优势A_i>0的正样本应用教师重加权，对负样本将权重重置为1，避免在错误轨迹上对教师偏好的错误模仿；(3) 序列级几何归一化——用几何均值归一化裁剪后的token级比率，使乘积等于1，消除师生似然间的系统性尺度差异，同时保留教师对token的相对偏好。整体目标函数采用类似GRPO的clip式策略优化形式，用归一化的教师重要性权重w_{i,t}重新分配token级别的RL学习信号。
AI.result: 在DSQW-1.5B（跨家族）、Qwen3-4B（同家族）和Qwen3-1.7B三个学生模型上，使用Qwen3-8B-GRPO作为教师，在10个数学推理基准上的pass@1平均分分别达到40.00、58.96和46.37，超越OPD、RL及OPD+RL基线。训练动态显示Distilled RL保持更高的奖励、更稳定适中的策略熵和稳定的响应长度，Pass@1持续提升。消融实验表明负样本重置贡献最大（去除后平均分下降6.39-8.81点），序列级几何归一化也带来稳定增益。熵控制案例研究证明Distilled RL能有效迁移教师分布中标准RL无法获取的信息（如目标熵特性）。在MMLU-Pro和SuperGPQA等知识密集型基准上也展现出良好的泛化能力，未过拟合于数学推理。
AI.conclusion: Distilled RL提供了一种统一的后训练范式，通过将教师偏好选择性融入RL梯度而非作为独立的无条件模仿损失，有效结合了强化学习的奖励驱动优化和教师模型的细粒度指导。该方法在跨家族蒸馏场景中优势尤为突出，突破了传统OPD对师生兼容性的依赖，为未来LLM后训练中融合强化学习与知识蒸馏提供了简洁有效的方案。局限在于假设教师在学生能正确解决的问题上始终具备足够能力，未来可通过教师rollout、置信度门控等方式进一步缓解。

title: Debate-on-Graph: Reliable and Adaptive Reasoning of Large Language Model on Uncertain Knowledge Graph
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in natural language processing. However, LLMs often suffer from hallucinations and lack of relevant knowledge when dealing with question answering (QA) tasks. To mitigate these issues, knowledge graphs (KGs) have been utilized to enhance LLM reasoning. Nevertheless, KGs often contain noise and errors, while existing KG-enhanced LLM approaches are generally unable to identify and filter such noisy and erroneous content, which can instead amplify hallucinations and pose challenges for reliable reasoning. Uncertain knowledge graphs (UKGs), which associate each triple with a confidence score to quantify uncertainty, offer a promising direction to address this challenge. Compared with prior work, we investigate how to leverage UKGs to support LLMs for QA. We propose Debate-on-Graph (DoG), a new framework that enables LLMs and UKGs to collaborate adaptively for reliable reasoning. Specifically, we first design a heuristic search algorithm tailored for UKGs to extract reliable and question-relevant subgraphs, thereby reducing noise and errors in retrieved knowledge. We then introduce a Multi-Agent Debate mechanism, which yields reliable answers through adaptive adversarial debates, aiming to fully exploit the knowledge in UKGs while preserving the reliability of retrieved evidence. Extensive experiments on four benchmark QA datasets show that DoG achieves state-of-the-art performance over existing LLM reasoning methods and KG-based baselines, while enabling reliable and adaptive reasoning. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Debate-on-Graph (DoG) 框架，针对不确定知识图谱（UKG）上的问答任务，通过启发式子图提取算法与多智能体辩论（MAD）机制，实现 LLM 与 UKG 的自适应可靠协作推理。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 在问答任务中存在幻觉和知识缺失问题，知识图谱（KG）虽可缓解，但 KG 中普遍存在噪声与错误。现有 KG 增强 LLM 方法（检索式和智能体式）均无法有效识别和过滤噪声，反而可能放大幻觉。不确定知识图谱（UKG）为每条三元组附加置信度分数，为可靠推理提供了新方向，但如何平衡知识利用度与检索可靠性是关键挑战。
AI.method: DoG 框架包含两大核心组件：（1）**启发式子图提取算法**：基于最佳优先搜索，以主题实体为中心，利用路径评分函数 Score(p,Q) = SR(p,Q)·Conf(p)^α（结合语义相关性与路径置信度）和实体距离作为优先级，通过扩展宽度 W 和动态评分阈值进行剪枝，提取与问题相关且可靠的知识子图，并保留每个实体的 Top-K 推理路径；（2）**多智能体辩论机制（MAD）**：设计四个角色——Proponent（可访问子图）、Challenger（仅依赖内部知识）、Decision-Making Agent（决策是否扩展子图或终止辩论）、Judge Agent（综合辩论结果输出最终答案）。关键设计是**信息不对称设置**，使 Challenger 无法访问检索内容，避免 LLM 对错误检索事实的盲目趋同；同时通过自适应调整 K 值实现动态证据范围扩展。
AI.result: 在四个基准数据集（CSQA、CSQA 2.0、OBQA、MedQA）上使用 Qwen3-8B 和 GPT-4o-mini 进行实验，DoG 均取得 SOTA 性能：在 MedQA 上分别超越次优方法 10.3% 和 7.2%。消融实验证实 MAD 机制和信息不对称设置的必要性；自适应推理分析表明 DoG 能根据问题难度动态选择 K 值与辩论轮次；超参数分析显示 α=1.0 和 W=3 为最优配置；效率方面，DoG 在运行时间上显著优于 ToG（14.87s vs 51.89s）。
AI.conclusion: DoG 是首个针对 UKGQA 任务系统性地探索利用不确定知识图谱增强 LLM 推理的工作，通过启发式搜索与多智能体辩论的协同，有效平衡了知识利用度与证据可靠性，实现了自适应、可靠的问答推理，为未来 KG 增强 LLM 推理研究提供了新范式，但仍存在缺乏专用 UKGQA 基准和计算开销中等等局限。

title: AIGB-R1: Self-Evolving Generative Auto-Bidding via Hierarchical Planner-Executor Optimization
summary: Auto-bidding plays an essential role in online advertising, automatically adjusting bids for advertisers to optimize their commercial goals. The emerging AI-Generated Bidding (AIGB) paradigm widely adopts generative modeling to optimize bidding strategies, yet suffers from the limited mode coverage of offline datasets and inadequate task-state understanding, hindering effective exploration of optimal strategies. Large Language Models (LLMs), with prior world knowledge and reasoning capabilities, offer a promising approach to overcome these limitations. However, directly applying LLMs to auto-bidding tasks faces inherent challenges in limited numerical precision, hallucinations, and inference latency. To address these limitations, we propose AIGB-R1, a hierarchical self-evolving auto-bidding framework aiming to enhance AI-Generated Bidding via LLMs' Reasoning capabilities, comprising a high-level Planner module for macro-level strategy planning and a low-level Executor module for fine-grained decision-making. Building upon this, we design an experience-driven self-evolving loop, enabling autonomous strategy exploration and optimization from accumulated experience. We adopt a two-stage pipeline of offline pre-training and post-training alignment, and build an interactive bidding simulation environment for strategy rollout. Furthermore, we propose Decoupled Group Relative Policy Optimization (D-GRPO) to achieve end-to-end optimization via advantage decoupling. Experimental results on a large-scale public dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of AIGB-R1.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AIGB-R1，一种用于在线广告自动出价的分层自进化框架，通过高层Planner（LLM）进行宏观策略规划、低层Executor（PDT）进行细粒度出价决策，并设计基于经验驱动的自进化循环和D-GRPO算法实现端到端优化，在大规模公开数据集上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有AI-Generated Bidding（AIGB）方法依赖离线数据集生成式建模，受限于模式覆盖不足和任务状态理解不充分，难以有效探索最优策略；直接应用LLM进行自动出价又面临数值精度有限、幻觉和推理延迟等固有挑战。需要一种能融合LLM推理能力同时规避其局限性的分层框架，实现经验的自主积累与策略的自进化优化。
AI.method: 1. 分层Planner-Executor架构：高层Planner使用Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct LLM基于广告主上下文信息和历史经验推理生成M个结构化策略提示；低层Executor使用Prompt Decision Transformer（PDT），将策略提示作为条件前缀嵌入输入序列，自回归生成每步出价参数（采用对数正态分布建模随机策略）。2. 两阶段训练：预训练阶段用LLM标注的离线数据集训练Executor拟合数据分布；后训练阶段构建交互式竞价仿真环境AuctionNetEnv进行策略rollout。3. 经验驱动的自进化循环：为每个任务维护经验缓冲（含最佳策略锚点和滑动记忆窗口），实现任务特定的经验积累。4. Decoupled GRPO（D-GRPO）：通过层次化rollout产生M×K奖励矩阵，将奖励偏差正交分解为组间分量（反映Planner策略选择质量）和组内分量（反映Executor执行质量），分别为两层构建解耦的优势信号，实现层间信用分配和端到端优化。
AI.result: 在AuctionNet和AuctionNet-sparse两个大规模公开数据集上，AIGB-R1在Score指标上均取得最佳性能（385和39.0），优于所有基线方法（包括USCB、CQL、IQL、BCQ、DT、DiffBid、CBD、GAS、GAVE、PRO-Bid、GRAD和LBM）；在不同预算比例（50%-150%）的泛化实验中同样表现最佳。在线竞价仿真环境AuctionNetEnv与历史数据集保持了良好分布一致性。消融实验验证了各核心组件（Planner、Executor、后训练、D-GRPO端到端优化）的不可或缺性。
AI.conclusion: AIGB-R1通过分层Planner-Executor架构有效结合了LLM的推理规划能力与轻量决策模型的数值精度优势，借助经验驱动的自进化循环和D-GRPO优势解耦机制，实现了自动出价策略的持续自主优化，为LLM赋能的自动出价提供了一种有前景的解决方案。

title: Lookahead Branching for Neural Network Verification
comment: Accepted to IJCAI 2026. Lookahead branching is part of the Marabou and $α$-$β$-CROWN verifiers
summary: In this work, we investigate the effect of lookahead branching strategies in neural network verification. We present a general recipe to integrate lookahead into any branch-and-bound verifier and demonstrate how one of the current state-of-the-art branching heuristics, FSB, can be viewed as a special instantiation of the lookahead branching strategy. We also describe how, in addition to improving the quality of branching decisions, lookahead can generate additional lemmas that accelerate verification. We instantiate the method in two representative branch-and-bound-based verifiers (Marabou and $\alpha$-$\beta$-CROWN), and demonstrate that lookahead leads to consistent speedups in verification time and up to $57\%$ more solved instances. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种通用的 lookahead（前瞻）分支策略模板，用于神经网络形式化验证中的分支决策。作者将该方法集成到两种代表性的 branch-and-bound（BaB）验证器（Marabou 和 α-β-CROWN）中，展示了该方法能够一致性地加速验证时间，并多解决 57% 的验证实例。
AI.motivation: 在基于分支定界（BaB）的神经网络验证中，分支启发式（branching heuristic）对验证效率有显著影响。现有的分支启发式（如 BaBSR、FSB、Pseudo-impact）大多依赖局部信息进行快速决策，可能导致次优的分支选择，尤其是在搜索树顶层。已有研究（如 FSB）表明投入更多计算进行更智能的分支决策是有益的。本文系统性地研究 lookahead 策略，通过模拟分支的级联效应来做出更明智的决策，并探讨其是否能普遍提升验证性能。
AI.method:
方法核心是将 lookahead 建模为模板算法，包含以下关键参数：
1. **预选策略（Preselect Strategy）**：使用轻量级度量（如极性得分或 BaBSR 分数）从所有不稳定神经元中筛选少量候选者。
2. **前瞻深度（Lookahead Depth k）**：递归模拟 k 层分支，使用基础选择启发式（BaBSR 或 pseudo-impact）选择下一层神经元。
3. **评分函数（Scoring Function）**：
   - 神经元固定型度量：通过公式 $a \times b / (a+b+1)$ 评估分支中相位固定的神经元的平衡性（用于 Marabou）。
   - 边界缩减型度量：基于变量边界的缩减量评估（用于 α-β-CROWN）。
4. **相位固定（Phase Fixing）**：前瞻过程中获得的紧界可以确定不稳定神经元的相位，生成有效引理以修剪搜索空间。

作者将 FSB 视为 lookahead 策略的特例（深度为 1，每步都执行）。实现选择：在搜索树顶层执行深度为 2 的 lookahead，之后回退到基础启发式。论文还给出了相位固定的理论定理保证。
AI.result:
实验在两类验证器上进行：
**Marabou（CPU，SMT-based）**：对比 BaBSR 和 pseudo-impact，在 NAP、NN4Sys、MNIST 基准上测试。在 NAP 上 lookahead 比 BaBSR 多解决 17 个实例（从 30 提升到 47），平均求解时间从 29.0 秒降至 3.7 秒。在 NN4Sys 上与 pseudo-impact 结合多解决 12 个实例。在简单实例上 lookahead 有较大开销（87.5%），但在困难实例上开销仅占 10.6%，且显著加速验证。

**α-β-CROWN（GPU，bound-propagation-based）**：对比 FSB，在 CIFAR、MNIST、TinyImageNet 等 7 个大规模 CNN 上测试。Lookahead 在所有基准上一致性地加速验证，在需要完整 BaB 的实例上平均加速 15%-24%，并额外解决 2 个独立实例。

消融实验表明：前瞻深度和候选数量影响较小（NAP 例外，过深的深度 D10 反而降低性能）；相位固定在 NN4Sys 上带来 33 秒的性能提升；不同前瞻分支层数对 α-β-CROWN 影响较小。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的 lookahead 分支策略可作为一种通用框架，提升分支定界型神经网络验证器的性能。该策略通过模拟级联分支效应来做出更优决策，并能在前瞻过程中发现额外引理（如相位固定）以缩减搜索空间。在两种不同范式的验证器（基于 SMT 的 Marabou 和基于 GPU 边界传播的 α-β-CROWN）上的一致性增益表明 lookahead 是具有广泛适用性的策略。未来工作方向包括：探索更深的前瞻模拟、在搜索后期周期性调用 lookahead，以及利用神经元间依赖关系进一步修剪搜索空间。

title: WAR: Workload-Aware Rollouts for Synchronous Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Long-horizon rollout generation has become the dominant systems bottleneck in agentic reinforcement learning (RL). As agents interact with environments over many turns, trajectories rapidly grow to tens of thousands of tokens, making synchronous RL training increasingly constrained by rollout. We propose WAR, a workload-aware rollout system that substantially accelerates synchronous agentic RL by jointly optimizing decoding and scheduling. WAR is built on a key observation: the optimal rollout optimization strategy depends on runtime load: (1) Under low load, WAR enables model-free speculative decoding with SuffixDecoding, which reuses suffix patterns from previously completed trajectories as speculative drafts for future rollouts. Unlike model-based drafters, SuffixDecoding introduces no additional draft model and avoids GPU contention with rollout generation. (2) Under high load, where saturated batched decoding leaves limited room for speculative speedup, WAR shifts the optimization focus to cache-aware scheduling. A global scheduler places requests across rollout replicas based on cache locality, trajectory progress and server load, reducing redundant KV-cache recomputation and mitigating load imbalance. By combining decoding-level suffix reuse with system-level rollout scheduling, WAR delivers robust throughput improvements across workload regimes without changing the underlying RL algorithm. WAR improves long-context agentic rollout throughput by 1.4x under low load and up to 1.6x under high load. These results show that WAR removes a major rollout bottleneck in synchronous agentic RL and provides a practical path toward scalable long-context agent training.

AI.tldr: WAR 是一个面向同步智能体强化学习训练的工作负载感知（workload-aware）Rollout 系统。它根据运行时负载情况，在低负载时启用无模型的推测解码（SuffixDecoding）以利用未充分利用的 GPU 资源，在高负载时切换到缓存感知调度（cache-aware scheduling）以减少 KV-cache 重复计算和负载不均衡。在长上下文智能体任务上，相比 veRL 基线，吞吐量在低负载下提升 1.4×，在高负载下最高提升 1.6×。
AI.motivation: 长时序智能体强化学习（agentic RL）训练中，Rollout 生成已成为主要系统瓶颈：轨迹长度可达数万 token，长尾分布严重，同步 RL 训练中慢节点会拖累整体效率。现有方案如异步 Rollout 虽然能提高利用率，但会引入策略陈旧（policy staleness）和分布偏移等问题。因此亟需在保持同步 RL 语义的前提下优化 Rollout 本身。同时作者指出，Rollout 优化的最佳策略取决于运行时负载：低负载下 GPU 未充分利用，适合推测解码；高负载下批量解码已饱和 GPU，需关注缓存局部性与负载均衡，但现有系统缺乏这种负载自适应的设计。
AI.method: WAR 包含两个核心组件，并通过运行时有效批大小作为负载指示器进行自适应切换：(1) 低负载下启用 SuffixDecoding——一种基于后缀树的免模型推测解码方法，缓存历史轨迹的 token 模式作为草稿，无需额外草稿模型，避免与目标模型争抢 GPU；并实现了跨 worker 的后缀树同步机制，每步 RL 后将新生成的轨迹广播到所有副本。(2) 高负载下启用缓存感知全局调度器，按四个维度对请求评分：等待时间（S_waiting，防止沙箱 TTL 超时）、在线估计的助手轮次（S_turn，优先调度短轨迹）、KV-cache 命中率（S_cache，提高缓存局部性）和各副本的飞行中请求数（S_inflight，平衡负载），并借鉴 CONCUR 的 AIMD 机制动态调整每个副本的最大请求数。系统基于 veRL v0.8.0 实现，使用 SGLang v0.5.5 作为推理引擎，约 7000 行 Python 代码，不改变底层 RL 算法。
AI.result: 在 16 张 H100 GPU 上使用 Qwen3-32B（YaRN 扩展至 96K 上下文）评估 SWE 智能体数据集（500 个 prompt，每 prompt 滚动 8 次）。实验对比了四种配置（veRL_base、sched_only、spec_only、sched_spec），在 batch size 从 4 到 64 的范围内：(1) sched_only 在高负载下效果显著，batch size 从 4 增至 64 时，prefill 吞吐提升从 0% 增至 47%，decode 吞吐提升从 -4% 增至 47%，KV-cache 命中率从 ~0.9 降至 0.5（远优于基线的 0.1）。(2) spec_only 在低负载下效果显著，batch size 从 4 增至 64 时，prefill/decode 吞吐提升从 ~50% 降至 5%，接受长度约 2.8（小 batch）至 6.0（大 batch）。(3) sched_spec 全程表现稳健，end-to-end Rollout 时间一致降低。(4) 消融实验表明四个调度因子互补，S_cache 单独即可带来最佳单因子效果。所有配置下的工作负载差异均在 5% 以内，确保对比公平。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出将"工作负载"作为同步智能体 RL Rollout 优化的一等公民。WAR 通过联合优化解码层（SuffixDecoding）与系统层（缓存感知调度），在不改变底层 RL 算法或放松同步语义的前提下，在不同负载区间均实现了稳定的吞吐量提升（低负载 1.4×，高负载最高 1.6×）。该工作为可扩展的长上下文同步智能体 RL 训练提供了一条实用路径，且与现有的尾部分批、上下文感知调度等方法互补。

title: The Optimization Trilemma: Efficiency, Comfort and Fairness in Decentralized Multi-agent Coordination
summary: The problem of fair multi-agent coordination in decentralized settings is one of the most pressing challenges for building efficient collaborative systems. Resource allocation is based on optimized collective arrangements accounting for agents' needs. Such coordination should not only be computationally efficient but also account for fairness, i.e., equitable redistribution of costs incurred by all agents. Recent literature has proposed several algorithms that efficiently determine optimal plan combinations balancing system-wide efficiency and individual discomfort of agents in a centralized setting. However, these works do not address equitable resource optimization in fully decentralized scenarios, specifically, the optimized redistribution of discomfort among coordinating agents so that none experiences a discomfort level that could lead to loss of incentive or polarization that can disrupt planned operations. In this work, we study the problem of optimizing three objectives: (i) system-wide efficiency, (ii) individuals' comfort and (iii) fairness (i.e., balancing of incurred discomfort costs) in decentralized multi-agent coordination. We design a novel model to optimize those three orthogonal objectives, without any substantial increase in communication and computational overhead. Through experiments on two real-world datasets, we validate the model and demonstrate that it can achieve fairer optimization outcomes, while satisfying agents' preferences and system goals.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向去中心化多智能体协同优化的"三难困境"模型，将系统效率、个体舒适度和公平性（不适成本分布的均衡化）作为三个正交目标进行联合优化，并以 I-EPOS 算法为基础实现了几乎零额外通信开销的公平性建模与求解。
AI.motivation: 在去中心化多智能体系统中，资源分配通常追求全局效率与个体舒适，但现有工作忽视了个体间"不适成本"分配的不均衡问题，可能导致部分智能体承担过高负担而失去参与激励，甚至引发系统极化与运行中断。本文旨在弥补去中心化场景下公平性优化的空白。
AI.method: 1. 将公平性定义为各智能体不适成本的标准差 U(t)；2. 通过引理证明 U(t) 可仅由本地已计算的"聚合计划成本" k_a(t) 与"聚合平方计划成本" K_a(t) 近似表达（无需新增通信）；3. 将三个目标加权标量化 γG+αU+βL 嵌入到 I-EPOS 的自底向上/自顶向下两阶段协议中，利用树状拓扑实现去中心化协同；4. 在合成、共享单车、智慧电网三个数据集上进行网格搜索与Pareto前沿分析。
AI.result: 三个目标在不超过 35 轮迭代内均能收敛；公平性优化显著降低了不适成本分布的极化，同时保持较高的系统效率；Pareto 前沿分析验证了三个目标在不同数据集上的正交性与可调权衡；模型可扩展至数千智能体且通信计算开销可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明在去中心化多智能体协同中可同时优化效率、舒适与公平三个正交目标，且不引入显著通信瓶颈；通过 I-EPOS 的实例化验证了模型的可行性与可扩展性，并为后续研究异构偏好、替代公平度量及利他行为激励提供了基础。

title: TAPAS: Throughput-adaptive Perception for Autonomous Systems
comment: 15 Pages, 20 Figures, Accepted at ACM/IEEE International Conference on Codesign of Embedded Systems at Embedded Systems Week (ESWEEK-CODES), 2026
summary: Autonomous systems rely on a perception module to navigate through dynamic environments. In real-world scenarios, the perception module's throughput requirements vary at runtime due to changes in scene complexity. However, existing perception strategies assume a fixed FPS and static model-to-cluster mapping, resulting in either over/under provision of throughput requirements or unnecessary energy consumption across diverse scenes. Addressing this challenge requires tightly coupled \textit{scene complexity awareness} to estimate an appropriate FPS target and \textit{dynamic model-to-cluster mapping} to deliver the required throughput at minimum energy. We propose a throughput-adaptive perception strategy for mobile/edge platforms, enabling intelligent runtime resource allocation based on varying FPS targets. We use Reinforcement Learning (RL) with RRM (Reward Reasoning Model) and a GRU (Gated Recurrent Unit) agent to orchestrate perception tasks across heterogeneous mobile/edge platforms. We evaluate TAPAS on Jetson Orin NX across KITTI and unseen nuScenes. On the \textit{KITTI} dataset's test sequences, TAPAS achieves 93-100% throughput met rate while saving energy by 76%. On the unseen \textit{nuScenes} dataset, TAPAS maintains 97% throughput met rate with 64% lower energy compared to \textit{SOTA} approaches, proving its robustness.

AI.tldr: TAPAS是一种面向自动驾驶系统的吞吐量自适应感知框架，通过空间熵估计场景复杂度以动态调整FPS目标，并利用基于GRU的强化学习智能体结合奖励推理模型(RRM)在异构移动/边缘平台(Jetson Orin NX)上动态分配模型到计算簇(CPU/GPU/DLA)，以最低能耗满足变化的吞吐量需求。
AI.motivation: 现有感知策略假设固定FPS和静态模型-簇映射，导致在动态场景中要么过度配置（浪费能耗），要么配置不足（吞吐量未达标），无法应对真实场景中由场景复杂度变化引起的运行时吞吐量需求波动。
AI.method: 1) 通过Shannon空间熵从目标检测输出量化场景复杂度，并映射到可变FPS目标(5/10/15 FPS)；2) 基于GRU的PPO强化学习智能体处理时序状态(熵、FPS、工作负载特征)进行模型到簇的动态映射决策；3) 采用奖励推理模型(RRM，基于Qwen2)提供结构化、接地于实测吞吐量与能耗的奖励信号，解决吞吐量与能耗的多目标权衡问题；4) 训练阶段使用KITTI轨迹数据进行离线训练，部署阶段当熵变化触发调度策略更新。
AI.result: 在Jetson Orin NX上：KITTI测试序列上实现93-100%吞吐量满足率，最高节能76%；在未见的nuScenes数据集上保持97%吞吐量满足率，能耗比SOTA低64%。消融实验表明GRU+RRM组合性能(0.72)与稳定性(0.78)最优，运行开销仅2.3ms延迟和45mJ能耗。在渐进式簇不可用(0-25%)场景下表现出强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: TAPAS通过场景感知与动态资源分配的紧耦合，有效解决了自动驾驶感知系统中吞吐量与能耗的权衡问题，在已知和未见数据集上均显著优于EE、OmniBoost和Band等SOTA方法，未来工作将探索模型近似和DVFS以实现更细粒度的能效优化。

title: CoEvoP&R: Co-Evolving Placement Objectives with Routing Feedback via Large Language Models
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Corresponding author: Weihua Xiao
summary: Analytical placers rely on differentiable objective functions to guide placement, typically combining intermediate surrogate metrics such as half-perimeter wirelength (HPWL) and cell-density penalties. However, these placement-stage surrogates remain misaligned with downstream routed and timing quality. Prior work reduces this gap with human-designed terms or learned black-box surrogates, but the former requires expert retuning and the latter is difficult to explain, debug, or deploy in analytical placement flows. CoEvoP&R addresses these limitations with a large language model (LLM)-based framework that automatically evolves analytical placement objectives. At each generation, the prompt combines the restricted objective interface, baseline context, and archived prior candidates with routing-related feedback from placement, timing proxy, and routing tools. The LLM proposes readable differentiable objectives, which are embedded and validated in DREAMPlace, evaluated through a timing proxy and an actual router, and stored with their feedback to guide later generations. Across eight ChiP-Bench Nangate45 designs and three seeds, CoEvoP&R reduces post-route routed wirelength and congestion by 16.9% and 36.7%, with gains of 0.70 ns in worst negative slack and a 912 ns reduction in total negative slack magnitude over native DREAMPlace. Across eight ICCAD 2015 Superblue designs, it reduces post-route routed wirelength and congestion by 5.4% and 23.2%. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: CoEvoP&R 提出了一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的框架，通过路由反馈自动进化分析布局（analytical placement）的可微目标函数。在 DREAMPlace 中嵌入 LLM 生成的可读目标，结合 MAP-Elites 归档与下游路由/时序反馈进行闭环进化，在 ChiPBench Nangate45、ICCAD 2015 Superblue 和 ASAP7 上显著降低了布线长度、拥塞并改善了时序。
AI.motivation: 分析布局器（如 DREAMPlace）依赖可微代理指标（如 HPWL 和单元密度惩罚）来引导布局，但这些布局阶段代理与下游布线质量和时序（如 WNS/TNS）存在错配。已有方法存在两类局限：(1) 人工设计项（如 RUDY）依赖专家经验且需跨设计重新调参；(2) 学习型黑盒代理难以解释、调试且难以部署到分析布局流程中。因此需要一种可直接搜索可读、可微目标函数形式的自动化方法。
AI.method: CoEvoP&R 采用 LLM 驱动的进化循环：(1) 归档条件下的目标提议——每个 generation 基于受限目标接口 ℐ、基线上下文 B、父目标 p_g、归档证据 H_g、测量反馈 M_g 和输出格式 σ 组装 prompt packet Π_g，LLM 输出可读的轨迹感知目标（初始化 I_θ、更新 U_θ、损失 F_θ 及调度变量 h_t）；(2) 候选验证与 DREAMPlace 嵌入——通过语法、物理角色、可微性和运行时检查后嵌入到 DREAMPlace 中，作用于密度、布线压力、引脚压力和平滑系数；(3) 成本缩放评估——三级证据层级（Tier A 布局代理指标、Tier B 时序代理、Tier C 真实布线），通过 Pareto 排序选择精英；(4) 归档更新——采用 MAP-Elites 网格覆盖目标行为特征（复杂度、机制族、HPWL、溢出、时序），配合岛屿模型进行多样性维护和精英迁移，负记忆存储失败案例以避免重复无效机制。
AI.result: 在 ChiPBench Nangate45 八个设计上（三种子均值），CoEvoP&R-E 相对原生 DREAMPlace：布线线长降低 16.9%，布线拥塞降低 36.7%，WNS 改善 0.70 ns，TNS 改善 912 ns。LODO（leave-one-design-out）协议下 CoEvoP&R-L 保持 13.2% 线长、31.4% 拥塞、0.51 ns WNS、637 ns TNS 增益。在 ICCAD 2015 Superblue 上 E 变体平均 5.4% 线长、23.2% 拥塞降低、8.2 ns WNS、26,163 ns TNS 增益；T（零样本迁移）保留 46%-80% 收益。ASAP7 跨节点测试中，LaMPlace 出现回归而 CoEvoP&R 仍保持正向增益。时序代理审计显示 ΔWNS 与 HPWL 冗余度低，被设为首选代理；ΔTNS 用作平局打破。消融实验验证了归档条件迭代、成本缩放证据分配、组件轨迹和失败记忆的必要性。LLM 模型敏感性方面，gpt-5.4 表现最优（Score 4.87），claude-opus-4-8 接近（4.62），gpt-4.1-mini 与 qwen3.7-max 略低。
AI.conclusion: CoEvoP&R 证明了 LLM 引导的目标函数进化可作为可微布局与下游评估之间的可检查接口，能够将布线与时序证据转化为可读、可微的目标函数。该方法在多个基准测试和工艺节点上改进了布线线长、拥塞和时序。未来工作可将归档与验证接口扩展到多角时序、功耗以及签核（signoff）级精确布线反馈。

title: Kernelized Linear Attention: Breaking the Capacity Wall with Symmetric Cones
comment: 39 pages, 4 figures, 10 tables. Code: this https URL
summary: Linear attention promises constant-time recurrent inference but degrades sharply on associative recall. We formulate attention recall as a spherical-packing problem and introduce Kernelized Linear Attention Activations (KATA), a framework whose feature maps are derived from first principles by certifying nonnegative attention weights through a self-dual homogeneous cone. Building on this observation, we show that rank-one positive semi-definite (PSD) features offer a favorable capacity--interference tradeoff. KATA recovers a parameter-free convex output gate and characterizes associative capacity through the Welch interference floor. For tolerances above this floor, KATA enlarges the state without adding parameters and admits spherical codes with exponentially many keys in the projection dimension. We implement KATA as fused Triton kernels at two operating points: a flash-attention-style forward up to ${\sim}1.6\times$ FlashAttention-2 throughput, and an exact $O(T)$ chunked-state form that reaches ${\sim}11\times$ FlashAttention-2 forward throughput at $131$k tokens. An associative scan of the first-order feature lowers the inter-chunk recurrence depth to $O(\log(T/C))$ for chunk size $C$ and averages ${\sim}2.4\times$ the throughput of a matched sequential linear-attention baseline. On long-range MQAR and repeated-key overwrite, several KATA variants outperform Gated DeltaNet, with parameter counts and state sizes reported alongside accuracy. Induction preserves near-perfect recall, while kernel benchmarks show that the maps can be implemented efficiently. KATA retains $0.985$ MQAR at a $16\times$ out-of-distribution length, approaching the softmax with roughly one quarter of the KV-cache entries. Experiments on 340M-parameter LLMs reveal a feature-dependent fluency trade-off and clarify how positional embeddings, delta rules, and decay gates interact with feature geometry.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KATA（Kernelized Linear Attention Activations）框架，基于自对偶齐次锥（Koecher-Vinberg分类）从第一性原理推导线性注意力的非负特征映射，通过球填充理论刻画关联记忆容量，并在Triton上实现高效核函数，在长序列关联召回任务上超越Gated DeltaNet等基线。
AI.motivation: 线性注意力以常数时间循环推理替代softmax的二次复杂度，但在关联召回任务上性能急剧下降。现有门控线性RNN（如DeltaNet、Mamba2、Gated DeltaNet）通过学习遗忘门部分弥补了差距，但其特征映射的几何基础不透明：固定状态大小下召回容量的限制因素是什么？特征映射是否必须非负？哪些有限映射保持softmax的各向同性？缺乏原理性回答使得新架构设计依赖经验性消融。
AI.method: 1. **锥几何分类**：基于自对偶齐次锥假设和非负注意力权重条件，利用Koecher-Vinberg定理将允许的特征几何分为正卦限、Lorentz锥和PSD锥三类；2. **容量理论**：将关联召回建模为离散球填充问题，导出正卦限的Welch界、Lorentz锥的Rankin墙、PSD秩一射线的指数级容量下界；3. **pSNR分析**：在等向值模型下推导最优填充对应的功率信噪比，将softmax温度锐化效应统一到同一框架；4. **硬件实现**：在Triton上实现两种工作点（二次O(T²)和线性状态O(T)），并利用关联扫描将块间依赖深度从O(N_C)降至O(log N_C)；5. **架构变体**：提出KATA-Σg（块外积求和）、KATA-Mg（保留每块PSD因子）及其Delta/Gated/GatedDelta组合。
AI.result: 1. **容量优势**：KATA-M1在16×分布外长度下保持0.985 MQAR精度，状态大小约为softmax KV缓存的1/4；2. **硬件效率**：二次KATA-M1前向达FlashAttention-2的1.6×吞吐量，线性状态KATA-M2在131k tokens下达11× FlashAttention-2吞吐量，关联扫描平均提供2.4×的顺序扫描加速；3. **关联召回**：DeltaKATA-M1在重复键覆写任务上接近完美（0.999），优于Gated DeltaNet；4. **高熵信号保持**：KATA在RULER UUID任务上保留显著信号（0.758-0.910），而Gated DeltaNet降至0.004；5. **预训练权衡**：340M参数模型上KATA-M1/M2在困惑度上略逊于softmax和Gated DeltaNet，但在精确召回任务上展现互补优势。
AI.conclusion: KATA通过锥几何分类、球填充容量理论和硬件对齐实现三个层面，系统地解决了线性注意力的容量瓶颈问题。秩一PSD特征映射通过平方内积将地址维度从O(p)扩展至O(p²)，在固定可容忍干扰下实现指数级地址容量。分母自然产生的参数无关凸输出门简化了设计空间，而门控和delta规则可作为正交的正交性补充控制。实验表明几何容量、训练可学习性和语境流畅度是可分离的关注点，KATA在合成关联任务和精确召回上表现出色，但在需要语境路由的任务上仍有差距。未来工作包括复数锥扩展、系统预训练GatedKATA、张量训练分解实现更高阶特征以及更宽头部维度的可学习性研究。

title: HyCoRec: Hypergraph-Enhanced Multi-Preference Learning for Alleviating Matthew Effect in Conversational Recommendation
summary: The Matthew effect is a notorious issue in Recommender Systems (RSs), \emph{i.e.}, the rich get richer and the poor get poorer, wherein popular items are overexposed while less popular ones are regularly ignored. Most methods examine Matthew effect in static or nearly-static recommendation scenarios. However, the Matthew effect will be increasingly amplified when the user interacts with the system over time. To address these issues, we propose a novel paradigm, Hypergraph-Enhanced Multi-Preference Learning for Alleviating Matthew Effect in Conversational Recommendation (HyCoRec), which aims to alleviate the Matthew effect in conversational recommendation. Concretely, HyCoRec devotes to alleviate the Matthew effect by learning multi-aspect preferences, \emph{i.e.}, item-, entity-, word-, review-, and knowledge-aspect preferences, to effectively generate responses in the conversational task and accurately predict items in the recommendation task when the user chats with the system over time. Extensive experiments conducted on two benchmarks validate that HyCoRec achieves new state-of-the-art performance and the superior of alleviating Matthew effect. Our code is available at this https URL .
