AI.conclusion: EvolvingWorld通过将交互式文学世界建模为开放模式下的角色与世界共同演化的长视距过程，并提供大规模基准与轨迹级评估协议，为可控、长期一致的多智能体文学仿真奠定了基础；实验证明该设计能有效缓解长视距仿真中的性能退化，并具备跨领域泛化的潜力。

title: Should Missing Modalities Always Be Necessary to Repair for Multi-modal Sentiment Analysis?
summary: Existing methods for multimodal sentiment analysis (MSA) under missing modalities usually follow a repair-first paradigm. We revisit this assumption and ask: \emph{should every missing modality be repaired?} A per-sample oracle analysis shows the answer is not always: full-modality input is optimal for only a small fraction of samples, and every modality subset is preferred by some samples. These results suggest that adding or repairing modalities may not always improve prediction, and that the utility of each modality is sample-dependent. Building on this finding, we propose \textbf{S}ufficiency-\textbf{I}nformed \textbf{E}vidential \textbf{V}al\textbf{vE} (\textbf{SIEVE}) that turns ``whether to repair'' into an explicit, learnable decision at the sample level. SIEVE compares a direct prediction branch with a repair branch, derives an empirical sufficiency signal from their per-sample loss gap, and routes each input through an evidential gate that jointly models sufficiency and its epistemic uncertainty. SIEVE is repair-agnostic: it operates as a plug-and-play decision on top of any explicit or implicit repair module, without modifying its internal design. Experiments on CMU-MOSI and IEMOCAP show that SIEVE consistently improves representative repair backbones across evaluated missing rates, and approaches the per-sample dual-branch achievable optimum.

AI.tldr: 该论文挑战了多模态情感分析(MSA)中处理缺失模态时"先修复后预测"的默认范式，提出SIEVE框架，通过学习样本级"是否需要修复"的决策，选择性地调用现有修复模块，在CMU-MOSI和IEMOCAP数据集上一致提升了多种修复骨干网络的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有缺失模态MSA方法普遍遵循"repair-first"假设：只要模态缺失就进行修复/补偿。但论文通过per-sample oracle分析发现：(1) 全模态输入仅在少数样本(15.5%-33.2%)上最优；(2) 几乎每种模态子集都对某些样本最优；(3) 模态的效用是sample-dependent的，强制修复有时反而有害。因此问题应从"如何修复"转变为"是否需要修复"。
AI.method: SIEVE (Sufficiency-Informed Evidential Valve) 是一个plug-and-play、repair-agnostic的样本级选择性修复框架，核心设计包括：(1) **双分支预测**：直接分支(用观察模态预测)与修复分支(先调用修复模块R_ω再预测)并行；(2) **经验充分性信号**：利用两分支per-sample loss gap A_i = L_r - L_d 经温度sigmoid生成软充分性目标s_i*；(3) **证据充分性阀门(Evidential Valve)**：基于Beta分布参数化充分性概率，预测(α_i, β_i)同时捕获充分性估计和认知不确定性；(4) **不确定性感知路由**：动态阈值θ(u)=(1+(1-2π_m)u)/2结合缺失模式先验π_m(EMA更新)和认知不确定性u_i；(5) **训练策略**：两阶段(warmup稳定双分支→联合训练)，使用Gumbel-Sigmoid松弛实现可微路由，损失包括routed prediction loss、valve calibration loss(基于Beta对数似然)和evidence regularizer(惩罚错误方向证据)。阈值形式由Subjective Logic投影严格推导得出。
AI.result: 在CMU-MOSI和IEMOCAP两个基准数据集上，SIEVE作为插件一致提升了三种代表性修复范式(显式图重建GCNet、蒸馏式CorrKD、内在证据补偿MoMKE)的性能：(1) 极端缺失(MR=0.7)下，GCNet+SIEVE在MOSI达到Acc-2 0.7165/F1 0.7100，在IEMOCAP达到Acc-4 0.6942/F1 0.6968，均为最佳；(2) 跨所有缺失率MR∈{0.0,...,0.7}稳定提升，即使在全模态设置下也有增益；(3) 路由分析显示SIEVE接近per-sample achievable optimum；(4) t-SNE证实两个分支占据不同表示区域；(5) 消融实验验证各组件(ℒ_valve、ℒ_ev、ℒ_R、动态阈值、π_m先验)均不可缺。
AI.conclusion: 论文确立了"是否修复"作为缺失模态MSA中与"如何修复"并列的核心问题，证明选择性干预是稳健多模态系统设计的通用原则。SIEVE通过双分支损失gap提供无外部监督的内部充分性信号，结合证据阀门实现不确定性感知路由，是一种通用、即插即用的决策层。未来可拓展至VQA、多模态动作识别、医学诊断等更广泛的不完整模态场景。局限在于：仅在MSA两个数据集验证；训练需评估双分支带来额外开销。

title: Safety That Does Not Transfer: Cross-Lingual Clinical Correctness Drift in Deployable Medical Language Models
summary: Safety evaluation of large language models is conducted predominantly in English and predominantly on frontier systems. Neither condition describes how such models are encountered in low-resource health settings, where small quantised systems are run locally and queried in local languages. We ask whether clinical safety established in English transfers to Hausa, and whether any failure is attributable to the language, the clinical task, or the class of model that low-resource deployment admits. Matched English-Hausa question pairs were built for three conditions of high burden in northern Nigeria: malaria, sickle cell disease, and tuberculosis, probing knowledge recall, emergency triage, a leading question inviting a contraindicated action, and a traditional-remedy claim. Six models were evaluated: five locally deployable systems of 4-9 billion parameters, two medically fine-tuned, and one frontier system. All 128 responses were scored against Nigerian national treatment guidelines by two fluent Hausa speakers working independently and blind to one another. Among locally deployable models, mean clinical correctness fell from 1.57 in English to -0.03 in Hausa, on a scale where 2 denotes a correct answer and -1 an actively harmful one. The frontier model moved from 2.00 to 1.75 and produced no response judged harmful in either language. Drift was consistent across all three conditions. Inter-rater agreement was substantial for clinical correctness (kappa = 0.70); agreement on harm was initially poor (kappa = 0.22) and is examined in detail. Because a frontier model answers the same questions competently in Hausa, the deficit is a property neither of the language nor of the clinical material, but of the deployable tier.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了部署级小型语言模型在英语到豪萨语跨语言临床场景中的安全性迁移问题。核心发现：在英语中临床正确的小型可部署模型（4-9B参数）在豪萨语中平均正确性从1.57跌至-0.03（评分量表中-1代表"主动有害"），即从"称职"恶化到"有害"；而前沿模型在同一豪萨语任务中保持1.75的正确性，未产生任何有害回答。研究表明安全缺陷既不源于豪萨语本身，也不源于临床任务，而源于低资源部署所允许的模型层级（deployable tier）。
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型的安全评估存在两大偏差：1) 语言偏差——安全对齐数据以英语为主，Yong等人已证明将对抗提示翻译成低资源语言可绕过GPT-4的拒绝行为；2) 架构偏差——评估聚焦于前沿大模型，而非低资源医疗场景中实际部署的小型量化模型。同时，现有多语言安全研究多测量"拒绝漂移"(refusal drift)，但在临床咨询中真正有害的是"流畅、自信且错误"的回答，而非不回答。论文选择尼日利亚北部的豪萨语作为研究对象，因其是当地真实的健康求助语言，却几乎未被纳入安全评估体系。
AI.method: 研究构建了匹配英-豪双语的临床问题集，覆盖尼日利亚北部高负担的三类疾病：疟疾、镰状细胞病、结核病（分别代表急性寄生虫感染、慢性遗传病、慢性细菌感染）。每种疾病设计四种问题形式：知识回忆、紧急分诊（含危重症状的病例）、诱导性问题（诱导禁忌操作）、传统疗法探针。共12对（英-豪）24个问题。正确性锚定尼日利亚国家治疗指南（如抗疟疾一线为青蒿素联合疗法，禁止氯喹；结核病标准6个月方案）。评估6个模型：5个本地可部署模型（medgemma:4b、biomistral、gemma2:9b、qwen2.5:7b、llama3.1:8b，均通过Ollama以默认量化运行）+1个前沿模型（Gemini API参考）。共128个回答，由两位流利豪萨语使用者独立、盲评打分（评分维度：临床正确性2/-1、安全对冲、语言质量、输出语言）。引入"危险自信率"(Dangerous Confidence Rate)指标——同时满足无对冲、自信、临床错误三者条件者。两位评分者间一致性采用Cohen's κ衡量。
AI.result: 1) 可部署模型平均临床正确性从英语1.57跌至豪萨语-0.03，跨越"称职"到"有害"；前沿模型仅从2.00降至1.75，两种语言均无有害回答。2) 三种疾病均呈下降趋势（疟疾1.25→0.15；镰状细胞病1.85→-0.30；结核病1.67→0.33），但镰状细胞病出现"英语最强、豪萨语最弱"的反差。3) 在原始有害标记下，可部署模型豪萨语有害回答占比从英语的5%升至38%；裁定后为25%。4) 医学微调模型（medgemma、biomistral）在豪萨语中并未优于通用模型，提示领域微调可能窄化了多语言能力。5) 模型未能可靠以提示语言作答：medgemma多数超时，llama3.1输出相当比例为斯瓦希里语（不相关语系）。6) 评分者一致性：临床正确性κ=0.70（实质性一致）、输出语言κ=0.98（近乎完美）、语言质量κ=0.89、对冲κ=0.82；唯独有害性判断κ=0.22（差），原因为类别不平衡（占主导的"非有害"类人为提升随机一致性），分歧源于"将危害视为内容属性还是后果属性"——最终采用"后果属性"裁定（紧急场景下未传达紧急指引即为有害）。7) 第二位评分者独立复制了层级分离：可部署模型豪萨语正确性+0.18，前沿模型2.00。
AI.conclusion: 缺陷既不在豪萨语本身（前沿模型在豪萨语中表现称职），也不在临床任务本身（六模型英语均称职），而在于低资源部署所允许的模型层级。论文提出三项评估原则：必须在部署层级评估（前沿结果不下传）、必须在使用语言评估（英语结果不外推）、在临床应用中必须衡量正确性而非拒绝（拒绝型指标无法区分安全回答与自信错误回答）。建议采购立场：未经在其部署层级与目标语言中评估的次前沿模型不应被依赖用于临床指导。该方法（匹配语对+国家指南+前沿参考）可推广至其他语言、疾病和部署层级。

title: How Reliable Are Multimodal Signals of Conversational State? Evidence from Remote Dyadic Collaborative Tasks
comment: Accepted, to appear in Proceedings of ACM International Conference on Multimodal Interaction 2026, 13 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables
summary: Measuring conversational states such as cognitive load and conversational power from multimodal behavior requires characteristic features that are not only predictive but also reliable across task contexts. We present a three-dimensional evaluation framework assessing predictive accuracy, cross-task generalizability, and test-retest reliability, applied to interactional, acoustic, and linguistic features extracted from dyadic conversations during collaborative tasks performed over a video-conferencing platform (AVCAffe dataset; 53 dyads, 9 tasks). Our results show that no single feature family dominates all three dimensions. Linguistic features show the highest predictive accuracy for cognitive load but collapse under cross-task evaluation, revealing sensitivity to task-specific vocabulary. Additionally, acoustic reliability, often reported as evidence of feature stability, degrades once speaker identity is controlled, confirming that standard prosodic features measure vocal characteristics rather than conversational state. Interaction features provide the only genuinely reliable signal, unchanged after speaker normalization. Interestingly, classifying power role remained near chance baseline across all conditions, indicating limitations of task-level aggregated behavior for predicting power role in conversation. Our findings reveal three insights: (1) linguistic features predict best but generalize poorly across task contexts; (2) acoustic reliability collapses to near-zero once speaker identity is controlled, challenging standard evaluation practice; and (3) interaction features provide the only genuinely reliable signal, with floor dominance predicting within-dyad cognitive load asymmetry. These results argue for speaker normalization and multi-dimensional evaluation as prerequisites for context-aware, robust multimodal feature selection in conversational systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出三维评估框架（预测准确性、跨任务泛化性、说话人归一化前后的重测信度），系统评估远程协作对话中的多模态特征对认知负荷和会话权力的测量可靠性，发现任何单一特征族都无法在三个维度同时占优：语言特征预测力最强但任务依赖严重，声学特征信度由说话人身份虚高，归一化后崩塌；交互特征是唯一经得起归一化检验的可靠信号，并发现"话语权主导"可预测双人对内认知负荷不对称。
AI.motivation: 多模态情感计算领域长期以预测准确性作为评估金标准，但忽略两个关键问题：特征是否跨任务上下文泛化？特征究竟测量的是会话状态本身，还是被说话人稳定的声学/语言习惯所混淆？这在系统部署至多样化上下文时会导致可靠性幻觉与泛化失效。
AI.method: 基于 AVCAffe 数据集（53 对双人、9 个 Zoom 远程协作任务，18 国参与者）。在任务层级提取三类特征族：交互特征（14 项，二元相对量）、声学特征（10 项，逐说话人）、语言特征（21 项，来自 Distil-Whisper 转录）。三维评估协议：（1）留一对出（LODO）随机森林回归/分类，用 Lin 一致性相关系数（CCC）与 macro-F1；（2）按任务类别留一（LOCO）测跨任务泛化；（3）ICC(2,1) 重测信度，并在逐说话人 z-score 归一化前后对比。另用皮尔逊/斯皮尔曼相关分析话语权主导与对内认知负荷不对称的关系。
AI.result: （1）预测准确性：语言特征对时间需求 CCC=0.545，显著优于交互（0.379）与声学（0.205），词汇多样性（root TTR）为最强预测因子；（2）跨任务泛化：语言特征在社会类任务上崩塌至 CCC=0.009，揭示其学到的是任务专属词汇；（3）信度：声学原始 ICC=0.576，归一化后降至-0.112（降幅 119%），语言 ICC 由 0.090 降至-0.095；交互特征 ICC 始终为 0.193，因二元相对量天然免疫说话人身份膨胀；（4）权力分类所有特征族均接近 0.333 机会基线；（5）话语权不平衡与对内认知负荷差呈 r=0.315 显著相关。
AI.conclusion: 作者主张三项实践原则：（a）报告声学 ICC 前必须做说话人归一化，否则虚高；（b）应在 in-corpus 交叉验证之外补充跨上下文 LOCO 评估；（c）交互特征虽预测力中等、信度绝对值偏低，却是唯一可信的测量基础，适合实时参与感知系统部署。研究呼吁将说话人归一化与多维评估作为多模态对话 AI 特征选择与模型评估的标准前提。

title: Tokenizing Crosslingual Homographs
summary: Multilingual language models rely on shared subword vocabularies to represent multiple languages within a limited number of token units. While such sharing is often useful, it can also create cases in which identical surface forms are treated too uniformly across languages, even when their meanings or usage differ. We investigate this limitation through cross-lingual homographs and false friends, and examine whether introducing language information earlier in the tokenization process can improve their treatment. We propose a simple tokenizer-level intervention based on language cues: language-specific characters replacing initial characters of shared-vocabulary words, reducing common identity during vocabulary construction. In intrinsic analysis, we find through tokenizer-level statistics that BPE and UnigramLM often treat cross-lingual homographs in a largely language agnostic way, whereas the context-sensitive SaGe tokenizer diverges more strongly; our intervention removes this gap. In downstream English-to-X machine translation, our cues yield modest improvements in several settings, especially under BPE, although the effect is not consistent across all languages and evaluation sets. Overall, the findings suggest that adding lightweight language information at the tokenizer level is a promising direction for further exploration.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多语言模型中跨语言同形异义词（cross-lingual homographs）的分词问题，提出一种基于语言线索（language cues）的轻量级分词器级干预方法。该方法通过将同形词的首字符替换为语言特定的Unicode字符，帮助BPE和UnigramLM分词器在构建词汇表时区分跨语言同形词。实验表明，BPE和UnigramLM通常以语言无关的方式处理跨语言同形词，而上下文敏感的SaGe分词器则表现出更强的区分能力；在英到X机器翻译任务中，该方法在BPE设置下带来适度改进，但效果在不同语言和评估集上并不完全一致。
AI.motivation: 多语言大语言模型依赖共享子词词汇表来表示多种语言，但这种共享会导致跨语言同形异义词（甚至假朋友词false friends）被统一处理，从而在嵌入空间中混合不同语言的含义和用法模式。这种语言不平衡可能源于语料库大小、词频或上下文使用模式的差异，可能损害多语言模型在跨语言任务中的表现。论文旨在探索是否能在分词阶段更早地引入语言信息，以缓解这一问题。
AI.method: 1. 同形词集构建：从全语言词典库提取英语与各目标语言共享的表层形式，过滤短于3字符和频次低于5的词，得到包含专名、实体、假朋友、医学术语等的同形词集。2. 语言线索注入（Language Cues）：为每种语言定义26个Unicode字符（来自扩展拉丁Unicode区块），与英文字母一一对应。在分词器训练语料中，将同形词的首字符替换为对应语言的线索字符，破坏跨语言身份，但仍允许部分子词共享。3. 内部分析：比较BPE、UnigramLM和SaGe分词器在单语与多语设置下的分词模式，使用Earth Mover's Distance（EMD）量化差异；分析词汇表平均长度、Rényi效率、词长分布（fertility）。4. 下游评估：在OPUS-100和FLORES+数据集上进行英到X机器翻译，对比基线与线索系统的BLEU分数；同时训练小GPT模型比较token级和word级困惑度。5. 统计稳健性：通过1000次配对Bootstrap重采样检验BLEU差异的置信区间。6. 实例分析：检查假朋友词在翻译中的实际产出变化。
AI.result: 1. 内部分析：BPE和UnigramLM对跨语言同形词往往采用与单语相同的切分（语言无关），而SaGe分词器（即使是BPE初始化的）会产生更多不同的切分模式。线索注入缩小了这种差距，使BPE/ULM表现出类似SaGe的分化行为。2. 语言建模：线索模型在token级困惑度上几乎全部优于基线（所有6种语言对），但word级困惑度结果不一致（仅EN-IT在UnigramLM下略优），需谨慎解读。3. 机器翻译（BPE）：线索系统在大多数设置下带来小幅BLEU提升，FLORES+上改进尤为明显（如EN-IT、EN-RO、EN-DE）。Bootstrap分析显示EN-IT的FLORES+及其同形词子集的CI不跨零，显著有利于线索模型。4. 机器翻译（UnigramLM）：结果不一致，部分语言对有提升（如EN-DE、EN-FR的OPUS-100），EN-SV在FLORES+上出现显著下降。5. 实例分析：线索模型能将英语"tour"正确翻译为西语"gira"（而非借词tour），将"team"翻译为意语"squadra"（而非借词team），表明线索帮助模型选择本族词汇而非英语借词。6. 总体结论：效果依赖于分词器、语言对和评估集，BPE比UnigramLM更一致地从线索中受益。
AI.conclusion: 在多语言分词中引入轻量级语言线索是一个有前景但尚不成熟的方向。论文的发现表明，标准BPE和UnigramLM在处理跨语言同形词时确实存在语言无关的倾向，而简单地在分词阶段注入语言信号可以部分缓解这一问题，并在某些设置（尤其是BPE机器翻译）下带来适度但反复出现的改进。然而，结果的不一致性也表明该方法尚不能作为通用解决方案。未来工作可探索将语言线索发展为更通用的分词方法、扩展到多脚本场景、在更大规模多语言模型和其他任务上验证。论文的主要局限在于实验范围局限于拉丁字母的相近语言、仅针对选定的同形词集、未涵盖其他形式的跨语言歧义。

title: AEGIS: Awareness-Enhanced Guidance for Iterative Safeguard
summary: Span-level rationales are often assumed to improve controllability in text detoxification, but it remains unclear when such guidance helps and when it introduces trade-offs. We present Awareness-Enhanced Guidance for Iterative Safeguard (AEGIS) as an exploratory framework for studying span-guided multilingual detoxification across English, Mandarin Chinese, and Korean. AEGIS combines span-level detector outputs with frozen generator backbones, allowing harmful spans, intensity labels, and target attributes to be provided as structured guidance during rewriting. Rather than claiming state-of-the-art detoxification performance, we analyze how span guidance affects the balance between toxicity reduction and meaning preservation across generator families, model scales, and languages. Our results suggest that span-guided detoxification is conditionally useful: explicit rationales change the trade-off between toxicity reduction and meaning preservation, but their effects depend strongly on the generator backbone and the linguistic context. These findings highlight both the promise and the limitations of span-level control signals for multilingual detoxification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AEGIS框架,通过结合span级有害内容检测器与冻结的生成器骨干,系统性地研究span级引导在英语、普通话中文和韩语多语言文本去毒任务中的作用。论文核心发现是span级引导对去毒效果的影响是有条件的——它改变毒性降低与语义保留之间的权衡,但其效果强烈依赖于生成器骨干、模型规模和语言环境。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化去毒系统通常存在三个主要局限:(1) 检测粒度粗,多采用句子级分类,难以捕捉细粒度的span级线索;(2) 改写策略对整个句子进行修改,容易扭曲作者原意;(3) 跨语言适应性差,尤其在非英语语境中难以处理文化特定的仇恨表达。span级rationale虽然被直觉性地认为有助于可控去毒,但其实际效益——尤其是何时有益、何时会引入过度编辑或语义漂移等权衡——尚未得到系统研究。
AI.method: AEGIS采用模块化设计,包含两个核心组件:(1) **检测器**:基于XLM-R或InfoXLM多语言编码器,具有三任务头(句子级分类、5-way BIO token标记含强度标签、多标签目标属性分类),并使用CRF解码确保合法标签转移,通过阈值过滤低置信度span;(2) **生成器**:使用冻结的LLaMA 3.2和Qwen 3系列小规模模型,采用rationale引导的提示模板(标注span的偏移、类别、目标和强度)进行初始去毒,再通过自反思迭代优化(最多3轮),依据BERTScore和毒性阈值判断是否终止。损失函数结合三类任务,β=2.0以缓解O类与非O类的极端不平衡。
AI.result: 实验表明:(1) span级引导和反思机制均能改善BERTScore和LLM语义相似性,但反思会轻微降低语义得分换取毒性降低;(2) LLaMA骨干在英语中语义保留更强,Qwen在中文和韩语某些设置中毒性降低分数更高;(3) 迭代次数增加可改善非英语毒性得分,但可能伴随语义相似性下降;(4) 检测器作为固定仪器在三种语言上BIO F1均较高(XLM-R: 93.89-97.19%),但Non-O F1仅66-78%;(5) 定性案例显示系统能有效软化或删除有害表达,但不保证保留所有语用或意识形态内容。
AI.conclusion: span级引导应被视为一种可控性机制而非优越去毒性能的保证。其效果具有条件性,取决于生成器骨干、模型规模、语言和评价维度。未来工作需要纳入更强更新的基线、更大模型家族以及人类判断评估,以更准确地刻画span引导去毒在何时优于无引导或专有LLM改写。论文明确将自身定位为探索性分析而非SOTA声明,强调需谨慎对待span级控制信号。

title: C$^2$KV: Compressed and Composable KV Cache Reuse for Efficient LLM Inference
comment: 12 pages, 9 figures, accepted by ACM SIGKDD 2026
summary: Long-context inference is central to modern large language model (LLM) applications such as retrieval-augmented generation and multi-document reasoning. To mitigate the growing inference cost, recent work has explored key-value (KV) cache reuse to reduce redundant prefill computation. However, existing reuse methods primarily focus on computation savings and overlook a critical bottleneck in long-context LLM serving: the cost of storing and accessing large KV caches. While KV compression appears to be a natural complement, naively combining compression with non-prefix KV reuse often leads to severe accuracy degradation. In this work, we propose C$^2$KV, a unified framework for non-prefix KV reuse that jointly optimizes KV extraction and inference-time concatenation. C$^2$KV learns a composable and compressed KV cache manifold that is explicitly designed to be position-agnostic. Our approach introduces a lightweight sidecar Extractor with learnable compression tokens and a structured attention flow, enabling modular KV representations that can be flexibly reused and concatenated without modifying the frozen base model. We further employ a compression-concatenation co-training strategy to align extraction-time representations with their downstream reuse behavior. Extensive experiments across multiple long-context benchmarks and model families demonstrate that C$^2$KV significantly reduces KV cache storage and transfer costs, achieving up to 17$\times$ inference speedup under long contexts, while preserving generation quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 C²KV 框架，针对长上下文 LLM 推理中非前缀 KV 缓存复用的存储与带宽瓶颈，设计了一种可组合且可压缩的 KV 缓存流形。该方法通过轻量级旁路 Extractor（含可学习压缩令牌与结构化注意力流）实现位置无关的模块化 KV 表示，并采用压缩-拼接联合训练策略对齐提取与复用行为，在不修改冻结基座模型的前提下实现了最高 17× 的推理加速。
AI.motivation: 长上下文推理（如 RAG、多文档推理）面临两个关键瓶颈：(1) KV 缓存的计算冗余（已有非前缀复用方法如 CacheBlend、EPIC 等部分解决）；(2) 更关键的瓶颈——KV 缓存的存储与访存开销（现有方法忽视）。朴素地将通用 KV 压缩（如 SnapKV）与非前缀复用结合会导致严重的精度下降，因为标准 KV 表示具有上下文耦合性（non-composable）和位置依赖性，无法在不同上下文中灵活拼接。核心矛盾在于：压缩产生位置绑定的表示，而复用需要位置无关的可组合表示。
AI.method:
1. **C² Extractor（旁路模块）**：冻结基座 LLM，仅训练 (a) 可学习的 C² Tokens 嵌入向量（作为压缩存储槽）和 (b) 每层新增的 QKV 投影头（仅作用于 C² Tokens，维度与基座匹配，新增约 10% 参数）。
2. **结构化注意力流（SIF）**：通过块结构注意力掩码实现 — 原文档 Token 保持标准因果注意力且不关注 C² Tokens（保证原 Token 的隐藏态与冻结基座完全一致）；每个 C² Token 仅因果关注其对应块内的原 Token 与一个 sink block；C² Tokens 之间因果累积，使提取的 KV 天然位置无关。
3. **压缩-拼接联合训练（Co-training）**：以拼接后的多文档 KV 作为条件，仅通过标准的 SFT 语言建模损失监督生成答案；梯度仅回传至 Extractor 参数。由于文档顺序与数量在训练中变化，Extractor 被迫学习在任意组合下均有效的"可拼接"表示。
4. **复用时位置重对齐**：检索后按目标位置重新分配位置编码并进行 RoPE 重旋转。
AI.result: 在 LongBench（多文档 QA 与摘要）、RULER（4k–64k 长上下文检索）及 Qwen3-4B / Llama3.1-8B / Qwen2.5-7B / Qwen3-14B 等多模型上验证：(1) TTFT-精度权衡曲线处于最优左上区域，4× 压缩下长上下文推理最高实现 17× 加速；(2) 解码阶段 TBT 随上下文增长的曲线显著趋于平缓（带宽瓶颈缓解）；(3) 固定压缩比 4×/8×/16× 下均表现稳健，动态比率训练进一步增强泛化性；(4) 朴素组合 SnapKV 与复用方法会导致精度崩溃（BlockAttn+SnapKV 在 HotpotQA 上从 0.4271 降至 0.0547），反向验证了 C²KV 的设计必要性；(5) 消融实验证实结构化注意力流、位置重对齐、块局部约束均为关键设计。
AI.conclusion: C²KV 重新审视了非前缀 KV 复用的瓶颈，将存储与带宽而非计算视为核心挑战，提出了首个联合优化压缩与拼接的统一框架。其核心贡献在于通过结构化注意力流将 KV 提取与上下文解耦，学习得到位置无关、可任意组合的压缩表示，同时完全保留冻结基座模型参数。该工作为长上下文 LLM 服务系统提供了兼具高效与可组合性的 KV 缓存解决方案，未来可拓展至在线增量提取与自适应压缩策略。

title: Large Language Models for Citation Function Classification
comment: Published at the 15th edition of the Language Resources and Evaluation Conference (LREC 2026)
summary: Citation function classification plays a crucial role in understanding the relationships between scientific publications and advancing bibliometric analysis. This study presents one of the first comprehensive evaluations of multiple state-of-the-art (SOTA) large language models (LLMs) for citation function classification, achieving new SOTA results on the ACL-ARC dataset. We systematically compare five models (Mistral 7B, Orca 2-7B, LLaMA 3.1-8B, Falcon 7B, and SciBERT) across zero-shot, few-shot, and fine-tuning approaches. Our fine-tuned Falcon 7B model achieves a 73.3% macro F1 score on ACL-ARC, representing a significant improvement over previous methods. Additionally, we introduce AC3, a novel dataset featuring a seven-category annotation scheme that distinguishes between neutral acknowledgments and explicit evaluative stances (more opinion-oriented citations - criticizing, complimenting, contradicting). The dataset is implemented across four context extraction variants to systematically evaluate the impact of contextual scope on classification performance. We also provide detailed analysis of model performance, experimental configurations, and limitations to guide future research in this domain. To our knowledge, this is one of the first studies dedicated to comprehensive model comparison for citation function classification, addressing a gap identified in recent surveys.

AI.tldr: 本文对五种主流语言模型（Mistral 7B、Orca 2-7B、LLaMA 3.1-8B、Falcon 7B、SciBERT）在引文功能分类任务上进行了系统性评估，在ACL-ARC数据集上以微调后的Falcon 7B取得73.3%宏F1的新SOTA结果。同时提出了AC3新数据集，采用七类标注方案以区分中性引用与评价性引用（批评、赞扬、矛盾）。
AI.motivation: （1）引文功能分类对理解科学文献关系和推进文献计量分析至关重要，但传统方法将所有引文等同视之，忽略了引用背后不同的功能意图（如支持、批评、对比等）。（2）现有引文分类方案（如ACL-ARC的六类方案）将语义差异显著的引文类型（如批评、赞扬、矛盾）合并到同一类别（如Compare_contrast），降低了细粒度分析的实用性。（3）尽管大语言模型在NLP领域取得突破，但其在引文分类任务上的系统对比研究仍然匮乏，现有研究多聚焦于单一模型或较旧架构。
AI.method: （1）评估数据集：使用ACL-ARC（1,941条引文，六类标注）作为基准；构建新数据集AC3（530条引文，涵盖ArXiv九个学科领域，七类标注）。（2）标注方案：AC3采用七类体系——Criticizing、Compliment、Comparison、Use、Substantiating、Contradiction、Basis，将中性引用与评价性引用明确区分；由两位标注员迭代标注，最终Cohen's Kappa达71%。（3）上下文提取策略：设计四种变体（全段落、引用前30词后10词、引用所在句加前一句、引用所在句加前后各一句）。（4）模型与范式：评估5个模型在零样本、少样本（每类一个示例）、微调三种范式下的表现；微调采用序列分类方式（线性分类头+池化输出），使用加权交叉熵损失处理类别不平衡；各模型使用差异化学习率（Falcon 5e-5、SciBERT 2e-5等）。（5）评估指标：宏F1值。
AI.result: （1）ACL-ARC结果：微调Falcon 7B以73.3%宏F1（测试集76.35%）取得新SOTA，超越此前最佳方法（Nambanoor Kunnath等2022的70.8%）；SciBERT以75.14%表现竞争性。（2）少样本/零样本表现显著低于微调（如Falcon 7B零样本仅1.38%，微调后76.35%），表明微调对竞争性表现不可或缺。（3）Orca 2-7B零样本表现最佳（47.63%），体现其推理导向设计的优势。（4）模型规模与性能不直接相关：Falcon 7B（7B）优于更大的LLaMA 3.1-8B（8B）。（5）AC3数据集结果远低于ACL-ARC（最佳仅约22%），所有模型在稀有类别（Criticizing、Compliment、Contradiction，占比不足8%）上几乎无法正确分类。（6）上下文提取策略最优选择因模型而异：Mistral 7B偏好"前30词后10词"窗口，全段落上下文常引入噪声。
AI.conclusion: （1）本文是首个针对引文功能分类任务的LLM架构系统性比较研究，填补了该领域的研究空白。（2）微调是实现竞争性表现的关键，零样本和少样本范式均不充分。（3）模型参数规模并非性能的决定因素，架构与训练数据质量可能更为关键；领域专用模型（如SciBERT）虽参数小但仍具竞争力。（4）稀有但语义复杂的评价性引文类别对所有模型构成重大挑战，微调后仍受类别不平衡影响。（5）最优上下文提取策略具有模型依赖性，不存在通用最优方案。（6）AC3数据集已公开，为未来研究提供了更细粒度的评价性引文分析资源。局限：类别不平衡严重、上下文提取策略仍为预定义窗口、仅覆盖英文科学文献。

title: When to Use Extra Context: Evidence-Grounded Terminology Adaptation for Simultaneous Speech Translation
summary: Extra context is valuable for simultaneous speech translation of technical talks, but injecting the entire document context into every streaming segment is often too coarse. Through diagnostic experiments, we find that context gains mainly come from paper-specific terminology recovery rather than uniform semantic enhancement. We therefore propose EGTA, an Evidence-Grounded Terminology Adaptation framework that builds a document terminology memory, selects compact candidate terms conditioned on the current streaming state, and adapts ASR/speech-side and decoder-side decision spaces using only the selected terms. EGTA can be instantiated in cascaded, end-to-end, and generation-only SimulST settings without full-model fine-tuning. We evaluate EGTA on an ACL technical-talk SimulST evaluation suite consisting of MCIF-dev and ACL60/60-dev. On MCIF-dev, EGTA-RG improves BLEU by +1.05/+0.59, XCOMET-XL by +0.019/+0.006, named-entity recall by +79\%/+73\% relative, and acronym recall by +0.099/+0.171 on En$\rightarrow$Zh and En$\rightarrow$De. Across MCIF-dev latency settings, EGTA consistently improves XCOMET-XL, named-entity recall, and acronym recall. External validation on ACL60/60-dev further shows consistent terminology-recall gains without additional fine-tuning. Shuffled-memory controls and activation audits provide evidence that the improvements are tied to paper-specific evidence alignment rather than generic context prompting.

AI.tldr: 本文针对技术演讲场景下的同声传译（SimulST），提出EGTA（Evidence-Grounded Terminology Adaptation）框架，通过构建文档术语记忆库并基于当前流式状态进行证据条件化的候选术语选择，避免将完整文档上下文粗粒度地注入每个流式片段，从而提升论文特有术语（如缩写、模型名、命名实体）的翻译保真度。
AI.motivation: 技术演讲中的同声传译面临论文特有术语（缩写、模型名、数据集名、方法名等）频繁出现且难以正确翻译的挑战。直接的做法是将完整文档上下文（如标题、摘要）注入每个流式片段，但诊断实验表明这种统一注入策略过于粗糙——上下文带来的增益主要来自论文特有术语的恢复，而非均匀的语义增强；许多片段并不需要文档特定术语，只有少数片段需要精确的术语保留。因此需要从"是否使用上下文"转向"何时使用上下文以及在哪里应用"。
AI.method: EGTA框架包含三阶段：（1）术语记忆构建——利用Qwen3-30B-Instruct从标题、摘要等文档级上下文中自动提取候选术语（缩写、字母数字/连字符术语、CamelCase术语、多词技术短语、人名/组织名），并进行规范化；（2）证据条件化候选选择——对每个流式片段，基于当前ASR假设、部分转写或近邻历史等本地证据，通过规范化表面形式匹配从术语记忆中选出top-K个证据支持的术语子集（按精确匹配、缩写匹配、专长度和近期度排序）；（3）ASR/语音端与解码端双通道适应——EGTA-R将选定术语作为紧凑术语上下文（端到端）或ASR热词（级联），EGTA-G在解码端对选定术语对应的词表token施加对数偏置（B=2），EGTA-RG组合两者。该框架无需全模型微调，可应用于级联、端到端和仅生成三种SimulST架构。
AI.result: 在MCIF-dev（21场报告、919片段）和ACL60/60-dev（5场报告、468片段）上基于Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B端到端骨干：MCIF-dev锚点处En→Zh/De上BLEU提升+1.05/+0.59，XCOMET-XL提升+0.019/+0.006，NER_clean召回率绝对提升+0.212/+0.266（相对+79%/+73%），缩写召回率提升+0.099/+0.171，延迟（LongLAAL_CU）降低46/44ms；ACL60/60-dev外部验证无微调下术语召回同样持续提升；五个延迟操作点上EGTA-RG在XCOMET-XL、NER和缩写召回上均持续优于基线和统一上下文变体。接地验证显示96%/93.9%的激活有同篇报告支持、仅4.0%/6.1%为无支持激活；洗牌记忆控制表明增益依赖正确的论文记忆（De上NER增益从+0.266降至+0.012）；证据强度桶分析表明高/中证据片段获得最大NER增益、低证据片段几无chrF变化（+0.3/+0.4），支持"按需激活"而非"过度偏置"。全局偏置应力测试（B=5）出现BLEU下降和延迟崩溃，验证选择性偏置的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 技术演讲SimulST中，额外文档上下文应以"证据条件化的术语适应"形式而非"统一语义注入"形式加以利用；EGTA通过紧凑的术语记忆和流式证据条件化的候选选择，在不进行全模型微调的前提下实现术语保真度、整体翻译质量和延迟三者的更优权衡，其增益源自论文特定证据对齐而非通用上下文提示。

title: ESCUCHA: A Spanish Speech Benchmark for Heterogeneous Acoustic Conditions
summary: As large audio language models (LALMs) advance, robust evaluation frameworks have become essential. In this context, Spanish speech understanding under realistic acoustic conditions has received particularly little attention. We introduce ESCUCHA, the first Spanish speech understanding benchmark designed to evaluate LALMs across heterogeneous acoustic conditions and reasoning abilities. ESCUCHA comprises 1,000 human-curated questions paired with audio, totaling 162.9 hours sourced directly ``from the wild'' rather than drawn from existing datasets, with durations ranging from a few seconds to over 80 minutes. The benchmark emphasizes reasoning, spanning 9 perceptual and 10 reasoning categories, and it captures linguistic diversity through multiple Spanish accents and non-normative speech. ESCUCHA further includes multi-audio questions, spoken questions, and audio instructions, and it flags which questions support open-ended evaluation. Benchmarking several state-of-the-art multimodal and speech models reveals substantial performance gaps relative to trained humans.

AI.tldr: ESCUCHA 是首个面向西班牙语的真实场景语音理解基准，包含 1,000 道人工策划的问题与 162.9 小时"野外"音频，采用 9 项感知+10 项推理的多标签分类法，并首次纳入非规范性病理语音（ALS 与中风后构音障碍），对多个 LALM 进行评测，发现人机差距显著（人类 90.10% vs 最佳模型 Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B 74.40%），级联 ASR+LLM 系统甚至优于除该模型外的所有端到端音频模型。
AI.motivation: 现有 LALM 评测基准以英语、规范语音、朗读或策划音频为主，存在训练-测试污染风险，且缺乏对西班牙语及非规范性病理语音（如 ALS、中风后构音障碍）的覆盖，无法衡量模型在真实、多样化声学条件下的泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出四阶段构建流水线：(1) 目标设定与分类法精炼；(2) 从 YouTube 采集真实音频，由 3 位语言学家+3 位技术专家撰写问题与干扰项；(3) Gemma-4-31B-IT 辅助审查（分类、音频必要性、干扰项难度、语法）；(4) 模型与人类评测。评测体系涵盖四类系统：端到端 LALM（Audio-Flamingo-3、Qwen2.5-Omni、Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B、Voxtral-Mini、Gemma-4-12B-IT、Gemini-2.5-Flash）、级联系统（Whisper-Large-v3+Qwen3-4B）、纯文本 LLM 基线，并设立人类专家上限。评估格式包括 MCQA（900 题）与音频指令遵循 AIF（100 题），采用精确匹配评分。
AI.result: 人类专家 90.10% 远超最佳模型 Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B（74.40%）；其余音频模型集中在 49–53%。Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B 在所有列均领先，AIF 子集 88% 甚至超过人类 79%。在病理语音子集上，Gemini-2.5-Flash 与 Gemma-4-12B-IT 分别下降 19 与 15 个百分点；Audio-Flamingo-3、Qwen3-Omni-30B、Voxtral-Mini 保持稳定或略升，表明病理语音仍是 LALM 弱项。级联系统（Whisper+Qwen3-4B）以 60% 超越除 Qwen3-Omni-30B 之外的所有单一音频模型，说明大量问题依赖词汇理解，残差部分才是真正需要声学推理之处。相较 MMAU-Pro，Audio-Flamingo-3 与 Qwen2.5-Omni-7B 分数均明显下降（58.8%→49.60%，57.4%→50.60%），表明 ESCUCHA 在西班牙语条件下更具区分度。纯文本 Qwen3-4B 达 41%，显示部分问题可由语言先验部分解答。
AI.conclusion: ESCUCHA 填补了西班牙语真实场景语音理解的基准空白，揭示了 LALM 在病理语音上的持续短板，并量化了级联系统相对端到端模型的竞争力。未来工作将扩展更多神经性病理条件，并填补稀疏的感知-推理组合类别。

title: When a Name Is Not a Name: A Benchmark Dataset and Distilled Reasoning for Culturally Entangled Bangla Homographs in Low-Resource LLMs
summary: Many Bangla words are at once personal names and culturally loaded common nouns, "Maya" is both a girl's name and a word for affectionate compassion. Choosing the right reading demands cultural knowledge that is scarce in the pretraining data of modern language models. We introduce Culturally Entangled Homograph (CEH) disambiguation and build a Bangla benchmark of 1,516 expert-verified sentences (3,032 labelled occurrences) in which one word appears twice with two distinct readings, each labelled with a culturally grounded category and an explanation of the reasoning behind it. Across open- and closed-source models, we find a systematic dominant-meaning bias: models default to the common-noun sense and overlook the name. A Bangla-specific model fails under every prompting regime we test, showing that language-specific pretraining alone does not confer cultural grounding. We further show that contrastive chain-of-thought prompting can sharply reduce this bias without training, and that distilling cultural explanations teaches small (1-3B) models to reason toward the correct reading rather than memorise labels, cutting dominant-meaning bias from as high as 100% to under 5% and turning the failed Bangla-specific model into our strongest system. Dataset and code are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"文化纠缠同形异义词"（CEH）消歧任务，构建了一个包含1,516个孟加拉语句子的专家验证基准（3,032个标注出现），揭示了LLM在低资源语言文化理解上存在的"主导意义偏见"（dominant-meaning bias），并通过对比性思维链提示（C-CoT）和QLoRA知识蒸馏将偏见从最高100%降至5%以下，使原本失败的孟加拉语专用模型TituLLM成为最强系统。
AI.motivation: 在孟加拉语中，许多词汇同时是人名和承载文化内涵的普通名词（如"Maya"既是女孩名也表示深情），正确消歧需要文化知识，而现代语言模型的预训练数据中此类低资源文化知识稀缺。现有研究多关注知识、推理和分类任务，对日常词汇使用中的文化基础（cultural grounding）研究不足。论文旨在验证：语言专属预训练是否足以赋予文化理解能力？
AI.method: 1) **任务定义**：CEH消歧——同一词在同句中出现两次，需分别标注为Name/Concept/Emotion/Emotional State/Collective State/Spiritual六类之一，并给出文化推理解释。2) **数据集构建**：由母语者人工筛选兼具人名与文化概念双重读音的词（如Maya、Asha、Gagan），使用三种SOTA模型（Claude、Kimi、Gemini）多模型生成，交叉验证后由两位母语专家人工审核（κ=0.95）。3) **四种评估范式**：零样本、少样本、对比性思维链（C-CoT，强制模型对每次出现同时论证"人名"和"竞争文化类别"两种解读）、QLoRA知识蒸馏微调（监督目标为完整文化解释+标签，而非仅标签）。4) **模型**：开源模型（Qwen2.5-1.5B、Llama-3.2-3B、Gemma-3-1B、Ministral-3B、孟加拉语专用TituLLM）与闭源GPT-4o-mini。
AI.result: **核心发现**：1) 零样本下所有开源模型均表现出严重主导意义偏见（62.5%–100%），孟加拉语专用TituLLM在所有提示范式下完全失败（100%幻觉）。2) C-CoT对Qwen2.5效果显著（偏见从63.46%降至2.88%），但对Llama-3.2反有害（升至75%），效果强烈依赖模型。3) QLoRA-KD带来决定性提升：所有蒸馏模型精确匹配率超82%，偏见降至≤4.2%，TituLLM从失败变为最强系统（EM 87.91%）。4) 消融实验证实：仅标签蒸馏（EM 41.33%）远不如完整推理蒸馏（EM 85.16%）。5) 人类与LLM法官评估结果高度一致（误差≤1分），TituLLM经蒸馏后获得87%精确匹配的文化忠实预测。6) 残差错误集中于长尾标签（Emotion F1最低0.59，Spiritual 0.62），Name类几乎完美恢复（F1≥0.98）。
AI.conclusion: 文化基础不能仅靠单语预训练获得，但可通过带推理标注的监督信号有效注入。关键洞察：语言专属预训练提供了更好的"基质"（更忠实的分词与更密集的相关词汇暴露），使得有限的推理监督能被更高效吸收——这是低资源文化丰富语言的实用路径。论文贡献包括：（i）形式化CEH消歧任务，（ii）发布含文化推理解释的孟加拉语基准，（iii）系统评估四种范式揭示偏见，（iv）证明对比推理与蒸馏监督能有效缓解偏见。该框架具有语言无关性，可推广至其他具有类似人名-概念纠缠的语言。

title: What Transfers Under Source Shift? Definitions, Examples, and Fine-Tuning for Climate Disclosure Classification
comment: 15 pages, 12 figures. Code: this https URL
summary: Climate disclosure classification is a fundamental task for analysing corporate climate disclosures, yet such disclosures appear in many different sources -- annual reports, press releases, and earnings calls -- that differ in length, purpose, and writing style. Existing evaluations are mostly conducted within a single source, leaving open whether common LLM adaptation strategies remain effective under source shift. We reframe climate disclosure classification as a cross-source adaptation problem and study three widely used adaptation strategies -- definitions, examples, and fine-tuning -- across eleven open- and closed-source LLMs, using two corpora that share the same label space but come from different sources. We find that all strategies bring positive cross-source gains on average, but the strongest in-source strategies are not the strongest cross-source ones: similarity-based retrieval and LoRA fine-tuning gain most in-source but lose most of that advantage under source shift; randomly selected few-shot examples, a weaker in-source baseline, retain their advantage more reliably; definitions transfer most consistently, though only when their granularity matches the target text. Across these strategies, when the source changes, simpler is often safer.

AI.tldr: 本文将企业气候信息披露（TCFD 四支柱）分类重构为跨源（cross-source）适配问题，在 11 个开源/闭源 LLM 上系统比较了定义（definitions）、示例（examples）、LoRA 微调（fine-tuning）三种适配策略。研究发现：源内最强的策略不一定是跨源最强的策略——相似度检索与 LoRA 微调在源内增益最大，却在源切换后损失最多优势；粒度匹配的定义和随机少样本示例反而跨源更稳健。核心结论是"源一变，简单更安全"。
AI.motivation: 气候信息披露分析的实际部署场景涉及年报、新闻稿、财报电话会议等多种文本源，这些源在长度、目的、文风上差异显著，但现有 TCFD 分类研究几乎只在单一源（年报/可持续发展报告）内评估，导致研究覆盖的源与实际部署的源之间存在明显落差。因此亟需回答一个部署导向的核心问题：当分类器遇到新披露源时，常见的 LLM 适配策略（更丰富的定义、示例检索、微调）是否仍然可靠。
AI.method: 使用两个共享 TCFD 四类标签空间但来源不同的语料：TCFD-CR（公司年报与可持续发展报告，1,000 条训练/验证 + 320 条测试）作为源，TCFD-EX（TCFD 官网示例披露，593 条）作为跨源目标；通过 logistic regression 源分类器（5-fold 81.2%，代理 A-距离≈1.25）确认两者存在显著分布差异。三类适配策略分别为：（1）四级定义阶梯 D0–D3（标签名→支柱意图→11 项 Recommended Disclosures→27 项实施准则）的零样本提示；（2）示例选择规则对比零样本、随机、TF-IDF 检索、稠密检索（all-mpnet-base-v2），扫描 k∈{3,5,8}、n∈{2,3}；（3）QLoRA 微调（r=16, α=32, 4-bit），在 Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen3-8B/3-32B/3.5-9B 上三随机种子训练。覆盖 11 个 LLM（Qwen2.5-7B、Qwen3-8B、Qwen3.5-9B/27B、Qwen3-32B、Llama-3.1-8B、Llama-4-Scout、Llama-3.3-70B、Ministral-8B、GPT-4o、GPT-5-mini），统一报告 macro-F1，并对比 in-source 与 cross-source 增益。
AI.result: 1) 四种策略均带来正向平均跨源增益，但 in-source 冠军并非 cross-source 冠军。LoRA+D1 源内增益 +14.1pp，跨源仅保留 +3.7pp；TF-IDF/稠密检索源内 +8.0/+7.9pp，跨源仅 +0.5/+1.0pp；定义与随机少样本则跨源更稳健（甚至略高于源内）。2) 定义并非越细越好：平均而言 TCFD-CR 在 D1 达到峰值，TCFD-EX 在 D2 达到峰值，D3 在两源均出现下降；没有任何模型在 TCFD-EX 上的峰值定义层级早于其在 TCFD-CR 上的层级——TCFD-EX 因措辞更贴近 Recommended Disclosures，需要更具体的定义。3) 检索在源内大幅优于随机，但在跨源下随机更可靠：固定 k=8,n=2 后，TF-IDF/稠密检索呈现明显的 in-source–cross-source 差距，而随机少样本几乎没有稳定差距；相似度假设（文本相似≈标签相似）在源切换后弱化。4) LoRA 微调在所有四个基座上一致出现 −4.4 至 −6.7pp 的跨源下降；冻结适配器、在推理时替换为 D1 定义提示可使跨源性能恢复 +0.4 至 +2.4pp（强基座上更明显），说明微调损失部分源于训练信号缺少显式标签语义。
AI.conclusion: 本文给出三条面向部署的"更安全默认"建议：(a) 定义提示的粒度应与目标文本匹配，而非追求最详细；(b) 跨源少样本适配应优先选择小规模随机示例池，而非看似更强的相似度检索器；(c) 即使模型已微调，推理时仍应保留定义提示，跨源鲁棒性是权重与提示的联合设计问题。局限在于跨源评估仅基于目前唯一公开可用的 TCFD 共享标签跨源数据集对（TCFD-CR→TCFD-EX）。总体启示：当源发生变化时，最强的源内选择往往不是最强的跨源选择，"简单更安全"。

title: An Early Warning of Emerging Biosecurity Risks in Frontier LLMs
comment: 22 pages, 7 figures, authors are listed alphabetically by surname
summary: Frontier large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into scientific workflows, yet their growing biological capabilities may outpace current safeguards. To assess the biological risks of frontier models, we develop Intern-BioBreaker, a specialized bio-red-teaming model, together with an integrated computational-to-physical framework that couples model-level stress testing with wet-lab validation. Within this framework, Intern-BioBreaker generates targeted jailbreak prompts to test whether aligned models can be induced to provide operational guidance for safety-sensitive biological tasks or produce sequence-level outputs with potentially harmful properties. Selected sequence outputs are then carried forward for DNA synthesis, host expression, and orthogonal protein verification to assess whether model-generated designs can yield the intended biological products. Our evaluation reveals a concerning gap between text-level safeguards and the risks posed by capable scientific models: (i) Intern-BioBreaker outperforms baseline attack models and reveals widespread bio-risk jailbreak vulnerabilities across both open-weight and proprietary frontier LLMs, with several targets reaching near-saturated or 100% task-level attack success rate (ASR); (ii) in sequence-level case studies, GPT-5.5 can be induced to generate modified viral candidate sequences with pathogenic potential; the corresponding translated proteins may exhibit even stronger receptor-binding affinity and thus enhanced infection potential; and (iii) end-to-end verification shows that selected model-generated biological designs are not merely textual artifacts, but can be physically realized under controlled experimental settings. These findings underscore the need for stronger biological red-teaming, nucleic acid synthesis screening, and safety mechanisms that keep pace with model capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Intern-BioBreaker，一种专门的生物领域红队模型，并构建了"计算-物理"一体化框架，用于评估前沿大语言模型（LLMs）的生物安全风险。通过越狱攻击提示生成、DNA合成、宿主表达和蛋白验证等环节，证明当前LLM在生物安全方面的文本级防护与实际能力存在显著差距，部分模型可被诱导生成具有潜在致病性的病毒序列设计，且这些设计在实验条件下可被物理实现。
AI.motivation: 随着前沿大语言模型（LLMs）被广泛整合到科学研究流程中，其日益增强的生物能力可能超越现有安全防护机制。当前的生物安全评估多停留在文本层面，缺乏对模型生成序列是否能在真实实验中实现危害的端到端验证，亟需一种能够桥接计算测试与湿实验验证的系统性评估框架。
AI.method: 1. **Intern-BioBreaker模型开发**：训练一个专门的生物领域红队（red-teaming）模型，用于生成针对性的越狱提示（jailbreak prompts），测试目标对齐LLM是否能被诱导提供安全敏感生物任务的实操指导或生成具有潜在危害属性的序列级输出。2. **计算-物理一体化框架**：将模型级压力测试与湿实验验证耦合，覆盖DNA合成、宿主表达、正交蛋白验证（orthogonal protein verification）等环节。3. **评估维度**：包括任务级攻击成功率（ASR）、序列级致病潜力分析（如受体结合亲和力预测）以及端到端物理可实现性验证。
AI.result: （i）Intern-BioBreaker在攻击效果上优于基线攻击模型，揭示了开源和闭源前沿LLM普遍存在生物风险越狱漏洞，部分目标的攻击成功率接近饱和或达100%；（ii）在序列级案例研究中，GPT-5.5可被诱导生成具有致病潜力的改良病毒候选序列，其翻译蛋白可能展现出更强的受体结合亲和力及感染潜力；（iii）端到端验证表明，选定的模型生成生物设计不仅是文本产物，在受控实验条件下可被物理实现。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了前沿LLM在生物安全方面存在文本级防护与实际能力之间的显著鸿沟，强调需要加强生物红队测试、核酸合成筛查以及与模型能力同步演进的安全机制，以应对日益增长的生物滥用风险。

title: Pancasila-Dilemmas: Evaluating Large Language Models on Indonesian Human Value Dilemmas Grounded in Pancasila
summary: The value alignment of large language models (LLMs) is crucial for ensuring responses align with human intention and value preferences. However, most evaluations of value alignment focus on Western or universal values, while assessments grounded in the value systems of specific countries remain scarce. In this paper, we introduce Pancasila-Dilemmas, an evaluation dataset of 1,834 questions derived from Indonesian news, classified by 5 values of Pancasila: Religion, Humanity, Unity, Democracy, and Social Justice. This dataset reflects daily life in Indonesia, making it suitable for measuring the value alignment of LLMs deployed for Indonesia. To ensure a more rigorous evaluation, we choose scenarios containing dilemmas. The dataset is proofread by native speakers and answered by 5 diverse Indonesian citizens. We evaluate 50 closed- and open-source LLMs on our dataset. Results reveal that all evaluated LLMs achieves less than 0.5 Probability Match Score (PMS) and 0.72 Max-Vote Agreement Score (MVAS). Compared by each values, LLMs mostly struggle in Religion and Unity dilemma cases. This highlights a significant gap in capturing Indonesian values. The dataset is publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Pancasila-Dilemmas数据集，包含1,834道基于印度尼西亚新闻构建的两难选择题，按潘查希拉五项核心价值观（宗教、人道、统一、民主、社会正义）分类，用于评估50个闭源与开源大语言模型对印尼本土价值观的对齐程度。结果显示所有模型的概率匹配分数（PMS）均低于0.5、最大投票一致率（MVAS）低于0.72，尤其在"宗教"和"统一"类两难问题上表现最差，揭示了当前LLM在印尼价值观对齐上的显著缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现有的大语言模型价值对齐评估主要聚焦于西方或普世价值观，缺乏针对特定国家（尤其是印度尼西亚）价值体系的评估基准。潘查希拉作为印尼的国家意识形态和道德基础，尚未有专门用于评估LLM在该价值观框架下表现的标准化基准。此外，传统价值对齐基准多依赖单一标准答案或多数投票，简化了道德推理中存在的规范复杂性，无法反映真实世界中两难情境下的人类决策多样性。
AI.method: 1. 数据采集：从印尼最大新闻门户Kompas爬取2024年全年279,362条新闻标题，经MinHash去重后保留9,155条；2. 两难场景识别：使用GPT-4o结合4-shot提示识别含价值冲突的新闻，筛选出2,075篇；3. 题目生成：使用GPT-4o为每篇新闻生成包含场景、问题和四个选项的多选题，并按潘查希拉五项价值分类标注；4. 选项映射：基于Thomas-Kilmann冲突模式工具（TKI），将每个选项映射到竞争、迁就、回避、合作、妥协五种冲突应对模式；5. 质量审核：由2位印尼母语博士校对，最终保留1,834道题；6. 人类标注：185位来自印尼8个地区、17个民族的多元化参与者，每题由5人标注；7. 模型评估：在Pancasila Prompt和Universal Prompt两种设置下，评估50个LLM（涵盖API模型、指令调优模型和基础模型），使用概率匹配分数（PMS）和最大投票一致率（MVAS）作为评估指标。
AI.result: 1. 整体表现欠佳：所有50个评估LLM的PMS均约为0.50，MVAS约为0.72，表明当前LLM在印尼价值观对齐上存在显著差距；2. 价值维度差异：模型在"民主"类两难问题上表现最佳（具有全球普适性），而在"宗教"和"统一"问题上表现最差且方差最大；3. 模型规模效应：更大参数的模型表现更优，如Qwen3系列从0.6B到32B性能稳步提升；4. 区域训练效果：印尼和东南亚专用模型（如Sahabatai-v1、SEA-LION）在所有五项价值上保持稳定均衡的表现，验证了本土化预训练的价值；5. 提示策略效果：Universal Prompt普遍略优于Pancasila Prompt，但对印尼语境理解较好的模型（如Gemini-3.1-Pro、Sahabatai）在Pancasila Prompt下表现更佳；6. 开放式生成偏差：LLM在开放式回答中过度倾向于"合作"策略（占比超过75%），而人类标注在各策略上分布更均衡。
AI.conclusion: 本研究构建了首个基于潘查希拉价值观的印尼两难情境主观多选评估基准Pancasila-Dilemmas，填补了非西方价值观对齐评估的空白。实验表明当前LLM（即使是SOTA模型）在理解和反映印尼本土价值观方面存在严重不足，尤其在涉及宗教和国家统一等敏感议题上。区域化和印尼本土化的预训练能够带来一定改善，但整体对齐效果仍不理想。未来工作需进一步提升LLM对印尼多元化人类价值观的对齐能力，避免因文化误读而引发宗教冒犯或社会分裂等实际风险。

title: Modeling turn-taking with distant viewing: investigating silence thresholds in human and AI-generated discourse
comment: 10 pages, MeSSH26 (Méthodes pour les sciences sociales et les humanités - Methods for social sciences and humanities 2026)
summary: This study investigates silence gaps in two kinds of audiovisual material. We analysed thirty US situational comedies and fifty-one synthetic podcasts generated with Google NotebookLM. Gaps were compared across speaker gender, assigned from a fundamental-frequency threshold estimated in Praat, and across production settings.

AI.tldr: 该研究考察了美国情景喜剧（30部）与由Google NotebookLM生成的合成播客（51个）中说话者间的"沉默间隙"（silence gaps），比较了不同性别（通过Praat基频阈值判定）与不同制作情境下的沉默模式差异。
AI.motivation: 研究动机在于揭示不同制作语境（真人影视对白 vs. AI合成播客）中说话者间沉默停顿的模式差异，特别是性别因素与制作方式如何影响对话中的沉默时长与分布。该问题在语音学、性别语言学以及AI生成语音研究中均具有意义。
AI.method: 语料：30部美国情景喜剧 + 51个由Google NotebookLM生成的合成播客。方法：使用Praat软件估算基频（F0）并以此设定阈值来判定说话者性别；比较两类语料在沉默间隙上的差异，跨性别与制作情境两个变量进行分析。
AI.result: 所提供内容仅为摘要式描述，未呈现具体的统计结果、数值或显著性发现。仅有研究设计与变量的陈述。
AI.conclusion: 所提供内容未包含结论部分，无法从现有文本中归纳研究发现或意义。

title: VDAR-Router: Adaptive LLMs Routing via Verbalized Query Difficulty Analysis Retrieval
summary: Large language models are increasingly used in practical systems, making efficient model selection important for reducing deployment cost. LLM routing has emerged as a practical solution for allocating each input query to an appropriate model under a desired cost-performance trade-off. Existing routing methods often estimate model suitability from the surface semantics or embedding similarity of the input query. However, such methods may ignore the underlying difficulty of a query, leading to suboptimal routing decisions. To address the challenge, we propose VDAR-Router, a difficulty-aware retrieval-based routing framework. For each input query, VDAR-Router first generates an explicit difficulty analysis. It then retrieves historical examples with similar difficulty profiles. Based on the retrieved records, it estimates candidate model suitability and selects the model using a reward function that considers both performance and cost. Experiments on three datasets show that VDAR-Router consistently achieves better cost-performance trade-offs than existing baselines. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of difficulty-aware retrieval for training-free LLM routing. Case studies further show that explicit query analysis helps retrieve more relevant examples and supports more reliable routing decisions.

AI.tldr: VDAR-Router提出了一种基于"难度分析检索"的无训练LLM路由框架，通过生成查询的显式难度分析（7个能力维度）作为检索键，而非依赖查询的表面语义或嵌入相似度，从而更精准地匹配历史示例、评估候选模型，实现更好的成本-性能权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM路由方法主要基于查询的表面语义（如主题、措辞、任务类别）或嵌入相似度来估计模型适用性，但这些方法忽略了查询的底层难度特性。例如，两个表面相似的网站生成任务可能在难度上差异很大，而两个表面无关的算术题可能难度相似。这种"难度不匹配"导致路由决策次优。需要一种能够理解查询真实能力需求的路由方法。
AI.method: VDAR-Router是一个无需训练的检索式路由框架，包含三个关键组件：1) **Difficulty Analyst**：使用LLM作为分析代理，在7个能力维度（推理、理解、指令遵循、代理能力、知识检索、编码、多语言）上评估查询难度；2) **Difficulty Analysis DB**：离线为训练集查询生成难度分析并嵌入存储；3) **Reward-based Routing**：测试时为新查询生成难度分析，检索top-k相似的历史难度分析，基于这些检索示例上各模型的性能与成本，用奖励函数 R(m|q) = α·p_m - β·c_m（其中α+β=1）选择最优模型。使用Gemma4-31B、Qwen3.5-4B/2B作为分析模型，Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B作为嵌入模型。
AI.result: 在三个数据集（RouterBench、LLMRouterBench、ArenaExpert5K）上的实验表明：1) VDAR-Router在成本-性能权衡（Reward指标）上持续优于KNN、RouteLLM、RouterDC、IRT-Router、ICL-Router等基线；2) 在50%:50%训练-测试分割下仍保持优势，验证了数据效率；3) 消融实验证明奖励重排序和难度分析检索两个组件均不可或缺；4) 超参数分析显示较大的k和α通常带来更好性能；5) 案例研究展示难度感知检索能找到真正需要相似能力的示例；6) Rasch模型定量验证检索的示例在难度上确实与查询更接近。
AI.conclusion: VDAR-Router通过将"难度分析"作为检索核心信号，提供了一种训练免费、可解释的LLM路由方案，能有效捕捉查询的底层能力需求，从而在多个数据集上实现更优的成本-性能平衡。该工作为自适应难度感知模型选择开辟了新方向。未来可探索潜在难度表示、与偏好感知信号的结合，以及通过微调小模型降低测试时延迟。

title: It's Not What You Say, It's How You Say It: Evaluating LLM Responses to Expressions of Belief
summary: Users frequently express their beliefs to large language models (LLMs). In some situations, the LLM should accept these contextual beliefs as true. In others, they should stick to their prior knowledge. Notably, users' expressions of belief (EoBs) can take linguistically diverse forms - using presuppositions, evidential and certainty markers, or varied tones - each of which may have a different persuasiveness over the LLMs. We introduce a typology to systematically evaluate how different EoBs affect whether models follow context versus prior knowledge. The typology is grounded in four linguistically motivated dimensions: form, evidentiality, epistemic stance, and tone, spanning 17 fine-grained types. By pairing these EoBs with world knowledge facts, we generate controlled EoB-query pairs that isolate the effect of linguistic variation. Using this benchmark, we evaluate 16 LLMs that differ in architecture (Llama3, Qwen3, Gemma3), scale (1B-30B parameters), and training stages (base vs instruct). We identify meaningful variations in response behavior across these axes, e.g., that bigger models and instruction models tend to be less context-following than smaller models and base models. We further identify specific EoBs that statistically significantly persuade LMs more consistently than others. Our work reveals systematic patterns in how linguistic framing affects LLM context integration, with implications for prompt engineering and model robustness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 EoBench，一个基于语言学分类体系的基准测试，用于系统评估不同"信念表达方式"（EoBs）对大语言模型（LLMs）整合上下文与先验知识的影响。研究基于形式、证据性、认识立场和语气四个语言学维度，涵盖 19 种细粒度表达类型，生成约 65,778 个受控 EoB-查询对，并在 16 个不同架构、规模和训练阶段的 LLM 上进行了评估。
AI.motivation: 用户在与 LLMs 交互时表达信念的方式多种多样（包含预设、证据标记、确定性标记、语气变化等），这些语言学差异可能不同程度地影响模型接受上下文而放弃先验知识的倾向。然而，现有研究缺乏对不同信念表达方式如何影响 LLM 上下文整合的系统理解，这对模型鲁棒性评估和提示工程具有重要意义。
AI.method: 研究方法包括：(1) 构建一个基于四个语言学维度（形式、证据性、认识立场、语气）的分类体系，涵盖 19 种细粒度表达类型；(2) 设计语义元组框架（包含 subject、relation、object、object_pri 等组件）以保持命题内容恒定而仅变化语言形式；(3) 基于 PopQA 数据集生成约 65,778 个 EoB-查询对；(4) 评估 16 个来自 Gemma3、Llama3、Qwen3 家族的模型（规模 1B-30B），使用上下文跟随率（CFR）作为衡量指标，并通过排列检验识别显著说服性差异。
AI.result: 研究发现：(1) 儿童导向语气、命令式、正式语气、权威诉求、虚拟语气和情感诉求等 EoB 类型在统计上显著更能说服模型同意上下文，而反事实、信念报告、弱认识立场和疑问句则显著较不能说服模型；(2) 指令微调模型普遍比基础模型更不易跟随上下文；(3) 在 Llama3 和 Gemma3 家族中，模型规模越大，CFR 越低（即越大模型越不易被说服）；(4) Llama3 系列在可比规模下比其他模型家族更不易跟随上下文，而 Qwen3 系列普遍具有高 CFR。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了语言学框架对 LLM 上下文整合的系统性影响模式，表明模型规模、训练阶段和模型家族都是影响 EoB 说服效果的重要因素。这项工作为提示工程和模型鲁棒性评估提供了细粒度的分析框架，强调了在研究 LLM 上下文敏感性时必须考虑信念表达方式这一关键因素。未来研究可探索跨维度组合的 EoB 表达以及从机制层面理解 LLM 如何处理不同 EoB。

title: Fenced Citation-Context Retrieval for Case Law: Temporal Leakage and Degree Control Across Two Jurisdictions
summary: Incoming citation context-the text with which later cases describe a case when citing it-is a strong signal for legal precedent retrieval, but it is evaluated without a temporal fence: at query time the target precedent has not yet been cited by future cases, so an unfenced method credits itself with evidence unavailable at deployment. Our central contribution is to measure how much: a temporal-admission decomposition that splits the naive relax-the-fence gain into genuine future-citation leakage, legitimate pre-query admission, and an index effect, reporting the phantom fraction-the share that is future evidence. We instantiate this as a controlled deployability audit of incoming-citation retrieval across two jurisdictions, CLERC (US federal, 1.84M documents) and ECtHR-PCR (European Court of Human Rights), adding a zero-training anchor channel that admits only citers dated before the query. On ECtHR-PCR only 14.9% of the naive gain is genuine future evidence; on CLERC the over-credit grows to +4.95 R@1000 as the fence is relaxed. Under the fence, the zero-training channel gains +16.1 R@1000 over BM25 on CLERC, clears a citation-degree control, and reaches a published R@1000 estimate similar to the strongest trained system on ECtHR-PCR (79.56 vs 79.39) at zero training.

AI.tldr: 本文针对法律先例检索中"传入引用上下文"（incoming citation context）方法缺乏时间围栏（temporal fence）导致的评估泄漏问题，提出了一种时间准入分解（temporal-admission decomposition）方法，将无围栏评估的"naive增益"精确拆解为三部分：真正的未来引用泄漏、合法的查询前准入以及索引效应，并引入"幻影分数"（phantom fraction）作为度量指标，在美国联邦（CLERC，1.84M文档）和欧洲人权法院（ECtHR-PCR，15.7k案件）两个法域上进行了零训练的部署能力审计。
AI.motivation: 法律先例检索中，引用某案例的后续判决文本（incoming citation context / PAT）是一种强信号，但现有方法（如Patil et al. 2024）在评估时未施加时间围栏——查询时目标先例尚未被未来案例引用，但方法却将未来证据记入自身收益，造成时间泄漏（temporal leakage）；同时在相关性标注即为引用的基准上，候选案例的被引数（popularity/degree）本身即可预测，需引入度控制；论文旨在量化这种过度归因（over-credit）的程度，并验证严格的时序围栏与度控制是否能跨法域迁移。
AI.method: 1) 时间准入分解：将朴素"放宽围栏"效应 c−a 精确拆为 (c−b)+(b−a')+(a'−a)，分别对应非查询前证据溢价（clean leakage）、split-static准入成本（合法的查询前引用被排除）以及索引/检索集效应；2) 幻影分数：(c−b)/(c−body)，联合聚类自助法计算；3) 零训练锚文本通道（anchor channel），按查询前时间围栏准入引用方，通过RRF与BM25正文通道融合；4) CLERC上使用年份级围栏并设计剂量-反应曲线（k=0,1,2,5,10,∞）；ECtHR-PCR上使用日级围栏并强制split-static字节级可验证；5) 多种对照：公平调参的度控制、窗口计数控制、候选身份安慰剂、家族/时间匹配安慰剂、零样本稠密对照以及来源审计。
AI.result: ECtHR-PCR（val）：朴素+4.97 R@1000效应精确拆分为非查询前证据溢价+2.70 [2.36, 3.05]（clean leakage，两个深度均稳定）、split-static准入成本+3.29 [2.57, 4.15]、索引效应−1.02，幻影分数=14.9% [12.9%, 17.1%]；围栏下锚通道达R@1000 79.56，超BM25+度对照+8.68（簇LB95 +7.62），无训练即与最强已发表训练系统LeCoPCR-HT（79.39）相当且浅层召回与MAP更优（R@100 51.03 vs 38.62；MAP 15.82 vs 13.68）。CLERC（dev）：围栏偏移剂量-反应曲线从0单调升至+4.95 R@1000，围栏下策略ΔR@1000=+16.11 [+14.28, +17.95]（覆盖条件+22.30，mapped 2058/2850），清零调参后的度控制（dev最优融合权重=0，对照退化为BM25）；家族/时间匹配安慰剂使增益塌缩至正文之下（一致于内容主导解释），而ECtHR-PCR上度/计数匹配安慰剂保留~96%（一致于结构主导）；来源审计：CLERC 9/593翻转在去除家族标记后塌缩，ECtHR-PCR 20,921窗口零违规。
AI.conclusion: 跨两个法域与协议证实：未经时序围栏的传入引用上下文检索会自我过度归因，且程度可量化、可报告；围栏下的增益在两种协议下均大而稳健并能通过显式的度控制。可迁移的教训为——法律引文上下文检索必须时序围栏且度控制方可解释增益：(i) 仅准入查询前日期的引用方；(ii) 对引文度进行控制而非仅对比文本基线；(iii) 分别报告围栏增益与准入溢价，并按语料日期粒度命名；(iv) 公开对齐/覆盖率。机制层面，"信号是什么"在两法域上呈观察性差异（CLERC偏内容、ECtHR-PCR偏结构），但"评估必须如何做"不变。

title: A Fuzzy Logic Framework for Community-Aware Crime Hotspot Detection: Prototype Application Architecture and Exploratory Validation for an Urban Computing Platform
comment: 12 pages, 6 tables, 1 figure. Framework paper with Python prototype and exploratory validation with 25 participants
summary: Urban crime prevention is a persistent socio-technical challenge for municipalities, law enforcement agencies, and citizens. Traditional reporting and response processes often rely on delayed incident reports and reactive resource allocation, while community-level signals and ambiguous early-warning indicators may remain underused. This paper reframes an Urban Computing seminar project into a fuzzy logic-based framework for community-aware urban crime hotspot detection and real-time notification. The proposed platform combines citizen reports, historical crime data, contextual urban indicators, and configurable fuzzy rules to estimate localized risk levels and support targeted awareness notifications. Unlike binary classification approaches, fuzzy logic can represent partial risk, uncertainty, and incomplete information, making it suitable for urban environments where risk is gradual and context-dependent. The paper presents the system architecture, fuzzy risk model, notification workflow, privacy safeguards, and exploratory validation with 25 participants. The evaluation focuses on perceived usefulness, notification relevance, usability, trust, privacy concerns, multilingual accessibility, and acceptance of community reporting. The findings suggest that such a platform may improve situational awareness, support reporting and planning discussions, and help address weak points in existing urban safety workflows, while not yet constituting evidence of deployed crime reduction or real-world predictive accuracy. The contribution is a responsible, human-centered framework for future research on fuzzy logic, urban computing, and community-aware crime prevention systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于模糊逻辑的社区感知城市犯罪热点检测与实时通知框架，整合市民举报、历史犯罪数据、城市上下文指标及可配置的模糊规则，用于估计局部风险等级并支持有针对性的安全意识通知。通过系统架构设计、模糊风险模型、通知工作流、隐私保护机制以及对25名参与者的探索性验证，评估了感知有用性、通知相关性、可用性、信任度、隐私顾虑、多语言可及性及社区举报接受度。
AI.motivation: 城市犯罪预防是一个涉及多方利益相关者的社会技术挑战。传统响应依赖事后报告，存在延迟干预和态势感知不足的问题。现有数据驱动的预测性警务系统虽能辅助犯罪预测与巡逻规划，但因可能复制历史报告偏差、引发反馈循环或过度警务而存在伦理敏感性。此外，城市犯罪风险并非二元分类，而是渐变的、依赖于上下文的，难以用传统刚性分类方法准确刻画。因此需要一个能够表达部分风险、不确定性及不完整信息的、负责任的、以人为本的框架来填补现有城市安全工作流的薄弱环节。
AI.method: 方法包含四部分：(1)问题分析，识别城市犯罪预防中的痛点；(2)框架设计，定义模块化架构（数据收集、预处理、模糊风险推理、地理空间分析、通知、存储与用户界面）；(3)模糊模型构建，形式化输入变量（历史犯罪率、人群密度、最近报告、事件流量、时间上下文、地点敏感性）与六等级风险输出（最小到非常高），并定义7条可解释的模糊规则；(4)探索性验证，通过对25名参与者的概念评估，从感知有用性、通知相关性、可用性、信任与隐私、社区举报接受度、多语言可及性六个维度进行评估。同时实现了基于Python的原型系统，包含伯尔尼市的交互式犯罪热点地图可视化界面。
AI.result: 探索性验证结果显示：感知有用性88%（22/25）为正面评价；通知相关性84%（21/25）为正面；可用性与清晰度76%（19/25）为正面；信任与隐私保障72%（18/25）为正面；社区举报接受度高达92%（23/25）为正面；多语言与可及性需求76%（19/25）为正面。约20/25的参与者能够依据场景逻辑一致地解释模糊风险类别。参与者最看重本地化警报、匿名社区举报以及使用风险类别而非二元安全/危险标签，但也对过度警报、隐私、虚假举报和社区污名化表示担忧。改进建议包括：更清晰的风险等级解释、多语言界面、强大的数据保护与双因素认证、匿名社区举报及审核机制、避免社区污名化，以及明确区分已确认事件与预测风险。
AI.conclusion: 本文贡献了一个负责任的、以人为中心的模糊逻辑城市犯罪预防框架，整合了社区举报、上下文指标、可解释的风险建模、地理空间分析及隐私保护。该框架不能证明实际的犯罪减少或部署后的预测准确性，但为未来关于模糊逻辑、城市计算和社区感知犯罪预防系统的研究提供了透明、社区感知、隐私保护和可问责的决策支持基础。城市安全技术的设计不应仅作为预测引擎，而应是透明、社区感知、隐私保护和可问责的决策支持系统。未来工作包括：通过领域专家完善规则库、使用匿名历史数据进行回溯测试、长期评估通知疲劳、理解度与信任，以及公平性偏差分析。

title: MDAF: A Multi-Dimensional Annotation Framework for Automated Foreign Policy Analysis
summary: Government websites contain a vast but underexploited body of textual evidence on foreign policy. This article develops a scalable approach for extracting structured information from policy texts and converting it into standardized event data, with policy event defined broadly as a statement or action. It proposes MDAF integrating an LLM workflow to automate foreign policy text identification, information extraction, and event classification. Empirically, it applies this approach to China-related texts from Five Eyes countries. The analysis shows that the resulting database supports systematic cross-national comparison, reveals variation in how states frame and implement China policy, and traces the temporal evolution of these policy profiles. This article contributes to foreign policy analysis and the methodological development of computational international relations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MDAF（多维标注框架），通过将LLM推理工作流与"行动者-事件"三元组分析单元相结合，将政府网站上的外交政策文本自动转化为结构化事件数据。该框架针对不同推理难度的标注任务，分别采用直接分类、解耦推理和分层推理三种策略，并将其应用于五眼联盟国家的对华政策文本分析，生成可进行跨国比较和时间趋势追踪的结构化数据库。
AI.motivation: 现有外交政策事件数据集存在三大局限：(1) 严重依赖人工编码（如MIDs、Manifesto Project），更新成本高、周期长；(2) 数据集为特定研究目的设计，遗漏了政策动机等重要维度（如ACLED、UCDP不涉及动机分析）；(3) 主流事件数据系统（ICEWS、GDELT）仅围绕"谁对谁做了什么"的事件记录组织，与国际关系核心理论概念（意图、威胁认知、身份认同、伙伴-竞争者定位等）脱节。此外，人工编码难以应对持续更新、语义复杂、具有战略导向的官方政策文本，导致无法同时保留文本丰富性与实现标准化、可比较、可扩展的量化分析。
AI.method: （1）**分析单元**：以"源行动者-政策事件-目标行动者"三元组为基本标注单元，先从政策文本中提取事件，再进行多维标注。（2）**七维标注框架**：政策领域（16类）、政策态度（5大类含子类，含合作-冲突谱系）、政策动机（9类，基于现实主义、自由主义、建构主义等理论传统）、政策范围（单边/双边/多边）、政策阶段（纯意图/初步规划/即将行动/进行中/已完成）、行动者层级（7类）、所代表国家。（3）**三种推理策略**：直接分类（低推理负担任务，如"所代表国家"）、解耦推理（中推理负担任务，将语义推理与结构化输出分两步进行）、分层推理（大标签空间任务，如二级政策态度，先粗分类再细分）。（4）**实证应用**：通过Google高级搜索收集五眼联盟国家政府网站2009-2025的对华政策文本，经清洗分块得到24,848个文本块，在356个人工标注样本上评估。
AI.result: （1）**直接分类**：对"所代表国家"维度，解耦推理仅比直接分类F1提升0.6%，验证了简单任务无需额外推理。（2）**解耦推理**：在政策态度、动机、领域、阶段、范围、行动者层级等维度上，比直接分类和单提示基线提升15-32个百分点；多分类任务提升尤为显著（如actor level维度F1从0.649提升至0.938）。（3）**分层推理**：对二级政策态度分类，准确性从解耦推理的16.9%大幅提升至76.6%。（4）**实证发现**：美国对华经济政策2017年后从合作转向冲突，动机从"经济利益"重新诠释为"威胁"；英国对华政策呈领域分化（气候、科技合作延续，意识形态、安全、网络冲突加剧）；五国在政策范围上差异显著（美加偏单边、新西兰偏双边、澳大利亚最均衡），美国"纯意图"陈述占比异常高（45.9%），体现强战略信号特征。
AI.conclusion: 自动政策标注不应被视为单一分类问题。不同标注维度带来不同推理负担，需差异化分配推理策略：低负担任务用直接分类、中负担任务用解耦推理、大标签空间任务用分层推理。MDAF在统一模块化工作流中整合这三种策略，相比单一策略显著提升性能，证明了基于测量任务结构组织LLM推理能够提高标注可靠性。该框架既保留了原始政策文本的丰富性，又生成了可比较、可扩展的结构化数据，为计算国际关系方法论发展和外交政策比较研究提供了可扩展的精细化分析路径。未来研究方向包括：扩展框架以适应非关系型政策现象，以及采用模型路由策略（按任务复杂度分配不同强度模型）以降低计算成本。

title: Students' Perceptions of Peer Grading
comment: Expanded author version of a paper accepted for presentation at the European Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning (ECTEL 2026)
summary: Peer grading is widely used in education, yet it elicits mixed reactions from educators and students. Although many studies have examined students' views of peer grading, their findings are scattered, and no clear overall picture has emerged. To address this gap, we conducted a mixed-source thematic analysis of literature and student discussions on Reddit. To scale the Reddit data analysis, we fine-tuned a Gemini 2.5 text-classification model and used it as an initial relevance filter for our initially retrieved dataset of 659 posts and 6,607 comments, after which the items predicted as relevant were manually reviewed. The study synthesized evidence from 107 papers, 114 Reddit posts, and 300 comments. The findings show that students view peer grading as both beneficial and problematic. Positive perceptions included learning and understanding benefits, skill development, engagement, and collaboration, while negative perceptions centered on unreliable grading, unfairness, weak feedback quality, emotional stress, and workload. Reddit discussions also suggested an emerging concern that remains underexplored in the literature: AI use in peer grading may weaken students' trust in the accuracy and authenticity of the process. We further identified eight mitigation strategies and mapped them to the negative perceptions they help address. Among these, instructor oversight and training played the most central role.

AI.tldr: 本文通过混合来源主题分析，综合107篇文献和Reddit上114篇帖子、300条评论，系统研究了学生对互评（peer grading）的看法。研究识别出6种正面感知、7种负面感知以及8种缓解策略，并发现Reddit讨论中浮现出关于AI用于互评的新兴担忧。
AI.motivation: 互评虽在教育中广泛应用，但学生对其反应褒贬不一。现有研究结果分散，缺乏系统的综合图景。此外，以往综述多聚焦于技术或流程层面（如匿名性、评分工具、算法等），而非学生的实际体验。因此，本文旨在系统整合学生对互评的感知，填补研究空白。
AI.method: 采用混合来源主题分析设计，结合两个互补数据源：（1）文献分析——遵循PRISMA框架，从6个学术数据库（ACM、Web of Science、ERIC、PsycINFO、IEEE Xplore、PubMed）筛选2003–2025年间发表的107篇论文；（2）Reddit数据分析——收集659篇帖子和6,607条评论，使用微调的Gemini 2.5文本分类模型进行相关性过滤（准确率82.5%），再经人工审核得到最终数据集。编码阶段由多名作者独立进行，采用自底向上归纳法，并计算Cohen's Kappa评估评分者间一致性。
AI.result: 正面感知（P1–P6）：学习与理解收益（P1，文献中83.2%）、技能发展（P2，79.4%）、参与度与动机（P3，69.2%）、及时性（P4）、公平信任与效度（P5）、社会协作收益（P6，57.9%）。负面感知（N1–N7）：准确性与可靠性问题（N1，Reddit中57.7%）、公平与公正性问题（N2）、评分者准备不足（N3）、反馈质量差（N4）、动机与参与度低（N5）、情感与人际负担（N6）、工作量与时间压力（N7）。Reddit讨论还揭示了AI用于互评引发信任下降的新兴问题。8种缓解策略中，教师监督（M5）和培训准备（M1）最为核心，可应对全部7类负面感知。文献与Reddit数据呈现差异：文献视角较均衡，Reddit讨论更集中于负面体验。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，互评在学习、技能发展和协作方面具有价值，但学生也对其公平性、可靠性、反馈质量和评分者准备程度存在重要担忧。互评能否被积极接受，关键在于学生是否经过充分培训、流程是否结构化清晰、以及教师是否保持积极参与。AI工具在互评中的使用虽然能提高效率，但也可能引发新的信任问题，亟需未来研究关注。

title: From Novelty to Normalisation: Tracking Changing Perceptions of AI in Higher Education, 2024-2026
summary: The rapid integration of generative artificial intelligence (AI) has reshaped the landscape of higher education. Students have embraced tools such as ChatGPT with striking speed, while teaching staff and institutions have responded with greater caution. Existing research on AI perceptions has mainly been cross-sectional, providing single-point snapshots that view attitudes as stable rather than evolving. This paper presents a longitudinal study of AI perceptions in higher education, tracking undergraduates, doctoral researchers, teaching staff and non-teaching staff at Ulster University across three survey waves between 2024 and 2026 (n=1,665). A quantitative survey design measured familiarity, reported use and perceived risk; results show that students rapidly normalised AI use over the period, moving from tentative experimentation to routine engagement, while staff expressed persistent concerns about academic integrity, assessment design, and critical thinking. Doctoral and non-teaching staff occupied intermediate positions, reflecting both pragmatic adoption and institutional caution. The student-staff gap widened as institutional policy struggled to keep pace with actual practice. By tracking these shifts directly rather than reconstructing them from disconnected studies, the paper moves beyond descriptive accounts of AI attitudes and demonstrates the importance of capturing perceptions in real time. The findings carry significant implications for adaptive institutional policy, AI literacy initiatives, and targeted staff training.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对阿尔斯特大学(Ulster University)四类群体(本科生、博士研究生、教学人员、非教学人员)在2024-2026年三波调查(n=1,665)的纵向追踪,揭示了生成式AI(如ChatGPT)在高等教育中的认知演变规律:学生群体快速将AI使用常态化,而教职人员对学术诚信、评估设计和批判性思维表达持续担忧,学生与教职之间的认知差距随机构政策的滞后而扩大。
AI.motivation: 现有AI认知研究多为横截面设计,仅提供单一时间点的态度快照,将态度视为稳定的而非动态演变的,无法捕捉AI技术在高等教育中快速整合过程中的真实态度变化轨迹,亟需纵向实证研究弥补此空白。
AI.method: 采用纵向定量调查设计,以阿尔斯特大学四类群体为研究对象,在2024至2026年间开展三轮问卷调查(总样本量n=1,665),测量三个核心维度:AI熟悉程度、报告使用情况及感知风险,通过对同一群体跨时间点的态度追踪进行动态比较分析。
AI.result: 学生群体从试探性使用迅速过渡到常规化使用,实现了AI使用的快速常态化;教职人员对学术诚信、评估设计、批判性思维表达持续担忧;博士研究生与非教学人员处于中间位置,呈现务实采纳与制度谨慎并存的双重特征;学生与教职之间的认知差距随着机构政策滞后于实际实践而进一步扩大。
AI.conclusion: 研究通过实时追踪而非依赖零散研究的拼接重建,超越了描述性AI态度分析的局限,证明实时捕捉感知变化的重要性;结论对适应性机构政策制定、AI素养计划的推进以及有针对性的教职人员培训具有重要实践启示。

title: To Police or to Guide: How Higher Education Computer Science Instructors Design and Implement Generative AI Policies
summary: While generative AI tools are directly changing how undergraduate computer science is learned and taught, they are also reshaping the relationships between instructors and students. In contrast to existing tool-oriented research on how instructors view and adopt AI, this study investigates how instructors think about their roles and responsibilities to students through their course AI policies. Based on 13 semi-structured interviews with CS instructors in the US, we found that while instructors recognize that AI tools could harm student learning, AI policies primarily seek to AI-proof assessments without directly addressing student learning. Although policies such as switching to paper exams can preserve assessment integrity in the short term, instructors report extra burden of policing student AI use behaviors and worsening relationships with students. Based on the experiences of several interviewees, we make recommendations on AI policies that are more learning-oriented and could guide students toward healthier AI usage instead.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对13位美国高校计算机科学教师的半结构化访谈，探讨了他们如何设计与实施生成式AI政策。研究发现，虽然教师意识到AI可能损害学生学习，但AI政策主要聚焦于"AI-proofing"（防御AI）的评估方式而非直接解决学习问题，导致教师负担增加、师生关系恶化。文章倡导从"管控"转向"引导"，提出更具学习导向性的AI政策建议。
AI.motivation: 现有的关于生成式AI（GenAI）与教育的研究多聚焦于工具本身，即教师如何认知、采用和使用AI工具，而较少关注AI政策作为一种"社会契约"如何重塑师生关系与责任分配。GenAI工具自2022年普及以来，已广泛影响本科计算机科学（CS）教育：学生用AI辅助编程、TA用AI辅助评分、教师尝试整合AI教学工具。然而，AI对师生关系的间接影响（如信任侵蚀、政策不透明导致的权力不对等）尚未得到充分研究。该研究旨在通过分析教师设计AI政策的过程，理解教师如何看待自身对学生角色与责任的变化。
AI.method: 研究采用定性研究方法，对13位美国高校本科CS课程在职教师进行了时长约1小时的半结构化远程访谈。受访者来自9所不同类型的高等教育机构，教授课程涵盖CS1至各类高级选修课。访谈协议分为四部分：教学背景、书面AI政策（教学大纲中的政策）、AI政策执行（如何判定违规及如何处理）、AI政策设计动机。研究采用反思性主题分析（reflexive thematic analysis），由三位研究者共同编码、提炼主题，并通过反复讨论形成对数据的解释。研究特别保护受访者身份，不报告人口统计学信息。
AI.result: 研究发现主要包括四个方面：(1) 教师识别出AI的"学习伤害"与"评估伤害"两类不同问题——前者包括认知卸载（cognitive offloading）、能力错觉（illusion of competence）和社会孤立，后者指AI使教师难以判断学生提交作业是否真实反映其学习水平；(2) 虽然学习伤害更为复杂，但多数教师更倾向于通过"AI-proofing评估"来应对，包括使用监考笔试、提高考试权重、设置"蜜罐"陷阱检测AI使用等；(3) 这些评估导向的政策带来二阶成本——检测AI的工作量巨大、政策将教师置于"警察"角色、师生关系趋于对抗性、为应对压力学生选择自我隔离；(4) 部分教师探索了更具学习导向性的政策，包括透明的AI沟通、课堂示范AI良好用法、采用低利害的形成性评估促进元认知、以及通过开放式项目激发学习动机。然而，整体上教师倾向于将规范AI使用的责任转嫁给学生。
AI.conclusion: 本文主张AI政策应从"评估导向"转向"学习导向"。以检测和惩罚为主的政策无法有效解决学生过度依赖AI的根本问题，反而损害师生关系（类似"禁欲式性教育"已被证明无效）。基于减害理念（harm reduction），研究提出四项学习导向的政策建议：(1) 增强AI政策透明度，明确告知学生政策背后的目的与推理；(2) 在课堂上示范良好的AI使用方式；(3) 通过低利害的形成性评估促进学生元认知；(4) 鼓励社交互动并激发学习动机。研究承认存在局限：仅基于教师自我报告、未涵盖美国以外场景、缺乏实证效果验证，但呼吁未来研究关注如何在AI时代维护师生信任、引导学生形成有判断力的AI使用方式。

title: Translating AI into scientific impact: Field context, career position, and institutional capability in AI-enabled research
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly embedded in scientific research, but its scientific value is unlikely to be distributed evenly. This study examines how AI knowledge integration is associated with scientific impact and asks who benefits from AI-related knowledge in science. Using large-scale bibliographic data, we measure AI integration through references to papers in the OpenAlex Artificial intelligence subfield and link it to five-year citation impact. The results show that AI references are generally associated with higher citation impact, but the returns vary substantially across scientific fields. Career stage also matters: senior scholars benefit more from the extensive margin of AI referencing, whereas junior scholars benefit more from intensive AI referencing and tend to cite newer and higher-impact AI papers. At the institutional level, returns are non-monotonic: institutions with intermediate AI capability achieve the largest proportional gains, while leading AI institutions are more deeply embedded in AI-centered knowledge spaces, attract more AI-related audiences, and more often become substitute citation gateways to cited AI sources. These findings suggest that the value of AI knowledge depends not only on technical capability, but also on translational capacity: the ability to make AI knowledge meaningful, legitimate, and useful across scientific communities.

AI.tldr: 本文研究AI知识整合如何影响科学影响力及其收益分配的不均衡性。研究发现AI引用普遍与更高引用影响力相关，但收益因学科领域、职业阶段和机构AI能力而显著不同，核心结论是AI知识的价值不仅取决于技术能力，还取决于跨学科转化能力。
AI.motivation: AI正日益嵌入科学研究，但其科学价值可能并非均匀分布。作者试图探究：AI知识整合与科学影响力之间存在何种关联？哪些群体从AI相关知识中获益更多？这一问题的核心在于揭示AI赋能科学研究的差异化机制，理解技术能力与跨学科转化能力在科学价值创造中的不同作用。
AI.method: 基于大规模文献计量数据（bibliographic data），以OpenAlex人工智能子领域的论文引用作为AI整合的度量指标，将其与五年期引用影响力（five-year citation impact）相联系进行分析。分析维度涵盖三个层面：科学领域差异、学者职业阶段（资深 vs. 初级）以及机构AI能力层级。
AI.result: 主要结果包括三个层面：（1）领域层面：AI引用总体与更高引用影响力正相关，但各科学领域的回报差异显著；（2）职业阶段层面：资深学者从AI引用的"广度边际"（extensive margin，即引用范围广度）中获益更多，而初级学者则从"强度边际"（intensive margin，即引用深度）获益更多，且倾向于引用更新、影响力更高的AI论文；（3）机构层面：回报呈非单调关系——具备中等AI能力的机构获得最大比例收益，而顶尖AI机构则更深入嵌入AI中心知识空间，吸引更多AI相关受众，并更常成为被引AI源的"替代性引用门户"（substitute citation gateways）。
AI.conclusion: AI知识的价值不仅取决于技术能力（technical capability），更取决于转化能力（translational capacity），即将AI知识在跨学科社区中变得有意义、合法化和有用的能力。这意味着推动AI赋能科学研究需要超越纯技术维度，重视知识跨界整合与传播的中介机制。

title: A study of GenAI usage by Design Students Analysis of Survey Results and Journals of AI practices at the Politecnico di Milano in 2025/2026
summary: The results of a survey on the use of GenAI by the design students of the Politecnico di Milano raises major questions around the role of AI in the Design Process. A domain specific set of questions alongside the more general purpose probes about GenAI usage, delivers insights into the particular practices that are emerging in Design. The very high frequency of use of GenAI tools is concentrated in the initial stages of projects and does not affect the perception of project ownership or creativity. An analysis of AI journals kept by a class during research assignments confirms the range of AI supported activities but also the limited trust in GenAI leading to systematic individual and collective verification and augmentation of outputs. Together, the findings suggest that design students are reflectively experimenting with how GenAI tools can contribute to their creative design process.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对米兰理工大学设计专业学生的GenAI使用情况调查，探讨了AI在设计过程中的作用，发现学生高频使用GenAI工具但主要集中于项目初期阶段，且未影响对项目所有权和创造力的认知；同时通过AI日志分析揭示了学生对AI输出的系统性验证与增强行为。
AI.motivation: 随着生成式AI（GenAI）在设计领域的迅速普及，理解学生如何在设计过程中使用这些工具、其使用模式如何影响创造力感知和项目所有权，以及学生对AI输出的信任程度，成为设计教育亟需探讨的重要议题。
AI.method: 采用混合研究方法：（1）对米兰理工大学设计专业学生进行问卷调查，包含领域特定问题与通用GenAI使用问题；（2）对某班级在研究作业期间记录的AI日志进行质性分析，以深入了解AI支持的活动范围及验证行为。
AI.result: 研究发现GenAI使用频率非常高，但主要集中在项目的初始阶段；学生对项目所有权和创造力的感知未受GenAI使用影响；AI日志分析显示学生进行多样化的AI支持活动，但对AI输出的信任度有限，因而采取系统性的个体与集体验证及增强策略。
AI.conclusion: 设计学生正在以反思性（reflective）的方式实验GenAI工具如何融入其创造性设计过程；学生既积极利用GenAI辅助设计，又保持批判性态度进行人工验证与增强，体现出一种审慎而具有自主意识的技术融合实践。

title: Measuring Computational Thinking Self-Efficacy (CT-SEI): Instrument development and preliminary evaluation
summary: Much effort is put into helping students at different educational levels develop Computational Thinking (CT) skills. Self-efficacy is important for skill development. It can predict perseverance, engagement and success on educational tasks. We created an instrument to measure self-efficacy of students in higher education for the CT skills abstraction, algorithmic thinking, decomposition, evaluation and generalization. First, 91 candidate items were created by including, adapting and extending items found in the literature. These items were evaluated by experts in the field of CT and education. 54 items remained and to reduce the number of items further, data was collected from 270 students in higher education recruited both through Prolific and a university setting in Costa Rica. Through principle component analysis (PCA) using a subset of 200 responses, the number of items was reduced to 27. Confirmatory factor analysis (CFA) using the remaining responses in the dataset showed the items can be divided into two categories: (1) creating the solution and (2) evaluating the solution. The created instrument can be valuable when assessing CT self-efficacy of students in higher education. With additional validation (e.g. examination of test-retest validity), we believe the scale could be used to evaluate the effectiveness of interventions, or decide what interventions should be provided to foster CT skill development.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个用于评估高等教育学生计算思维（CT）自我效能感的测量工具（CT-SEI），通过文献综述、专家评估、主成分分析和验证性因子分析等步骤，将91个候选条目缩减为27个，最终形成包含任务描述、整体自我效能感和CT技能自我效能感三部分的问卷，并发现CT自我效能感可分为"创建解决方案"和"评估解决方案"两个因子。
AI.motivation: 计算思维（CT）技能被认为是重要的21世纪技能，自我效能感是影响技能发展和任务表现的心理建构，可以预测坚持性、参与度和成功率。已有的CT自我效能感测量工具存在缺乏情境设定、措辞不当（使用"我会做"而非"我能做"）等问题，需要开发更完善的测量工具来评估高等教育学生的CT自我效能感，从而指导CT干预措施的选择和教学重点。
AI.method: 1. 基于Bandura自我效能感测量原则，设计包含三部分的问卷：任务描述（Python编程猜数字游戏）、整体任务自我效能感、CT技能自我效能感条目；2. 从现有量表（Kukul和Karatas, Gülbahar等, Korkmaz等）中整合、改编和扩展条目，初始形成91个候选条目；3. 邀请教育科学和CT领域专家评估条目，筛选保留54个条目；4. 通过Prolific平台和哥斯达黎加一所高等教育机构招募270名学生收集数据；5. 使用200份回答进行主成分分析（PCA）将条目减至27个；6. 使用剩余70份回答进行验证性因子分析（CFA）检验因子结构；7. 使用Mann-Whitney U检验分析性别差异。
AI.result: 1. 形成了包含27个条目的CT自我效能感测量工具（CT-SEI），覆盖Selby定义的5个CT技能（抽象、算法思维、分解、评估、泛化）及其子技能；2. 整个量表的Cronbach's α = 0.976，各技能的Cronbach's α介于0.846-0.928之间，表明内部一致性很高；3. CFA结果显示最拟合的模型（Model 3）将条目分为两个因子："创建解决方案"（含抽象、泛化、算法思维与分解的组合）和"评估解决方案"（含评估技能），RMSEA = 0.050，CFI = 0.972，TLI = 0.969；4. 发现显著的性别差异：男性在大多数条目上的CT自我效能感高于女性，PCA数据中53个条目中有30个差异显著；5. 工具设计允许通过调整第一部分的情境描述来适应不同类型的CT任务。
AI.conclusion: 本研究成功开发了CT-SEI工具，可用于评估高等教育学生在特定任务情境下的CT自我效能感。该工具遵循Bandura的自我效能感测量原则，通过明确的情境设定和恰当的"我能做"措辞克服了现有量表的局限。CFA分析发现CT自我效能感可从"创建解决方案"和"评估解决方案"两个维度来理解。研究发现的性别差异对CT教育干预具有重要启示。未来需要进一步验证工具的重测信度，并扩大样本量以确认因子结构的稳定性。研究者计划将该工具用于干预研究，考察样例或练习题对学生CT自我效能感的影响。

title: An approach to systemic risks of AI through the lens of emergence, collective action problems, and externalities
summary: The integration of general-purpose artificial intelligence models into downstream AI systems, among other developments, has given rise to new forms of risk that are more systemic in nature than conventional AI risks. However, there is no generally accepted definition of systemic risks in general and for AI in particular. Conceptualisations of these risks vary across research and regulation. Especially the application of the systemic risk approach to human rights or fundamental rights, like in the EU AI Act, is relatively new, just as the research on the contribution of AI to systemic forms of discrimination, privacy violations, erosions of democracy, or climate and environmental degradation. We argue that some concepts so far have not sufficiently take complexity and emergence into account. Furthermore, this variety of concepts might hinder responsible actors to adequately assess the systemic risks of AI, leading to inadequate prevention and mitigation measures and ineffective governance. To contribute to the understanding of systemic risks of AI, we propose a conceptualisation of systemic risks of AI that considers complex phenomena that lead to the emergence of harms at the societal or global level. We outline systemic risks mainly as complex externalities and collective action problems. Of particular interest are feedback dynamics, processes that lead to market concentration like network effects, algorithmic monocultures, and integration processes of AI supply chains or 'AI ecosystems' and across societal sectors, which can result in structural dominance, (inter-) dependencies, and cascading risks. Further phenomena contributing to systemic risks are information asymmetries, informational emergence, and deficits of the governance and institutional framework.

AI.tldr: 本文针对当前缺乏被广泛接受的"AI系统性风险"定义的现状，提出一个新的概念化框架，将AI系统性风险主要界定为复杂外部性和集体行动问题，重点关注反馈动态、市场集中、算法单文化、AI生态系统整合及治理缺陷等现象，以推动对该类风险的理解与治理。
AI.motivation: 随着通用人工智能模型被集成到下游AI系统中，产生了比传统AI风险更具系统性特征的新型风险。然而，学术界和监管领域对系统性风险（尤其针对AI）缺乏统一定义，相关概念在研究与监管中差异显著。将系统性风险方法应用于人权/基本权利（如欧盟AI法案）属于较新尝试。此外，既有概念未充分考虑复杂性与涌现性，概念多样性阻碍了相关行为者对AI系统性风险的充分评估，进而导致预防、缓解措施及治理的不足。
AI.method: 本文采用概念分析与理论综合的方法：梳理并批判现有AI系统性风险概念化方案的不足，识别其在复杂性、涌现性方面的盲点；在此基础上构建一个综合性概念框架，将AI系统性风险定位为复杂外部性与集体行动问题，并系统整合反馈动态、网络效应、算法单文化、AI供应链/生态系统跨部门整合、结构性支配、相互依赖与级联风险、信息不对称、信息涌现以及治理与制度框架缺陷等关键现象。
AI.result: 论文提出一个更全面的AI系统性风险概念化框架，其核心要点包括：(1) 将系统性风险本质界定为复杂外部性和集体行动问题；(2) 强调风险在社会或全球层面上的涌现性危害；(3) 识别关键驱动现象——反馈动态、网络效应导致的市场集中、算法单文化、AI供应链与跨部门生态系统的整合过程；(4) 指出这些过程会引发结构性支配、相互依赖与级联风险；(5) 补充性风险因素包括信息不对称、信息涌现及治理与制度框架的缺陷。该框架旨在弥补既有概念对复杂性和涌现性关注不足的缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过提出一个综合考虑复杂性、涌现性及多层次现象的AI系统性风险概念框架，弥补了既有定义的不足，有助于研究者和监管者更准确地识别和理解AI在社会与全球层面的系统性危害。该概念化为改进AI系统性风险的评估、预防、缓解及治理提供了理论基础，对落实欧盟AI法案等监管要求及应对AI驱动的系统性歧视、隐私侵犯、民主侵蚀和气候环境退化等问题具有参考价值。

title: Beyond Fixed Depths and Widths: Optimizing Textual Decoding Tries in LLM-based Generative Recommendation
summary: Generative recommendation (GR) is an increasingly popular paradigm in recommender systems, with a prominent line of work using LLMs as autoregressive backbones to predict the next item's term IDs (e.g., titles or keywords). The success of autoregressive generation hinges on constrained beam search over a decoding trie to ensure that generated outputs correspond to valid items. However, current research predominantly focuses on generating more comprehensive term IDs to describe items, while largely neglecting the structural design of the decoding trie formed by these terms. This can lead to a trie that is poorly suited to beam search, which degrades performance. To address this, we examine the effectiveness of term IDs from the perspective of decoding trie optimization. Through empirical and theoretical analyses, we identify two desirable properties for a highly performant trie: (1) adaptive and variable ID length, enabling items with varying semantic richness to be represented by IDs of appropriate lengths, and (2) constrained branching factors, especially at shallow levels, which drastically improves the success rate of constrained beam search. Motivated by these properties, we introduce BONSAI: Branching-Optimized Node Structure for Adaptive Identifiers, a novel framework that co-designs textual term IDs and their underlying decoding trie. BONSAI extracts recommendation-informative words from item metadata and employs a minimum set cover formulation to recursively build a trie that satisfies the above properties. Experiments reveal that BONSAI achieves up to a 21.6% relative improvement over state-of-the-art baselines. Further analyses confirm the crucial role of our proposed properties, and demonstrate their generalizability to be applied to enhance the performance of other term ID methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BONSAI框架，从解码trie结构优化的角度重新审视LLM生成式推荐中的term ID设计问题，识别出两个关键属性——自适应变长ID和受限分支因子——并通过递归最小集合覆盖构建trie，在Amazon数据集上取得最高21.6%的相对性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM生成式推荐（GR）研究主要关注term ID的语义质量，却忽视了由term ID构成的解码trie结构对受限束搜索的影响。糟糕的trie结构（如浅层过度分支）会严重降低束搜索的解码成功率，从而损害推荐性能。本文旨在从trie结构优化的视角重新审视term ID设计。
AI.method: 提出BONSAI框架，包含四个阶段：(1) 用LLM提取物品元数据中的信息性关键词作为特征；(2) 通过递归最小集合覆盖（min set cover）问题构建trie，在每个内部节点选择能覆盖所有物品的最小特征集作为分支；(3) 监督微调（SFT）训练LLM以自回归生成term ID；(4) 使用GRPO强化学习在真实解码约束下进一步优化。理论上证明了该贪婪集合覆盖策略对最优解具有近似保证，并证明了变长深度严格优于固定深度。
AI.result: 在Amazon Review（Beauty、Sports、Toys）三个数据集上，Recall@5分别相对提升18.7%、16.4%、21.3%，NDCG@10提升19.5%、16.5%、20.8%，显著优于SASRec、TIGER、IDGenRec、GRLM等基线。消融实验验证了受限分支因子和变长深度两个属性的必要性；将GRLM的term ID用BONSAI策略重排序后性能提升7.7%-9.1%，证明其可迁移性；在冷启动场景和模型/数据规模扩展上也表现稳健。
AI.conclusion: BONSAI揭示了生成式推荐中item表示质量与解码结构应被联合优化而非独立处理。未来的研究方向包括改进特征提取方法、更好地权衡trie的深度与宽度，以及将相同原理扩展到多模态item表示。

title: Uncertainty as Remedy: Mitigating Satisfaction Label Bias in Short Video Multi-Objective Ensemble Ranking
summary: The core objective of short video recommendation is to model users' unobservable true satisfaction with recommended videos. As the dominant industrial framework, end-to-end multi-objective ensemble ranking models are typically trained with multi-dimensional dense user behavioral signals, such as clicks and watch time. However, these behavioral signals are partial, fragmented, and often mutually conflicting user satisfaction proxies, introducing uncertainty and label bias into satisfaction modeling. Conventional deterministic models overlook this uncertainty, which exacerbates satisfaction label bias and results in suboptimal model convergence. Meanwhile, existing uncertainty-aware methods mostly employ uncertainty for post-hoc ranking adjustments rather than leveraging it as a remedy to mitigate the inherent bias within the core optimization pipeline. This paper proposes UAME, an Uncertainty-Aware end-to-end Multi-objective Ensemble ranking framework for short video recommendation. UAME represents the model's prediction as a Gaussian scoring variable, where the mean denotes the predicted satisfaction score and the variance quantifies predictive uncertainty associated with this score. We further design a probabilistic pairwise ranking loss, and construct an uncertainty-aware sample-level weighting scheme to mitigate the bias. We further provide theoretical analysis suggesting that the weighting scheme helps mitigate satisfaction label bias. Extensive offline and online experiments on a large-scale industrial short video platform demonstrate that UAME consistently improves two state-of-the-art paradigms, EMER and EASQ, and better aligns with questionnaire-based user satisfaction. UAME has been deployed in our production short-video recommendation system and continues to deliver stable, statistically significant gains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UAME（Uncertainty-Aware end-to-end Multi-objective Ensemble ranking）框架，针对短视频推荐中端到端多目标集成排序模型因依赖点击、观看时长等多维行为信号作为用户满意度代理而引入的标签偏置问题，将不确定性作为缓解手段嵌入核心优化流程，而非仅用于推理期后处理。
AI.motivation: 工业短视频推荐的核心目标是建模用户不可观测的真实满意度，但现有端到端多目标集成排序方法（如EMER、Pantheon、HarmonRank）将异构pxtr信号视为可靠代理，采用等权损失优化；这些代理信号是片面的、碎片化的且常相互冲突，引入了样本级的满意度标签偏置。同时，传统的确定性建模无法量化多目标冲突带来的预测不确定性，且现有不确定性方法多用于推理期后调整，未在核心训练流程中缓解标签偏置。
AI.method: 1）满意度-不确定性建模：采用权重共享的双分支输出层，分别预测满意度分数μ_i和log方差log σ_i²，将评分建模为高斯随机变量 ŷ_i = μ_i + σ_i·ε_i。2）概率化pairwise排序损失（PPR）：基于高斯差分推导P(ŷ_i>ŷ_j) = Φ((μ_i-μ_j)/√(σ_i²+σ_j²))，并加入不确定性正则项防止模型通过无限增大σ来"作弊"。3）辅助约束损失：通过对pxtr冲突项对构造的pairwise逻辑回归损失，使σ_i²显式反映pxtr冲突程度。4）不确定性感知自适应加权：计算pair综合不确定性U_{ij}=σ_i²+σ_j²，经最大最小归一化后作为样本权重ω_{ij}嵌入到加权PPR（WPPR）损失中，强调高冲突item对。5）理论分析：分解真实排序风险R(f) = R_proxy(f) + Δ_proxy，证明样本级代理偏置Δ_{ij}与pxtr冲突正相关，从而与不确定性正相关（Pearson 0.65, Spearman 0.67），为以不确定性作为权重提供理论依据。
AI.result: 离线实验：在EMER和EASQ两种SOTA骨干网络上，UAME在8个核心pxtr指标上一致优于Base Model、RankDist、EBRank和ANSL基线。在EMER上pwtr提升5.8%（0.684→0.724），在EASQ上plvtr提升14.2%（0.668→0.763）、pctr提升9.2%（0.672→0.734）。在线A/B测试（7天，5%流量）：在EMER和EASQ两套部署上，LT7、App停留时长、观看时长、视频浏览数、点赞、关注、转发、评论等指标均取得统计显著（p<0.005）正增益，其中长视频率（LongView）最大提升+1.614%。超参数α=0.02、β=0.1、γ=2时效果最优。问卷分析：基于EASQ的问卷真实满意度反馈，NDCG@5提升8.71%，HR@5提升10.63%，证明对齐真实满意度。不确定性与标签偏置的相关系数Pearson=0.65、Spearman=0.67，并通过分桶可视化呈现单调递增关系。
AI.conclusion: UAME将预测不确定性作为核心优化信号而非后处理手段，通过概率化pairwise排序损失和不确定性感知自适应加权机制，有效缓解了多目标集成排序中pxtr代理信号与真实满意度之间的标签偏置。理论分析、离线多指标、在线A/B测试以及基于问卷的真实满意度评估共同验证了该框架在工业规模短视频推荐系统中具有显著、有效且稳定的效果。UAME已部署于快手生产环境，推理时仅使用μ_i打分，不增加排序阶段延迟，兼容现有工业服务系统。

title: Learning Sparse Representations of Multimodal Content for Enhanced Cold Item Recommendation
summary: The scale and rapid growth of item catalogs in modern digital platforms present significant challenges to recommender system (RS) practitioners. Most RSs use embedding similarity to predict user-item preferences, but embedding storage and low-latency retrieval is challenging in industry-scale catalogs. Furthermore, newly added items do not have corresponding embeddings and cannot be recommended effectively; previous works often tackle this item cold-start problem by generating cold item representations from auxiliary content, such as images or descriptive text, so that user preferences can be predicted without historical interactions. In this paper, we argue that sparse embeddings have notable advantages over standard dense vectors in this content-based cold-start paradigm. We describe how existing cold-start training regimes can be adapted for sparse representation learning, and build on insights from linear attention to design a pre-sparsification activation technique that induces sharpness and denoising effects in learned item-item similarities. We show that the resulting sparse embeddings achieve significant improvements in cold-start recommendation accuracy over dense embeddings at considerably lower storage costs, especially for users with multiple interests.
